March 6, 1936.
Afternoon Translation.

ACTIVITIES OF THE SHANGHAI WOMEN'S NATIONAL SALVATION
FEDERATION

The Nurse Training Committee of the Shanghai
Women's National Salvation Federation publishes the
following notice in the "Ta Mai Wan Pao" and other local
newspapers:-
China is daily suffering more insults from
foreigners and the existence of our race is in danger.
Unless we all work for the salvation of our nation,
we shall be wiped out altogether.
We, Chinese women, who constitute 50 per cent
of the population of China, should work as hard as men.
Practical training is required in order to cope with the
situation. This is the reason why the Nurse Training
Committee has been formed.
Girl students and all women organizations
should join this Committee. Doctors, qualified nurses
or students of medical schools should offer their service
free to the Committee as instructors.

Central China Daily News (telegram from Nanking):

THE CHINESE GOVERNMENT & BROADCASTING STATIONS

According to an official connected with the
radio administration, the following five matters relating
to the readjustment of radio broadcasting have been
rectified during the past two years.
1) With a view to putting a stop to troubles arising out
of wave lengths, the apparatus of radio broadcasting
stations were investigated and 13 radio broadcasting
stations in Shanghai were suppressed for violation
of regulations.
2) The programmes of the radio stations. were censored.
A radio station to maintain supervision on radio
broadcasting stations will be established in Shanghai.
3) Besides the radio stations which have been established
at Peiping and Shanghai, a big radio station will be
erected at Chungking.
4) In order to maintain the sovereignty of China, private
radio stations belonging to foreigners will be suppressed.
5) 70,000 owners of radio receivers have been registered.

Diamond (金鋼鑽), a mosquito paper:

PUBLICATION OF "PEOPLE'S LIVELIHOOD" TO BE RESUMED

After his return to China from Europe, Tseu Tao
Feng (鄒韜奮) published a weekly magazine entitled
"People's Livelihood" (大眾生活). Owing to certain
circumstances, Tseu Tao Feng recently published in newspapers
a notice announcing the suspension of the publication.
It is understood that the "People's Livelihood"
will be published as usual under the editorship of King
Chang Hwa (金仲華) and that Tseu Tao Feng will ostensibly
sever all connection with the "People's Livelihood."

上海妇女救国联合会的活动

上海妇女救国联合会护士训练委员会在《大美晚报》及其他本地报纸上刊登如下通告：-
中国每日遭受外国人更多的侮辱，我民族的生存处于危险之中。除非我们全体致力于救国，否则我们将被彻底消灭。
我们中国妇女占中国人口的百分之五十，应像男子一样努力工作。需要实际训练以应对局势。这就是成立护士训练委员会的原因。
女学生和所有妇女组织应加入本委员会。医生、合格护士或医学院学生应免费为本委员会提供服务，担任教员。

《华中日报》（南京电）：

中国政府与广播电台

据一位与无线电管理部门有关的官员称，过去两年中，以下五项关于调整无线电广播的事项已得到纠正。
1) 为了制止因波长引起的纠纷，对广播电台的设备进行了调查，上海有13家广播电台因违反规定而被取缔。
2) 广播电台的节目受到审查。将在上海设立一个电台，以监督广播电台。
3) 除了已在北平和上海建立的广播电台外，还将在重庆建立一座大型广播电台。
4) 为了维护中国的主权，将取缔属于外国人的私人广播电台。
5) 已登记了70,000名收音机所有者。

《金钢钻》，一家小报：

《大众生活》将恢复出版

邹韬奋从欧洲返回中国后，出版了一种名为《大众生活》的周刊杂志。由于某些情况，邹韬奋最近在报纸上刊登通告，宣布停刊。据悉，《大众生活》将在金仲华的主持下照常出版，而邹韬奋将在表面上切断与《大众生活》的一切联系。

March 4, 1936.

Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander's Headquarter - copies
of "Martial Law" order issued to local schools

On March 2 and 3, copies of an official order
relating to the activities of students were issued to
educational institutions in Chinese territory by the
Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commander's Headquarters. The
order states that in accordance with the rules governing
Martial Law, promulgated by the National Government, all
students should confine their attention to studies and
that the forming of organizations, holding of meetings
and processions, or any other activities liable to
endanger peace and order are prohibited. The order concludes
by stating that the principal of each school will be held
responsible for the conduct of the students under his care.

吴淞上海警备司令部——发给当地学校的“戒严令”副本

3月2日和3日，吴淞上海警备司令部向中国领土内的教育机构发布了关于学生活动的官方命令副本。该命令指出，根据国民政府颁布的戒严法规，所有学生应专心学业，禁止成立组织、举行会议和游行，或进行任何其他可能危及和平与秩序的活动。命令最后指出，各校校长须对其管辖下学生的行为负责。

The Modern Daily News (時 事 新 報), a mosquito newspaper,
published the following article on February 29 :-

NOTIFICATION OF THE WOOSUNG-SHANGHAI GARRISON COMMANDER'S
HEADQUARTERS ON THE SUBJECT OF THE PROCLAMATION OF
PRECAUTIONARY MEASURES

The Woosung-Shanghai Garrison
Commander's Headquarters which is concurrently responsible
for the application of precautionary measures in the
districts of Shanghai and Woosung, has issued the
following notification No. 1315, Character Chung Pi :-
"The National Government has
promulgated a set of emergency measures governing the
maintenance of public order and has issued circular
instructions to the military and civil authorities of
the country to comply with these measures.
"We have received orders to proclaim
and enforce precautionary measures within the area of
Shanghai and Woosung. In future, students of all
schools in districts where precautionary measures are
in force, must strictly observe the order and should
remain at their studies. The holding of meetings,
processions and demonstrations, as mentioned in the
emergency measures governing the maintenance of public
order and in the precautionary measures, as well as
acts that are liable to affect the order of the community
will be prohibited. All students should observe these
measures. They will be dealt with severely if they
deliberately violate the law. Apart from issuing
separate instructions to this effect, we publish this
notification for general information of the public.

(Signed): General Yu Teh-chen,
Commander of the Woosung-Shanghai
Garrison Headquarters and concurrently
Commander for the enforcement of
Precautionary Measures.
February 24 of the 25th Year of the Chinese Republic."

兼管上海及吴淞地区预防措施实施的吴淞上海警备司令部，发布了第1315号中秘字通告如下：“国民政府已颁布一套关于维持公共秩序的紧急措施，并向全国军政机关发出通令，要求遵照执行这些措施。

March 2, 1936.
Afternoon Translation.

The "Shengxozhsh"(生活知識) published the following article
in Volume 1, Issue No. 10 :-

RE ALLEGED USE OF VIOLENCE AGAINST UNARMED STUDENT
DEMONSTRATORS BY THE S.M.P.

On February 6, local newspapers published
a Reuter telegram from London reporting that in the House
of Lords on February 5 Lord Marley sought information
concerning the alleged use of violence against unarmed
student demonstrators by the Police of the International
Settlement of Shanghai in December last.
The so-called "unarmed student demonstrators"
probably refer to the Chinese students, but does it not
sound strange that no protest has been lodged by the
Chinese Government over the assault on the Chinese students?
In reality, there is nothing strange about it, because in
other parts of China where the "British Police" do not
function unarmed Chinese student demonstrators are similarly
treated with violence. Therefore, on what grounds can
China lodge a protest with the British Government?
The reply given in the House of Lords to
the enquiry put by Lord Marley undoubtedly means that the
Shanghai Municipal Police could not be blamed for using
undue violence because the conduct of the students had
gone beyond limits and bordered on disorder. The Earl
of Stanhope, Under Secretary of the Foreign Office, said
that the last thing that the Shanghai Municipal Council
would desire the Police to do would be to attack Chinese
unduly and raise bad feeling between Chinese and foreigners.
It is a pity that the argument of the Earl
of Stanhope, though smartly worded, is so silly, because
attacks on Chinese by the Police are public and common
occurrences. I have heard people say that at the time
when a Chinese student was arrested during a demonstration
in Shanghai, one of the Chinese policemen who was escorting
him raised his thumb and praised him thus:- "You are truly
courageous. Formerly 'sergeants'(?) used to attack
Chinese; one never hears of Chinese attacking 'sergeants'
......" Besides the attacking of Chinese, have not
reports appeared in newspapers of the throwing of a living
Chinese into a creek by two foreign policemen?

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

REGISTRATION OF SLAVE GIRLS

The movement for the emancipation of
slave girls was formally commenced yesterday. The Bureau
of Public Safety has already started the registration
of slave girls.
During the period of investigation to
be conducted by the Bureau of Public Safety, owners of
slave girls should apply to the Bureau for the registration
of their slave girls, while slave girls should be allowed
to apply for registration with the Bureau. Those slave
girls who have already been registered with the Bureau
should be granted their freedom. Owners who fail to
apply for the registration of their slave girls during
the period of investigation will be imposed a fine of
less $10.

《生活知识》在第1卷第10期发表了以下文章：

关于工部局警务处据称对 unarmed 学生示威者使用暴力的评论

2月6日，本地报纸刊登了一则来自伦敦的路透社电报，报道说在2月5日的上议院会议上，马利勋爵（Lord Marley）就去年12月上海公共租界警察据称对 unarmed 学生示威者使用暴力一事寻求信息。
所谓的“unarmed 学生示威者”可能指的是中国学生，但中国政府没有就中国学生受袭一事提出抗议，这难道不奇怪吗？实际上，这并不奇怪，因为在中国其他没有“英国警察”执法的地方，unarmed 的中国学生示威者同样遭受暴力对待。因此，中国有什么理由向英国政府提出抗议呢？
上议院对马利勋爵询问的答复无疑意味着，不能指责上海公共租界警务处使用过度暴力，因为学生的行为已经越界，近乎骚乱。外交部次长斯坦霍普伯爵（Earl of Stanhope）表示，上海公共租界工部局最不希望警察做的事情就是过度攻击中国人，从而引起中外人士之间的不良情绪。
可惜斯坦霍普伯爵的论点虽然措辞巧妙，却十分愚蠢，因为警察攻击中国人是公开且常见的事情。我听说，在上海一次示威活动中，当一名中国学生被捕时，护送他的一名中国巡捕竖起大拇指称赞道：“你真勇敢。以前都是‘巡长’（原文为 sergeants，疑指外籍巡捕或高级华捕）攻击中国人；从未听说过中国人攻击‘巡长’……”除了攻击中国人之外，报纸上不是还报道过两名外籍巡捕将一名活着的中国人扔进小河沟的事吗？

THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION AND THE STUDENTS

Of late the students of certain schools in
Peiping, Tientsin and Hankow have been threatening their
teachers and abused the representatives they had sent to
attend the interview given by General Chiang Kai Shek.
Interviewed by a reporter of the Central
News Agency on February 24, Wong Shih Jih (王世杰)
Minister of Education, said : -" This Ministry is paying
close attention to the matter. Apart from instructing
the authorities of various schools to enforce strict
disciplinary measures and to punish instigators, it was
decided to take drastic action, if necessary, to deal
with the situation, either by discontinuing grants or by
closing the schools for a time. As regards education
during the period of national crisis, the Ministry is
at present carefully studying the matter and will enforce
the measures as soon as a decision has been reached."

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE CHINESE REPUBLIC NATIONAL SALVATION FUND SAVINGS SOCIETY.

An organization known as the "Chinese Republic National Salvation Fund Savings Society"(中華民國救國金儲蓄會) has been formed by Kiang Vung Yue(江向漁), Yang Wei Nyoh(楊衛玉), Pan Niang Yao(潘仰堯) and Ho Ching Zu(何清儒) of the Chinese Vocational Educational Society(中華職業教育社).
The following are brief particulars of the objects and the rules of organization of this Society :-
The object of this Society is to unite patriotic citizens throughout the country and to induce them to curtail their daily expenses as much as possible and to donate their savings to a fund to meet the urgent needs of the State in external affairs. Any person who approves of this object may join this Society which has already begun to receive savings. Any body may become a member of this Society upon the introduction of at least two members.
The following are the rules of this Society:-
(1) Basic organization: Members of any public body, rural district, street, village, or family, not fewer than ten in number, may form a small body to be known as "---- Branch of the Chinese Republic National Salvation Fund Savings Society in ----- Hsien, ----- Province".
(2) District consolidated body: The various branches in a Hsien may be formed into a single body to be known as "----- Hsien or District Branch of the Chinese Republic National Salvation Fund Savings Society".
(3) A joint body formed by various branches of a Hsien or District is to be called "---- Provincial or Municipal Branch of the Chinese Republic National Salvation Fund Savings Society".
(4) A national body of such branches is to be called the Main Office of the Chinese Republic National Salvation Fund Savings Society.
Apart from collecting monthly and ordinary savings, this Society will also convene various kinds of informal meetings and consider reports submitted by executive members to promote common sense, to foster a national spirit and to encourage patriotic feelings. The collection will be used for military expenses in warfare against outsiders.

中华民国救国金储蓄会

由中华职业教育社的江向渔、杨卫玉、潘仰尧和何清儒组建了一个名为“中华民国救国金储蓄会”的组织。
以下是该会的宗旨和组织规则概要：
本会的宗旨是团结全国爱国公民，劝导他们尽可能缩减日常开支，并将节省下来的钱捐赠给基金，以满足国家在外交事务上的紧急需求。任何赞同此宗旨的人均可加入本会，本会已开始接收储蓄。任何人经至少两名会员介绍，即可成为本会会员。
本会规则如下：
(1) 基本组织：任何公共团体、乡村区、街道、村庄或家庭的成员，人数不少于十人，可组成一个小团体，称为“----省----县中华民国救国金储蓄会----分会”。
(2) 区级联合团体：一个县内的各分会可合并为一个团体，称为“中华民国救国金储蓄会----县或区分会”。
(3) 由一个县或区的各分会组成的联合团体，称为“中华民国救国金储蓄会----省或市分会”。
(4) 此类分会的全国性团体称为中华民国救国金储蓄会总会。
除收集月度储蓄和普通储蓄外，本会还将召开各种非正式会议，审议执行委员提交的报告，以普及常识、培养民族精神和鼓励爱国情感。所收款项将用于对外战争的军费开支。

The People's Livelihood (大衆生活), Volume 1, Issue No. 15,
reproduced the following article :-

THE SHANGHAI INTELLECTUALS NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION
CRITICIZES MANIFESTO OF THE CENTRAL PROPAGANDA COMMITTEE
OF KUOMINTANG HEADQUARTERS

(Abridged Translation)

We are disappointed over the manifesto
issued by the Central Propaganda Committee of the
Kuomintang Headquarters on February 21. For the sake
of the Kuomintang and the future of the Chinese nation,
we beg sincerely to submit the following points for
consideration by the Committee and the authorities:-
The patriotic movement for the
salvation of the nation was started in Shanghai because
of the establishment of the bogus autonomous movement
in North China. At that time the traitors in North
China assembled numbers of opium addicts and made them
appear as representatives of the people in that territory.
The papers in North China openly published articles in
favour of the traitors. Yet the Central Propaganda
Committee failed to take any measures to rectify this
at a time when the activities of the traitors were
becoming highly dangerous.
Realizing our imminent danger, we
started the movement for national salvation and our
action was immediately followed by students throughout
the country. As a result, the traitors were alarmed and
their activities have since become less conspicuous.
If the Government officials and the members of the
Kuomintang are really sincere for the welfare of the
Chinese nation, they should support this movement.
Even if there exist irregularities in the organization
of the movement, they should take every step to rectify
them and direct the students in their movement.
Unfortunately, the Central Propaganda
Committee remained inactive while the traitors in
North China were actively engaged; but when the students
started a national salvation movement, the Central
Propaganda Committee adopted strong measures and
denounced the movement. This is why we are disappointed
over the manifesto of the Central Propaganda Committee.
We will all support our Government
if it will sincerely adopt a policy of resistance and will
frankly announce to the people its future policy. We
hope that our Government will not fall into its former
mistakes. This does not mean that we are demanding of our
Government to put up resistance against the enemy
immediately. What we earnestly desire is that the Government
will make all preparations for an effective resistance
against the enemy. In the past, not only had our Government
failed to arouse the feelings of the people or to organize
them to resist the enemy, but had, on the contrary, compelled
them to befriend the enemy. This is a suicidal policy.
If the Government fails to correct a
policy which will result in the ruin of China and the
annihilation of the Chinese race, then we can definitely
state that even if the Government has made all preparations
to resist the enemy, such preparations will result in
nothing.
In conclusion, we hope that the Central
Propaganda Committee will, in the interests of the Chinese
nation and the Kuomintang, immediately rectify its mistakes.

《大众生活》，第一卷第十五期，
转载了以下文章：-

上海文化界救国会
批评国民党总部中央宣传部宣言

（节译）

我们对国民党总部中央宣传部于2月21日发表的宣言感到失望。为了国民党及中华民族的前途，我们恳切地提出以下几点，供该部及当局考虑：-
抗日救国的爱国运动之所以在上海发起，是因为华北建立了伪自治运动。当时，华北的汉奸聚集大批鸦片烟民，让他们冒充该地区的民意代表。华北的报纸公然刊登支持汉奸的文章。然而，在汉奸活动日益危险之际，中央宣传部却未采取任何措施予以纠正。
鉴于危在旦夕，我们发起了救国运动，全国学生随即响应。结果，汉奸们惊慌失措，其活动此后变得不再那么猖獗。
如果政府官员和国民党党员真心为中华民族的福祉着想，就应当支持这一运动。即使该运动的组织存在不规范之处，也应当采取一切步骤加以纠正，并引导学生的运动方向。
不幸的是，当华北汉奸积极活动时，中央宣传部无所作为；而当学生发起救国运动时，中央宣传部却采取强硬措施并谴责该运动。这就是我们对中央宣传部宣言感到失望的原因。
如果政府真诚采取抵抗政策，并向人民坦率宣布其未来政策，我们将全力支持政府。我们希望政府不要重蹈覆辙。这并不意味着我们要求政府立即对敌进行抵抗。我们迫切希望的是，政府做好有效抗敌的一切准备。过去，我国政府不仅未能唤起民众情感或组织民众抗敌，反而强迫他们与敌人亲善。这是一种自杀政策。
如果政府不纠正这种将导致中国毁灭和中华民族灭绝的政策，那么我们可以肯定地说，即使政府做好了抗敌的一切准备，这些准备也将毫无结果。
最后，我们希望中央宣传部为了中华民族和国民党的利益，立即纠正其错误。

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

EMERGENCY MEASURES FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF PEACE AND ORDER

On February 20, the National Government promulgated the following emergency measures for the maintenance of peace and order:-
(1) When an incident that disturbs the peace and order or incites an uprising or obstructs traffic or endangers the nation in some other way has taken place, the military and police who are responsible for the maintenance of public safety may stop it by force of arms or by any other effective means.
(2) Whoever conducts propaganda by writing, drawing, speech or any other means may be arrested on the spot. In case of absolute necessity, armed force or any other effective means may be employed to overcome resistance.
(3) The military and police shall at once disperse any meeting or procession that is liable to impair the peace and order or to incite the people, and may arrest the ringleaders and other persons when they offer resistance.
(4) Whenever an incident of any one of the abovementioned nature occurs, the military and police shall at once disarm persons who are in possession of arms and arrest them. A search for suspects may be made.
(5) Whoever knowing a person to have violated these measures conceals him or accommodates him or makes him go into hiding may be arrested.
(6) When dealing with an incident, the military and police shall immediately report the matter to their senior officers. Arrested offenders shall be at once escorted to the senior officer of the Gendarmerie or the Commissioner of the Public Safety Bureau or the Magistrate of a Hsien or a Procurator for interrogation and the case shall be dealt with in accordance with the Emergency Measures for the punishment of persons endangering the Republic of China or under the Criminal Code.
(7) The military and police who deal with an incident in accordance with these measures shall accord special protection to law-abiding persons and pay attention to the maintenance of peace and order or to its restoration.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

维持治安紧急措施

2月20日，国民政府颁布了以下维持治安紧急措施：-
(1) 当发生扰乱治安、煽动暴乱、阻碍交通或以其他任何方式危害国家的事件时，负责维护公共安全的军警可以使用武力或其他任何有效手段予以制止。
(2) 凡通过文字、图画、演讲或任何其他方式进行宣传者，可当场逮捕。在绝对必要的情况下，可使用武力或其他任何有效手段克服抵抗。
(3) 军警应立即驱散任何可能损害治安或煽动民众的集会或游行，并在遇到抵抗时逮捕首要分子及其他人员。
(4) 每当发生上述性质的事件时，军警应立即解除持有武器者的武装并将其逮捕。可对嫌疑人进行搜查。
(5) 凡明知某人违反这些措施而予以藏匿、容留或协助其潜逃者，可予逮捕。
(6) 在处理事件时，军警应立即向上级报告。被捕罪犯应立即押送至宪兵高级军官、公共安全局局长、县长或检察官处接受审讯，案件将根据《危害民国紧急治罪法》或《刑法》进行处理。
(7) 依照这些措施处理事件的军警，应对守法公民给予特别保护，并注意维持或恢复治安。

China Evening News published the following comment on
February 12:-

BRITISH POLICEMEN FOUND "NOT GUILTY"

Two British policemen threw a sick Chinese
beggar into a creek. The beggar died. The policemen were
charged in the British Court. In all 27 Chinese and
foreign witnesses were heard.
On February 11, the case ended. The Judge
asked the jury whether the accused were guilty.
The jury (twelve British residents), after a
consultation lasting 40 minutes, declared that the British
policemen were "Not Guilty"
It was not surprising that applause came
from some of the people present in Court.
Was the sick Chinese beggar thrown into the
creek by the two British policemen or was he thrown upon
a beggar boat? The truth will never be known.

Social Daily News (社會日報), a mosquito paper, published
the following comment on February 12:-

LORD MARLEY

Lord Marley, member of the British House of
Lords, sought information regarding the alleged use of
undue violence against unarmed students by the Police of
the International Settlement of Shanghai in December, 1935.
Anybody knows that students held processions
and conducted propaganda as a protest against the autonomy
movement in North China. Actually, only the Government
officers possess authority to decide upon a plan to deal
with the situation. The fact must not be overlooked
that when a person offends our "good neighbour", capital
punishment would be too good for him. For this reason,
General Sung Cheh Yuan of Peiping he turned his sword against
the Chinese people, and precautionary measures were
adopted in Shanghai and Hankow against the students'
movement.
Nobody dares to say that the Government's
policy to maintain friendly relations with a foreign
country is not good. Has anybody ever heard of any
member of the Control Yuan daring to impeach Government
officials for having dealt unfairly with the movement of
the students?
Lord Marley questioned the British Foreign
Minister about the handling of the students' movement
in Shanghai. Is he crazy or is his act so ridiculous
after all?

《China Evening News》于2月12日发表如下评论：

英国警察被判“无罪”

两名英国警察将一名患病的中国乞丐扔进沟渠。该乞丐死亡。这两名警察在英国法院被起诉。共有27名中外证人出庭作证。
2月11日，案件审结。法官询问陪审团被告是否有罪。
陪审团（由十二名英国侨民组成）经过40分钟的商议后，宣布这两名英国警察“无罪”。
法庭上部分旁听者发出欢呼声，这并不令人意外。
这名患病的中国乞丐究竟是被两名英国警察扔进沟渠，还是被扔上了一艘乞丐船？真相将永远无人知晓。

蚊型小报《社会日报》于2月12日发表如下评论：

马利勋爵

英国上议院议员马利勋爵（Lord Marley）就1935年12月上海公共租界警察据称对 unarmed 学生使用过度暴力一事寻求信息。
众所周知，学生举行游行并进行宣传，是为了抗议华北的自治运动。实际上，只有政府官员才有权决定处理局势的方案。不可忽视的事实是，当一个人冒犯我们的“好邻居”时，死刑对他来说都算是太轻了。正因如此，北平的宋哲元将军将屠刀挥向中国人民，上海和汉口也针对学生运动采取了预防措施。
没人敢说政府维持与外国友好关系的政策不好。可曾听说过有任何监察院委员敢于弹劾政府官员对学生运动处理不公？
马利勋爵就上海学生运动的处置情况质询英国外交大臣。他究竟是疯了，还是其行为终究如此荒谬？

The "Holmes"(福尔摩斯) published the following comment on
February 8 :-

"UNWARRANTED USE OF VIOLENCE BY SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE".

In the House of Lords on February 5, Lord
Marley, leader of the Opposition, sought information on the
alleged use of force against unarmed student demonstrators
by the Police in the International Settlement of Shanghai
in December last. Replying, the Earl of Stanhope, Under
Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs, said that the reports
he had read in the Shanghai newspapers concerning the
demonstrations there differed very materially from Lord
Marley's account of the happenings. It was obvious from
these reports that the students had disorganized traffic
and had tried to enter the Settlement. He stated that he
would inquire whether or not the Police under the control
of the Shanghai Municipal Council had used undue violence,
but he thought that the very last thing the S.M.C. would
desire the Police to do would be to attack Chinese unduly
and raise bad feeling between Chinese and foreigners. In
consequence, Lord Marley's inquiry was dropped.
This debate in the British House of Lords
is very interesting; it gives us two views of present-day
conditions in China.
In the first place, if a Chinese had been present
in the House of Lords during this debate, he would have
laughed heartily at the sight of the large number of British
Peers wasting their time and energy over happenings in China
to which an average Chinese citizen would not have paid any
attention whatever. Probably, Lord Marley had some ground
for his enquiry as to whether or not the S.M.P. had used
undue violence against unarmed student demonstrators in
December last. The reply given by the Under Secretary
did not definitely deny it, yet his assertion that according
to the reports of the affair carried by Shanghai newspapers
the students had disorganized traffic and had tried to enter
the Settlement is true. Thus the patriotic demonstrations
which took place on Nanking Road in December last had given
rise to two kinds of views: one to the effect that the
demonstrations were orderly, and the other that the students
had disorganized traffic and had tried to enter the
Settlement.
However, the opinion was general in the
House of Lords that "the last thing the S.M.C. would desire
the Police to do would be to attack unduly." We are also
certain that "the first thing the S.M.C. would desire the
Police to do would be to make justified attacks upon
Chinese" for that would not create ill feeling between
Chinese and foreigners but would produce "the utmost good
sentiment" among the upper class Chinese.
In the second place, if the patriotic
demonstrations held by unarmed students in China during
the past few years had been held in favour of the "friendly
Powers", the foreign and Chinese authorities would not have
dared to suppress them, but would have afforded every
protection to them. As the demonstrations were held
because of love for the fatherland, they were, in the eyes

《福尔摩斯》报于2月8日发表如下评论：

“上海公共租界警务处无端使用暴力”。

2月5日，在上议院，反对党领袖马利勋爵就去年12月上海公共租界警察据称对 unarmed 学生示威者使用武力一事寻求信息。外交副大臣斯坦霍普伯爵（Earl of Stanhope）在答复中表示，他在上海报纸上读到的关于当地示威的报道，与马利勋爵所述的事件经过存在极大差异。从这些报道中可以明显看出，学生扰乱了交通并试图进入租界。他表示，他将调查受上海工部局控制的警察是否使用了过度暴力，但他认为，工部局最不希望警察做的事情莫过于无端攻击中国人，从而引起中外之间的不良情绪。因此，马利勋爵的质询被搁置。
这次英国上议院的辩论非常有趣；它让我们看到了当今中国局势的两种观点。
首先，如果在这次辩论期间有一位中国人在上议院在场，看到众多英国贵族将时间和精力浪费在普通中国公民根本不会关注的中国事件上，他一定会开怀大笑。也许，马利勋爵质疑去年12月上海公共租界警务处（S.M.P.）是否对 unarmed 学生示威者使用了过度暴力，是有一定依据的。副大臣的答复并未明确否认这一点，但他断言，根据上海报纸对该事件的报道，学生扰乱了交通并试图进入租界，这一说法是属实的。因此，去年12月在南京路发生的爱国示威引发了两种观点：一种认为示威是有序的，另一种则认为学生扰乱了交通并试图进入租界。
然而，上议院的普遍意见是，“工部局最不希望警察做的事情是无端攻击”。我们也确信，“工部局最希望警察做的事情是对中国人进行正当的攻击”，因为这不会在中外之间造成不良情绪，反而会在上层华人中产生“最大的好感”。
其次，如果过去几年中国 unarmed 学生举行的爱国示威是为了支持“友好列强”，那么中外当局就不敢镇压它们，反而会提供一切保护。由于这些示威是出于爱国之情，在外国人眼中

of foreigners, "harmful to peace and order and constituted an attempted entry into the Settlement" and police batons should be used upon the demonstrators, while in the eyes of the Chinese authorities they were regarded as "riots" and "harmful to international relations" and had to be suppressed with swords, machine guns, stones, spies and imprisonment for the participants; furthermore, on the following day newspapers would publish reports to the effect that "the disorderly conduct of the demonstrators had bordered on the reactionary", that "thanks to efficient handling by the authorities, no untoward incidents occurred and the demonstrators had been quietly dispersed." The world on reading such reports will admire the efficient handling of the situation by the Chinese authorities. The newspapers which the Earl of Stanhope had read were probably Chinese newspapers and on this account he could base on them his statement to the world that the British gentlemen in Shanghai would never resort to the use of violence.
Frankly speaking, the attack made by the S.M.P. on the student demonstrators in December last was, in the eyes of the lower class Chinese, very mild and lenient and was far milder and more lenient than the action taken by the Chinese authorities against demonstrators. Supposing the students had not entered the Settlement and had demonstrated in Chinese controlled territory, the result would have been .......?
Therefore, we should shout "Support Imperialism!"

"Li Pao"(立报) published the following brief comment on February 8 :-

IT IS A CRIME TO BE POOR.

A painter named Sung Tsung Hwa(孫宗華) has been shot to death; Mei Sze Chung(梅士鈞), a worker in a certain cotton mill, has been fatally assaulted. Why have they lost their lives? Because they were poor and the life of a poor person is worth nothing, and being poor they were treated as if they were savages and were thus sent to heaven for a "civilized baptism".
They had committed no offence, they were guilty only of having been poor.

它们“有害于和平秩序并构成企图进入租界”，应当对示威者使用警棍；而在中国当局眼中，它们被视为“暴乱”和“有害于国际关系”，必须用刀剑、机枪、石块、密探和监禁参与者来镇压；此外，第二天报纸会刊登报道，称“示威者的无序行为已近乎反动”，“得益于当局的高效处理，未发生不幸事件，示威者已安静地解散。”世界读者看到此类报道，将会钦佩中国当局对局势的高效处理。斯坦霍普伯爵阅读的报纸可能是中文报纸，因此他可以据此向世界宣称，上海的英国绅士绝不会诉诸暴力。
坦率地说，在去年12月上海公共租界警务处对学生示威者的攻击，在下层华人眼中是非常温和且宽大的，远比中国当局对付示威者的行动温和宽大得多。假如学生没有进入租界，而是在中国管辖区域内进行示威，结果又会如何呢？
因此，我们应该高呼“支持帝国主义！”

贫穷是一种罪过。

一位名叫孙宗华的画家被枪杀；某纱厂工人梅士钧遭殴打致死。他们为何丧命？因为他们贫穷，穷人的命不值钱，因为贫穷，他们被当作野蛮人对待，从而被送去接受“文明洗礼”而升天。
他们没有犯罪，唯一的罪过就是贫穷。

Anti-Japanese slogans were shouted and sentiments against
traitors were expressed. Subsequently the propagandists
and a number of sympathisers formed a procession and marched
along Yung Shing Road, Jukong Road, and Paoshan Road to the
North Railway Station. Lectures denouncing Japanese
imperialism were delivered and slogans of a similar strain
were shouted. They dispersed about 7 p.m.

At 3.30 p.m. February 9, 1936, about 100 students
from universities and middle schools in the Western and
Nantao Districts of Shanghai assembled at the St. Catherine's
Bridge. They delivered open air lectures bearing on the
national salvation movement and subsequently marched in
processional order along Fong Zia Road, Chung Hwa Road,
Woo Ping Road to Rue Captain Rabier (boundary between
Chinese Controlled territory and the French Concession)
where the West Gate Branch of the Public Safety Bureau is
situated. About ~~about~~ 4.30 p.m. police attached to the
West Gate Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety attempted
to persuade them to disperse but without success. The
police then began to disperse the students by force. The
crowd resented this and a free fight developed. Order
was eventually restored at 7.30 p.m. During the melee,
four policemen and the chauffeur of the police van were
injured, the latter seriously. A number of the rioters
also received minor injuries and seven were taken into
custody.

1936年2月9日下午3时30分，来自上海西部和南市地区各大学及中学的约100名学生聚集在圣凯瑟琳桥。他们就救国运动发表露天演讲，随后列队沿冯家路、中华路、武平路行进至拉贝里船长路（华界与法租界交界处），上海市公安局西门分局即位于此处。下午4时30分左右，公安局西门分局的警察试图劝其解散，但未成功。随后警察开始强行驱散学生。人群对此表示不满，演变成混战。秩序最终于晚上7时30分恢复。在混战中，四名警察和警车司机受伤，后者伤势严重。多名肇事者也受轻伤，七人被拘留。

January 30, 1936.    3.    Morning Translation.

Eastern Times: (Hangchow Correspondence):

REPORTS OF THE MURDER OF A GERMAN AUTHORESS UNTRUE

On January 28 newspapers reported that Miss
"Morga Taisen," a German authoress, had been murdered in the
vicinity of the Lin Yin Sz ( 靈隱寺 ) Temple, Hangchow.
Enquiries made by our reporter at the Police
Station near the Lin Yin Sz Temple failed to secure any
information about the affair. Later, men were
detailed to seek information in the valleys and villages
in the vicinity of the Lin Yin Sz Temple, but without
result. Our reporter then called at various hotels but
no person by the name of "Morga Taisen" could be located.

Sin Wan Pao :

Miss Morga Taisen Returns to Shanghai

It has now been ascertained that the report of
the murder of Miss "Morga Taisen" in the vicinity of the
Lin Yin Sze Temple is absolutely untrue, because she safely
returned to Shanghai from Hangchow yesterday.

Min Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking Telegram) :-

DISCIPLINE IN SCHOOLS

On January 29 the Ministry of Education issued the
following instructions to the various Education Bureaux,
schools and colleges throughout the country:-
"Of late, students at various places have
demonstrated their patriotism and their anxiety for the
salvation of the nation. However, it is a pity that the
activities of a section of the students have been contrary
to law and unreasonable. This constitutes a violation of
discipline in schools, and as a result disorder
prevailed among schools throughout the country.
"Realizing their responsibility, the principals
of the various schools who came to Nanking recently have
issued a joint manifesto declaring that apart from
supporting the Government in preserving national territory
and devoting their attention to the promotion of education,
they are unanimously opposed to the suspension of studies
and the launching of movements that constitute a violation
of the law and the discipline of schools.
"In view of the importance of education and
the training of youths, General Chiang Kai Shek, President
of the Executive Yuan, on January 28 pointed out earnestly
and clearly the necessity of suppressing such undesirable
movements, the suspension of studies, etc. This Ministry
has been strictly ordered to observe these instructions
and to do its utmost to protect the educational work. It
should not be overlooked that education is as important
as the existence of the nation, and its suspension will
render fruitless the work of national salvation. It is,
therefore, evident that to remain away from school is
not an act of patriotism.

关于德国女作家被杀的报道不实

1月28日，各报报道一位名为“Morga Taisen”（音译）的德国女作家在杭州灵隐寺附近被杀。本报记者在灵隐寺附近的警察局查询，未获得有关此事的任何信息。随后，派人前往灵隐寺附近的山谷和村庄搜寻信息，但无结果。本报记者随后走访各家旅馆，但未能找到名为“Morga Taisen”的人。

《民报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

学校纪律

1月29日，教育部向全国各教育局、学校和学院发出如下指示：
“近来，各地学生表现出爱国热情及对国家救亡的关切。然而，遗憾的是，部分学生的活动违法且不合理。这构成了违反学校纪律的行为，导致全国学校秩序混乱。
“鉴于自身责任，近期来到南京的各学校校长发表联合宣言，声明除支持政府维护国土完整并致力于促进教育外，一致反对停课及发起违反法律和校纪的运动。
“鉴于教育及青年培养的重要性，行政院院长蒋介石将军于1月28日恳切而明确地指出了镇压此类不良运动、停课等的必要性。本部受命严格遵守这些指示，并尽全力保护教育工作。不可忽视的是，教育与国家存亡同等重要，其停滞将使救国工作徒劳无功。因此，显而易见，不上学并非爱国之举。

“本部将根据行政院的指示，仔细修订国民教育原则。除非学校内状况正常，否则执行这些原则对学校毫无益处。因此，各学校校长和教师应按照行政院的指示，维护本校的纪律和秩序，以制止停课。全国学生应保持冷静，不要被某些人误导。他们应意识到，中华民族的未来将落在他们肩上。在国家危机时刻，他们不应高估自己。除执行行政院的指示外，本部指令你们通知所有相关方。”

January 29, 1936. Morning translation.
Shun Pao publishing the following telegram from Nankirg:-
CHIANG KAI SHEK AND THE STUD NTS' MOVEMENT
ON Janua y 28, General Chiang Kai Shek,
President of the Executive Yuan, issued the following order
to principals of various schools through the medium of the
inistry of Education:-
"At this time of grave national crisis, the
educationalists should guide the youths in the observance of
disci line and endeavour to avert the crisis. In the recent
interview with representatives of school principals and
students, I stressed this point and also gave them an
explanation of the government's policy. The present
students' movement in various places arose out of the warm
patriotism of the students, but it was feared that sooner
or later they would go beyond the limits. At present certain
schools are completely without discipline and this eventually
resulted in a suspension of studies. Strict measures should
be adopted to rectify this situation.
"The winter vacation is now at end and all
schools will be resuming classes. The teaching staff should
persuade and guide the students in the right path and should
disqualify all students who fail to attend to their studies
or to pass the examinations. Students who attempt to
obstruct the studies should be instantly ordered to leave
the school, and no organization should be allowed to instigate
a suspension of studies or to interfere with the school
administration either within or without the school.. The
military and political organs in the district should suppress
all such organization. All this is intended for the
protection of education and to strengthen the national
force. The Ministry of Education should instruct all
Bureau f Education and schools to enforce this order
strictly."

1936年1月29日。晨间译文。
《申报》刊登如下来自南京的电报：
蒋介石与学生运动
1月28日，行政院院长蒋介石将军通过教育部向各学校校长发布如下命令：
“在国家危机深重之际，教育家应引导青年遵守纪律，并努力化解危机。在近期与学校校长代表及学生的会谈中，我强调了这一点，并向他们解释了政府政策。目前各地的学生运动源于学生的爱国热忱，但担心他们迟早会越出界限。目前某些学校完全缺乏纪律，这最终导致停课。应采取严厉措施纠正这一局面。
“寒假现已结束，所有学校即将复课。教职员应劝导和引导学生走上正途，并取消所有不专心学业或考试不及格学生的资格。企图阻碍学业的学生应立即勒令退学，任何组织不得在校内外煽动停课或干涉学校行政管理。该地区军政机关应取缔所有此类组织。这一切旨在保护教育并增强国力。教育部应指令各教育局和学校严格执行此命令。”

January 29, 1936.
Activities of local students in connection with autonomy movement
A number of students of local universities and
colleges who left Shanghai about one week ago for various
places along the Nanking Shanghai Railway Line for the
purpose of conducting propaganda against the autonomy
movement in North China, were compelled to return to
Shanghai by the Chinese authorities on January 28. They
were escorted from Soochow to Quinsan by a party of military
Police and from the latter place to Kiangwan by eighty members
of the paotui. The train in which they were travelling passed
through the Shanghai North Station in 2.30 p.m. and reached Kiangwan
about ten minutes later.
On leaving the train the students dispersed, but
shortly afterwards formed into processional order and, carrying
a cloth banner inscribed "Shanghai University and Middle School
Student National Salvation Propaganda Groups," marched along
Sui Dien Road, Chapei, to the North Railway Station. They
were joined by other students en route and at this time their
number had reached about one hundred. Leaving the North Station
at 5.20 p.m. the procession proceeded south along North Chekiang
Road until they reached North Chekiang Road Bridge where the presence
of a party of Municipal Police caused them to turn west along
North Soochow Road and back to Chapei via Kwang Foh Road. They
eventually dispersed on Kwang Foh Road to the west of stone
Bridge. During the course of the procession the students shouted
anti-Japanese slogans and distributed copies of two handbills
purporting to emanate from the Fuh Tan University Students
National Salvation Federation.

1936年1月29日。
本地学生参与自治运动的活动
约一周前，本地多所大学和学院的部分学生离开上海，前往京沪铁路沿线各地，旨在进行反对华北自治运动的宣传，但他们于1月28日被中国当局强制返回上海。他们由一队军警从苏州护送至昆山，随后由八十名保团成员从昆山护送至江湾。他们乘坐的火车于下午2时30分经过上海北站，约十分钟后抵达江湾。
下车后，学生们四散开来，但不久后重新整队，举着写有“上海大中学校学生救国宣传团”的布质横幅，沿闸北绥德路行进至北站。途中其他学生加入，此时人数已达约一百人。游行队伍于下午5时20分离开北站，沿浙江北路向南行进，直至浙江北路桥，因遇到一队巡捕，他们转而向西沿苏州河北路行进，并经广福路返回闸北。最终他们在石桥西侧的广福路解散。在游行过程中，学生们高呼反日口号，并分发两份声称出自复旦大学学生救国联合会的传单。

January 28, 1936.
Afternoon Translation.

Lih Pao ( 立報 ) dated Jan.27:

STUDENTS CREATE DISTURBANCES IN WESTERN DISTRICT

The other day about 20 groups of students
delivered lectures among the people in the vicinity of Zau
Ka Doo ( 曹家渡 ), Jessfield Road, Robison Road and in
Chapei. The lecturers also distributed handbills
and posted slogans along the streets.
At 7 a.m. January 26 in the vicinity of Robison
and Kiaochow Roads, 19 persons, including 5 girls, were
arrested. Most of them were students of the Ai Chun
( 愛羣 ) Girls School, the Chinan ( 暨南 ) and other
universities.
Upon learning of this, the students giving
lectures in Chapei together with a number of factory
workers in the vicinity of Robison Road, in all about some
600 persons, called at the Zau Ka Doo Branch of the Public
Safety Bureau at 1 p.m. the same day and submitted the
following demands:-
1) That the arrested students be released.
2) That the students' patriotic movement be protected.
3) That the persons responsible for the assault on students
be punished.
Colonel Tan Pao Zeu ( 譚葆壽 ), Chief of the
Branch Bureau, who received them, stated that the 6th
Branch Bureau had not despatched any policemen to arrest
students. This statement was not believed by the
people who insisted on searching the premises of the Branch
Bureau.
The people and the students rushed into the
Branch Bureau and as only 20 policemen were stationed in
the Bureau, Colonel Tan ordered non-resistance, as a
result of which two of the policemen were assaulted and
injured. Many windows were smashed by the people.
As none of the arrested students were found on
the premises, the people took Colonel Tan out of the Branch
Bureau and marched off with him towards the Woo Kwoh Zang
( 五角場 ), Jessfield Road. Colonel Tan later effected
his escape to the Pao Kong Ziang ( 宝康祥 ) Cigarette
Shop, No.1258 Jessfield Road, but the crowd shouting
"assault him" went into the shop and assaulted Colonel
Tan who was slightly injured, despite the efforts of some
of the students of Chinan University to make the people
desist.
In the meantime, four police vans of Bubbling
Well Station had arrived and the Settlement Police dispersed
the crowd and effected the release of Colonel Tan who
was later escorted to Bubbling Well Station in a police
van.
During the disturbances Chen Yoeh Ching ( 陳玉卿 ),
Chinese policeman No.2503 of Bubbling Well Station, was
deprived of his pistol.
Upon being informed of the disturbances, the
Headquarters of the Public Safety Bureau detailed two
squads of policemen to various points in Zau Ka Doo.
Detectives and policemen of the Settlement Authorities
also rendered assistance.

1月27日《立報》：

学生在西区制造骚乱

日前，约20组学生在曹家渡、极司菲尔路（Jessfield Road）、罗别根路（Robison Road）附近及闸北一带向民众发表演讲。演讲者还分发传单，并在街道张贴标语。
1月26日上午7时，在罗别根路与胶州路（Kiaochow Roads）附近，包括5名女生在内的19人被捕。他们大多是爱羣女中、暨南大学及其他大学的学生。
获悉此事后，在闸北演讲的学生连同罗别根路附近的一些工厂工人，共计约600人，于当日下午1时前往公安局曹家渡分局，提出以下要求：
1) 释放被捕学生。
2) 保护学生的爱国运动。
3) 惩办殴打学生的责任人。
接待他们的分局局长谭葆寿上校表示，第六分局并未派遣警察逮捕学生。这一说法未获民众相信，他们坚持要搜查分局办公处所。
民众和学生冲进分局，由于局内仅有20名警察驻守，谭上校下令不予抵抗，结果导致两名警察被殴打受伤。许多窗户被民众砸碎。
因在局内未发现任何被捕学生，民众将谭上校带出分局，挟持他沿极司菲尔路向五角场方向行进。谭上校后来逃至极司菲尔路1258号宝康祥烟纸店，但高喊“打他”的人群涌入店内殴打了谭上校，致其受轻伤，尽管暨南大学的一些学生努力劝阻民众停止暴力。
与此同时，静安寺巡捕房的四辆警车抵达，租界警察驱散了人群并解救了谭上校，随后用警车将其护送至静安寺巡捕房。
在骚乱期间，静安寺巡捕房华警第2503号陈玉卿的配枪被夺。
公安局总部获悉骚乱情况后，抽调两队警察前往曹家渡各要点。租界当局的侦探和警察也提供了协助。

After 5 p.m. Colonel Tan returned to the Branch

discussed measures for the maintenance of peace and order.
In the morning, students delivered lectures

persons were arrested. It is stated that amongst the

Lih Pao dated Jan.27:

THE NEW CHIEF OF THE MILITARY COURT AT LUNGHWА

Tao Pah Chuen (陶百川), ex-Chief of the
Military Court of the Woosung-Shanghai Garrison Commissioner's
Headquarters, tendered his resignation in November last
year.
It is understood that the vacancy will be
filled by Loh Ching Sz (陸京士). A petition to
this effect has been approved by General Chiang Kai Shek,
Chairman of the Military Commission.

Min Pao and other local newspapers -

OPPOSITION TO THE COLLECTION OF TAXES ON SULPHUR, SALTPETER
AND ACID BY THE SALT GABELLE

Upon learning that the Salt Gabelle has
refused to exempt the collection of taxes on sulphur,
saltpeter and acid, various local industrial bodies
have decided to convene within the next few days a
joint meeting of representatives dealing in these
materials to consider the matter.
At a meeting held by the Shanghai Chemical
Industry Company Owners Association, it was decided
to oppose unanimously the collection of any charges on
sulphur and acid other than the legal import and
export taxes.
According to Shia Siao Tso (謝筱初),
member of the Chinese Chamber of Commerce and General
Manager of the Hwa Feng Chemical Industry Company,
Ling Kong Hua (林孔華), Yue Tso Ding (俞佐庭), Doo
Yuet Seng, etc., members of the Board of Directors of
the Hwa Feng Company have been selected to open
negotiations with the Government.

反对盐务稽核所征收硫磺、硝石和酸类税款

获悉盐务稽核所拒绝免除硫磺、硝石和酸类的税款征收后，本地各工业团体决定在未来几天内召开经营这些材料的代表联席会议，以审议此事。

Ta Mei Wan Pao and other local newspapers:
ACTIVITIES OF SHANGHAI UNIVERSITY AND MIDDLE SCHOOL
STUDENTS.

In order to arouse the patriotism of the
people, students of local universities and middle schools
recently formed propaganda groups to conduct propaganda
along the Nanking-Shanghai Railway. On January 20,
students of Fudan University left for Nanziang and on
the following day, students of the Great China University,
the Dah Dong University, the Chiao Tung University, the
Law College and the Arts College left for the same place.
About 100 students held a meeting at the
Nanziang Vocational Middle School, at which it was
decided to form a group to be named "The Propaganda
Group of Students of Shanghai Universities and Middle
Schools for National Salvation". The Group will have
a section of three squads, and each squad will be divided
into three units.
After conducting propaganda among the people
on the afternoon of January 21, the students proceeded
to Kating on the following day for the same purpose.
On January 23, they left for Taichang and on January 24
they proceeded to Quinsan.
It is reported that these students are now
on their way to Soochow.

China Evening News and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):
THE STATUS OF THE FOREIGN WIFE OF A CHINESE CITIZEN

The Judicial Yuan explains that when a
foreign woman becomes the wife of a Chinese and secures
Chinese citizenship through proper procedure, her Chinese
nationality is not lost even should she divorce her
husband.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs has notified
its Legations, Embassies and Consulates in foreign
countries of this explanation.

《大美晚报》及其他本地报纸：
上海大中学校学生活动。

为了唤起民众的爱国热情，本地大学和中学的学生最近组成宣传队，沿京沪铁路线进行宣传。1月20日，复旦大学学生前往南翔，次日，大夏大学、大同大学、交通大学、法学院和文学院的学生也前往同一地点。
约100名学生在南翔职业中学举行会议，决定成立一个名为“上海大中学校学生救国宣传团”的组织。该团下设三个大队，每个大队再分为三个分队。
1月21日下午在民众中进行宣传后，学生们次日前往嘉定进行同样的活动。1月23日，他们前往太仓，1月24日前往昆山。
据报道，这些学生目前正在前往苏州途中。

中国公民外籍妻子的身份问题

司法院解释称，外国女子成为中国公民之妻并通过正当程序取得中国国籍后，即使与丈夫离婚，其中国国籍亦不丧失。
外交部已将此解释通知其驻外各国的公使馆、大使馆和领事馆。

Three different kinds of leaflets bearing anti-Government
and anti-Japanese slogans were found at the scene of the
demonstration. The arrested persons, fourteen male and
five female of the student and artisan class, were taken
to the Jessfield Branch Bureau and subsequently removed
to the Headquarters of the Public Safety Bureau.
Instigated by elements of various kinds, including
the loafer type, a large crowd assembled on Robison Road
and proceeded towards Jessfield. At Brenan Place the crowd
attempted to demonstrate and several further arrests were
made by the Public Safety Bureau. Following these arrests
the mob became infuriated and succeeded in overwhelming the
Police of the Jessfield Branch Bureau and secured Col. Tan
Bo Shou with the intention of holding him as hostage for the
release of the arrested persons. In the meantime, following
an urgent request from Col. Tan, a squad of Police from
Bubbling Well proceeded to the scene and eventually succeeded
in rescuing him. During the melee a Chinese constable of
the Municipal Police was severely assaulted and had his
pistol taken from him. The throwing of missiles was also
indulged in by the mob. The Municipal Police were successful
in dispersing the crowd and order was finally restored about
2 p.m.

在示威现场发现了三种带有反政府和反日标语的传单。被捕者为14名男性和5名女性，属学生和工匠阶层，被带往极司菲尔路分局，随后被移送至公安局总部。
受各类分子（包括游手好闲之徒）的煽动，一大群人在罗别根路聚集并向极司菲尔路进发。在布伦南里（Brenan Place），人群试图示威，公安局又逮捕了数人。在这些逮捕行动之后，暴徒变得愤怒，成功冲垮了极司菲尔路分局的警察防线，并控制了谭葆寿上校，意图将其作为人质以换取被捕者的释放。与此同时，应谭上校的紧急请求，一队静安寺警察赶赴现场，最终成功将其救出。在混战中，一名工部局华籍巡捕遭到严重殴打，配枪被夺。暴徒还投掷石块等杂物。工部局警察成功驱散了人群，秩序终于在下午2时左右恢复。

Waung Yung Hao said to him:- "Mr Hu Kyung
Kwei wants a further gratuity of $40. In this way, your
case will succeed".
The shoemaker now realized that he had been
deceived and filed a criminal prosecution against Waung
and Hu in the 1st Shanghai Special District Court.
At 3 p.m. January 21, Judge Yang Zien Chong
(楊全昌) heard the case. The Shanghai Municipal
Police is paying close attention to the case and detailed
a stenographer to take down a report of the proceedings.
Waung Yung Hao failed to appear, and Judge
Yang Zien Chong was very angry and decided to issue a
warrant for the arrest of Waung.
As the shoemaker produced the receipts which
were in the handwriting of Hu Kyung Kwei, Judge Yang
ordered Hu to write something in order to check the writing.
Hu attempted to refuse saying that the papers
presented by the shoemaker were not the receipts for the
payment of the money.
Judge Yang became angry and said in a loud
voice, "Write and let me see your writing". Hu then
wrote.
After comparing the writing, Judge Yang
remanded the case till January 30. Hu Kyung Kwei was
ordered to find a bail of $200.
Hu Kyung Kwei was very discouraged. His
lawyer bailed him out.
During the trial, the shoemaker said: "We
addressed Hu Kyung Kwei as 'Lord Hu'" and during the
proceedings he continued to address Hu Kyung Kwei as
"Lord Hu".

王荣浩（Waung Yung Hao，音译）对他说：“胡景贵（Hu Kyung Kwei，音译）先生想要另外40美元的酬金。这样，你的案子就能胜诉。”
这位鞋匠此时意识到自己受骗了，遂在上海第一特区地方法院对王和胡提起刑事诉讼。
1月21日下午3时，杨全昌法官审理此案。上海公共租界工部局警务处正密切关注该案，并指派一名速记员记录诉讼过程。
王荣浩未出庭，杨全昌法官非常愤怒，决定签发逮捕王的拘票。
由于鞋匠出示了由胡景贵手写的收据，杨法官命令胡写些字以核对笔迹。
胡试图拒绝，称鞋匠出示的文件并非付款收据。
杨法官大怒，大声说道：“写！让我看看你的字迹。”胡于是写了字。
比对笔迹后，杨法官将案件延期至1月30日审理。胡景贵被责令缴纳200美元保释金。
胡景贵非常沮丧。他的律师为他办理了保释。
在庭审期间，鞋匠说：“我们称呼胡景贵为‘胡老爷’”，且在诉讼过程中他继续称呼胡景贵为“胡老爷”。

学生聚集南京之余波
1月15日在南京举行的全国学生代表及校长集会，不仅在中国政治史上，而且在我国学生运动史上，都是前所未有的事件。毫无疑问，此次集会对我国的政治行政和文化认知产生了相当深远的影响。
兹对这些影响分析如下：
首先，此次集会的召开主要归因于救国学生运动，该运动在

January 23, 1936. Morning Translation.

propagated and developed during the whole of the last
month. The despair and anxiety of the youths over the
existing political situation was the principal and essential
cause of this movement. In fact, ever since the September
18th Incident, the Central Government has frequently
declared that it had already decided upon a definite plan
to deal with foreign affairs, but this plan was never
announced. In the meantime our territory has been invaded
inch by inch and Japanese aggression has been intensified
to such a point that it was not surprising that the Hopei
and Charhar Incidents had arisen. In their despair over
the policy of Government, the majority of the students
were compelled to resort to a movement such as that which
was launched last month to deal with present events.
We are convinced that the students'
movement is a noble movement. The Government should dispel
all causes for misunderstanding with a view to giving
full satisfaction to the representatives of the students
so that they can rely upon the Government in all foreign
affairs.
In the second place, the students' movement
may be said to have been due to the fact that the students'
plan for the preservation of the country was of an extremist
nature and was opposed by the Government leaders who desired
to maintain the status quo. The telegrams and the letters
which were dispatched by the Students Federations were
intended to urge the Government to adopt a strong policy
when dealing with foreign affairs. The youths to-day
are doing their utmost, whilst the grown-ups are cool.
The only thing for us to do is to decide upon a plan which
will enable us to obtain results, but this requires
courage. The Central Government has, on the one hand,
decided upon a definite plan which will enable it to attain
its aim for national salvation, while, on the other, it
has manifested its sincerity by inviting the students to
reveal their complaints.
In the third place, the students, during
the past years, have been deprived of freedom of assembly
in their schools. This act of oppression was frequently
carried out by the principals of the schools despite the
justification of the demand made by the students. The
students' movement which developed rapidly this time in
spite of all restrictions is the direct consequence of
a former reaction. The traditional respect of students
towards teachers disappeared a long time ago. At the
present time, the students can organize federations since
the Government has asked for their views as regards the
preservation of the nation. The foolish actions of the
principals of the schools have been counteracted, thereby
enabling the political and cultural administration of our
country to enter upon a new phase.

过去整个月中蔓延并发展。青年人对当前政治局势的绝望和焦虑是这一运动的主要和根本原因。事实上，自九一八事变以来，中央政府虽频繁宣称已制定处理外交事务的确切计划，但该计划从未公布。与此同时，我国领土寸土被侵，日本侵略加剧至如此地步，以致冀察事变的发生并不令人意外。多数学生对政府政策感到绝望，被迫采取如上个月发起的那类运动来应对当前事态。
我们要坚信，学生运动是一场高尚的运动。政府应消除所有造成误解的原因，以期充分满足学生代表的要求，使他们在所有外交事务上能够信赖政府。
其次，可以说学生运动的发生，是因为学生的救国计划具有极端性质，遭到了希望维持现状的政府领导人的反对。各学生联合会发出的电报和信件，旨在敦促政府在处理外交事务时采取强硬政策。当今青年人在竭尽全力，而成年人却态度冷淡。我们唯一要做的是决定一个能取得成果的计划，但这需要勇气。中央政府一方面决定了能够实现其救国目标的确切计划，另一方面通过邀请学生陈述不满来表现其诚意。
第三，在过去几年中，学生在学校里的集会自由被剥夺。尽管学生的要求合理，但这种压迫行为经常由学校校长实施。这次学生运动不顾所有限制迅速发展，是此前反应的直接后果。学生对老师的传统尊重早已消失。目前，既然政府就救国问题征求他们的意见，学生可以组织联合会。各校校长的愚蠢行径已被抵消，从而使我国的政治和文化管理进入一个新阶段。

MAINICHI

CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY TO INSTIGATE CHINESE WORKERS
OF JAPANESE COTTON MILLS TO GO ON STRIKE WORK

It is reported that the remnants
of the Central Japanese Communist Party are being suppressed
by the Osaka Police. The Japanese communists are
maintaining touch with Soviet Russia through the Chinese
communist party.
The Chinese communisty party in
Shanghai is losing its influence since the wholesale
arrest of communists last year. But now they are about
to become active again and are directing the students'
movement against the autonomy in the North.
According to the Second Section
of the Japanese Consular Police, communists through-out
the world are becoming active again because of the three
communist anniversaries in January. They are planning
to instigate strikes in mills and factories. In Shanghai
they are especially endeavouring to bring about strikes
of workers of various Japanese mills in the Western
District at the end of the lunar year.
Only a few members of the
Korean communist party now remain they are without any
influence. For this reason, they cannot organize strikes
or demonstrations but are resorting to the distribution
of handbills.

《每日新闻》

中国共产党煽动日本棉厂华工罢工

据报道，日本共产党中央残余势力正受到大阪警方的镇压。日本共产党人正通过中国共产党与苏俄保持联系。
上海的中国共产党自去年大规模逮捕共产党人以来，影响力正在减弱。但现在他们即将再次活跃起来，并指导针对华北自治的学生运动。
据日本领事警察第二课称，由于一月份有三个共产主义纪念日，世界各地的共产党人再次变得活跃。他们正策划在工厂和车间煽动罢工。在上海，他们特别致力于在农历年底引发西区各日本工厂工人的罢工。
朝鲜共产党现在仅剩少数成员，已无任何影响力。因此，他们无法组织罢工或示威，转而采取散发传单的方式。

The Shanghai Municipality Bicycle Repair and Hire
Trade Association held a meeting at 3 p.m. January 21 in

processional order along Fong Zia Road, Chung Hwa Road,
Woo Ping Road to Rue Captain Rabier (boundary between
Chinese Controlled territory and the French Concession)
where the West Gate Branch of the Public Safety Bureau is
situated. About about 4.30 p.m. police attached to the
West Gate Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety attempted
to persuade them to disperse but without success. The
police then began to disperse the students by force. The
crowd resented this and a free fight developed. Order
was eventually restored at 7.30 p.m. During the melee,
four policemen and the chauffeur of the police van were
injured, the latter seriously. A number of the rioters
also received minor injuries and seven were taken into
custody.
pages.zh:
1936年2月10日。

- 2 -

他们高呼反日口号，表达反对汉奸的情绪。随后，宣传员和一些同情者组成队伍，沿永兴路、虬江路和宝山路行进至北站。途中发表了谴责日本帝国主义的演讲，并高呼类似性质的口号。他们于晚上7点左右解散。

1936年2月9日下午3时30分，约100名来自上海西区和南市各大学及中学的学生在圣凯瑟琳桥集合。他们就救国运动发表露天演讲，随后列队沿方斜路、中华路、武平路行进至拉贝里船长路（Rue Captain Rabier，华界与法租界交界处），市公安局西门分局即位于此处。下午4时30分左右，市公安局西门分局的警察试图劝散他们，但未成功。警方随后开始强行驱散学生。人群对此表示不满，发生混战。秩序最终于晚上7时30分恢复。在混战中，四名警察和警车司机受伤，后者伤势严重。多名肇事者也受轻伤，七人被拘留。

pages.en:
February 10, 1936.

-3-

During the procession the students carried a banner
inscribed "Shanghai University and Middle School Student
National Salvation Propaganda Group" and two canvas flags
showing maps of China similar to those exhibited by
processionists in Chapei on February 8.

Employees of local Chinese banks to form national salvation
association

About three hundred Chinese employees of local Chinese
banks held a meeting in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's
Association, 480 Thibet Road, at 10.45 a.m. February 9
and decided to organize a national salvation association.
Speeches denouncing the weakness of the Nanking Government
and Japanese imperialism in general were delivered by the
following persons :-

Pan Niang-yao (潘仰), Chief of the Guidance
Department of the Chung Hwa Vocational Education
Institute, 80 Route Voyron, and a senior employee
of the Joint Savings Society, 170 Bubbling Well
Road.

Li Kung-poh (李公樸), principal of the Liang Zai
Supplementary School, Continental Emporium
Building, Nanking Road.

Sung Chun-su (沈儒), Dean of the Shanghai College
of Law.

Wong Zao-dz (王造時), ex-professor of the Kwang Hwa
University.

The meeting terminated at 12.15 p.m.

New Chinese daily newspaper to be published on February 12

A new Chinese daily newspaper to be known as the "Zung
Pao" (誠報) will commence publication on February 12, 1936.
This paper will take the place of the "Chan Pao" (晨報), the
publication of which was banned by order of the Government
on January 23 (Vide I.R. 24-28/1/36).
pages.zh:
1936年2月10日。

-3-

在游行过程中，学生们举着一面横幅，上面写着“上海大中学校学生救国宣传团”，还有两面帆布旗帜，上面绘有中国地图，与2月8日闸北游行队伍所展示的旗帜相似。

华商银行职员组织救国会

2月9日上午10时45分，约三百名本地华商银行的中国籍职员在西藏路480号宁波同乡会举行会议，决定组织一个救国会。以下人士发表了谴责南京政府软弱及日本帝国主义的演讲：

潘仰（Pan Niang-yao），法租界霞飞路80号中华职业教育社指导部主任，兼静安寺路170号四行储蓄会高级职员。

李公樸（Li Kung-poh），南京路大陆商场良友补习学校校长。

沈儒（Sung Chun-su），上海法学院院长。

王造時（Wong Zao-dz），前光华大学教授。

会议于下午12时15分结束。

新中文日报将于2月12日出版

一份名为《诚报》（Zung Pao）的新中文日报将于1936年2月12日开始出版。该报将取代《晨报》（Chan Pao），后者已被政府命令于1月23日禁止出版（参见 I.R. 24-28/1/36）。

pages.en:
D.7108.

January 20, 1936.

Delegation of representatives of scholastic circles
return to Shanghai from Nanking

The delegation formed by local Chinese university and
middle school principals and representatives of the whole
body of students in Shanghai, which proceeded to Nanking
on January 13 and 14 for the purpose of attending a
conference convened by General Chiang Kai Shek in connection
with the autonomy movement in North China, returned to
Shanghai by train in three parties, the first arriving at
2.20 p.m. January 18, the second at 11 p.m. January 18 and
the third at 7 a.m. January 19.

The thirty-five representatives of students in
Kwangtung who arrived in Shanghai en route to Nanking on
January 9, returned to Kwangtung in the s.s. "Hai Tseng"
at 8 a.m. January 20.
pages.zh:
D.7108.

1936年1月20日。

学界代表团从南京返回上海

由上海本地各大学和中学校长以及上海全体学生代表组成的代表团，曾于1月13日和14日前往南京，参加蒋介石将军就华北自治运动召开的会议，该代表团分三批乘火车返回上海，第一批于1月18日下午2时20分抵达，第二批于1月18日晚上11时抵达，第三批于1月19日上午7时抵达。

1月9日途经上海前往南京的35名广东学生代表，于1月20日上午8时乘坐“海澄”轮（s.s. "Hai Tseng"）返回广东。

pages.en:
January 17, 1936.
Afternoon Translation.
（印：DEPT. OF INFO.）

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

KIANGSU VOCATIONAL MIDDLE SCHOOL ORDERED TO CLOSE.

Having ascertained that the Kiangsu Vocational Middle School (江苏职业学校), No. 106 Robison Road, is not registered and that its organization is not very sound, the local Bureau of Education has instructed this school to cease functioning. The assistance of the Bureau of Public Safety will be sought to enforce the order.

China Times published the following editorial on January 16 :-

SOME QUESTIONS FOR STUDENTS.

In reply to a summons from General Chiang Kai Shek, President of the Executive Yuan, representatives of university and secondary school principals and students from every part of the country are now at Nanking to express their views on the salvation of the country and at the same time to hear an explanation of the policy of the government in the present situation.

This meeting, which is bringing together the government leader, the tutors and the future masters of the country in a hall to exchange views on national salvation and reconstruction, is not to be regarded as an ordinary affair.

While this meeting of students is taking place in Nanking, we wish to say a few words to their representatives :-

(1) What is the cause of the national crisis?
(2) Why has the situation become aggravated since the September 18 Incident?
(3) What is the cause of the Shanghai and Tangku Pacts and their consequences?
(4) Why does China waver between an attitude of peace and war? What will be the consequences of peace and war?
(5) If the students were in the place of the government leaders, what would they desire the people to do?
(6) Why have Cheng Hsiao Su and Ying Ju Keng, who had received a high education, become traitors?

If the students' representatives can reply to these questions, they will be able to explain these questions to their comrades on their return from Nanking, otherwise their trip to the Capital would have been fruitless.

The Iron News (铁报), a mosquito newspaper, published the following article on January 10 :-

HAI ALAI MAKES $2,000,000 A YEAR.

With the exception of the world renowned Monte Carlo there is no other open gambling country in the world.
Under the special influence of the Foreign

1936年1月17日。
下午译文。
（印：情报处 DEPT. OF INFO.）

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

江苏职业学校被令关闭。

经查实，罗宾森路106号的江苏职业学校（Kiangsu Vocational Middle School）未注册，且其组织架构不甚健全，本地教育局已指令该校停止运作。将寻求公共安全局的协助以执行该命令。

《字林西报》（China Times）于1月16日发表如下社论：

向学生提出的几个问题。

应行政院院长蒋介石将军的召唤，来自全国各地的大学和中学校长及学生代表目前正在南京，就救国问题表达观点，并听取政府对当前局势政策的解释。

这次会议将政府领袖、导师和国家的未来主人聚集一堂，交流关于救国和重建的意见，不应被视为普通事务。

当这次学生会议在南京进行时，我们想对他们的代表说几句话：

(1) 民族危机的原因是什么？
(2) 为什么自九一八事变以来局势日益恶化？
(3) 《淞沪协定》和《塘沽协定》的原因及其后果是什么？
(4) 为什么中国在和平与战争的态度之间摇摆不定？和平与战争的后果将是什么？
(5) 如果学生处于政府领导人的位置，他们希望人民做什么？
(6) 为什么受过高等教育的程孝苏（Cheng Hsiao Su）和应菊庚（Ying Ju Keng）变成了汉奸？

如果学生代表能够回答这些问题，他们就能在从南京回来后向同伴解释这些问题，否则他们的首都之行将是徒劳的。

小报《铁报》（The Iron News）于1月10日刊登了以下文章：

海逸赌场年入两百万美元。

除了世界闻名的蒙特卡洛外，世界上没有其他公开赌博的国家。
在外国的特殊影响下

January 17, 1936. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram):

CHIANG KAI SHEK RECEIVES REPRESENTATIVES OF STUDENTS

At 2.30 p.m. January 16 the 300 representatives
of presidents, principals and students of colleges and
high schools of various places gathered at the Officers
Moral Endeavour Association (勵志社 ) to attend the
giving of instructions by General Chiang Kai Shek, President
of the Executive Yuan. The Minister and the Vice
Minister of Education, the officials of the Reception
Office etc. were in attendance.
At 3 p.m. General Chiang Kai Shek arrived at
the Association. Following an address made by Wong Shih
Chih (王世杰), Minister of Education, General Chiang
Kai Shek delivered a speech the main points of which were:-
1) The international situation during the past few years
and the diplomatic negotiations between China and
Japan are known to all.
2) The Government will not conclude any agreement that
impairs the territorial integrity and the sovereign
rights of China, nor will it make any secret pact.
The people may rest assured of this.
3) The strength of a nation depends upon its culture
and economics. All school principals and students
should observe discipline and accept full responsibility
for the fate of the country. They should not be led
astray by others into damaging school premises and
committing breaches of the peace and order. The
national crisis will pass if the people throughout
the country will remain faithful to the country and
conduct orderly struggles.

At 7 p.m. January 16, the representatives were
entertained to dinner at the Officers Moral Endeavour
Association by the Minister of Education who gave an
explanation of the following points:-
1) The educational policy during this extraordinary period.
2) The rumoured removal to the South of the colleges
and schools established by the Government at Tientsin
and Peiping.
3) The rumoured revision of textbooks.
4) The suspension of studies.
The Minister also gave a clear explanation of
the attitude of the Government.

Under the guidance of the Reception Office, the
representatives will make a tour of the city at 7 a.m.
January 17.
At 3 p.m. the representatives will pay their
respects at the tombs of the deceased officers and men of
the Nationalist Army and of the officers and men who had
died during the January 28 War.
The giving of instructions by General Chiang Kai
Shek will terminate on January 17. The representatives
of presidents, high school principals and students will
leave Nanking for their respective schools on January 18.
The Reception Office has requested the Ministry
of Education to make arrangements with the Ministries of
Communications and Railways to provide trains and steamers
to convey the representatives to their respective places
free of charge.

1936年1月17日。上午译文。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：

蒋介石接见学生代表

1月16日下午2时30分，各地300名大学和中学校长及学生代表聚集在励志社（Officers Moral Endeavour Association），聆听行政院院长蒋介石将军的训示。教育部长、副部长及接待处官员等出席。
下午3时，蒋介石将军抵达励志社。在教育部长王世杰（Wong Shih Chih）致辞后，蒋介石将军发表演讲，其主要要点如下：
1) 过去几年的国际形势以及中日外交谈判众所周知。
2) 政府不会签订任何损害中国领土完整和主权的协议，也不会订立任何秘密条约。民众可对此放心。
3) 国家的力量取决于其文化和经济。所有校长和学生都应遵守纪律，对国家命运承担全部责任。不应受他人误导去破坏校舍和扰乱治安秩序。如果全国人民忠于国家并进行有序的斗争，民族危机将会过去。

1月16日晚上7时，教育部长在励志社宴请代表，并就以下几点作出解释：
1) 非常时期的教育政策。
2) 关于政府在天津和北平设立的院校南迁的谣言。
3) 关于修订教科书的谣言。
4) 停课问题。
部长还清楚地解释了政府的态度。

在接待处的引导下，代表们将于1月17日上午7时游览城市。
下午3时，代表们将谒祭国民革命军阵亡将士及在一·二八战争中牺牲的官兵陵墓。
蒋介石将军的训示将于1月17日结束。各大学校长、中学校长和学生代表将于1月18日离开南京返回各自学校。
接待处已请求教育部与交通部及铁道部安排，免费提供火车和轮船将代表送往各地。

pages.en:
January 17, 1936.

- 2 -

Students Activities in connection with the Autonomy
Movement in North China

During the afternoon of January 16, two small groups
of girl students delivered open air lectures in Nantao and
the City opposing the autonomy movement in North China.
They also distributed handbills purporting to emanate from
the Shanghai Women's National Salvation Federation. The
handbills denounce the "East Hopei Autonomous Anti-Communist
Council" as a puppet government and praise the students who
staged demonstrations in opposition to the new movement.
The handbills also urge all females to join the Federation.

Students of the Fun Tan University, Kiangwan, continued
their anti autonomy propaganda movement during the afternoon
of January 16 by delivering open-air lectures in Woosung.

Miscellaneous

Rent Reduction Movement

At 2 p.m. January 16, an agent of the Rent Reduction
Federation of All Tenants in Shanghai, 173 Chung Ka Shek
Road, Chapei, was endeavouring to collect subscription fees
from tenants of Lane 239, Wuchow Road, when he was arrested
at the request of a rent collector in the employ of the
Shanghai Land Investment Company, the owners of the property.
On enquiries being made by Police from Kashing Road
Station, it was found that no offence had been committed
and the man was released.
pages.zh:
1936年1月17日。

- 2 -

与华北自治运动有关的学生活动

1月16日下午，两组女学生在南市和老城厢进行露天演讲，反对华北自治运动。她们还散发了声称出自上海妇女救国联合会的传单。传单谴责“冀东防共自治委员会”为傀儡政府，并赞扬举行示威反对新运动的学生。传单还呼吁所有女性加入该联合会。

江湾复旦（Fun Tan）大学的学生于1月16日下午继续在吴淞进行露天演讲，开展反自治宣传活动。

杂项

减租运动

1月16日下午2时，闸北中山路173号上海全体租户减租联合会的一名代理人，在向梧州路239弄的租户收取会费时，被该物业业主上海地产公司（Shanghai Land Investment Company）的一名收租员要求逮捕。经嘉善路站警察查询，发现并未犯罪，该男子被释放。

pages.en:
January 16, 1936.    Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

CHIANG KAI SHEK RECEIVES REPRESENTATIVES OF STUDENTS

On the morning of January 15 the 300 representatives
of presidents, principals and students of colleges and high
schools of various places, who had come to Nanking to
attend the giving of instructions by General Chiang Kai
Shek, President of the Executive Yuan, paid their respects
at the mausoleum of the late Dr. Sun Yat Sen. At noon
a tiffin party was given by General Chiang Kai Shek at
the Officers Moral Endeavour Association (勵志社), at
which the representatives in question, the Vice-Minister
of Education and several officials of the Reception Office
were present.
At 3 p.m. 89 college presidents and 75 high
school principals were received by General Chiang Kai Shek
at the Officers Moral Endeavour Association.
Ho Sheh Tse (胡適之) and other representatives
submitted the views of educational circles of various
places on the national crisis and the patriotic movement
of students. They expressed the hope that the Government
would preserve the territorial integrity and sovereign
rights of China and that adequate measures would be devised
by the Government, in conjunction with educational circles,
to handle the students patriotic movement and to train
these youths for service to the country.
At 3 p.m. January 15 the 140 representatives of
students of various places were received at the auditorium
of the Executive Yuan. Oong Wen Hao (翁文灝), Secretary-
General of the Executive Yuan, presided.
The following are the main points submitted by
some 50 of the students representatives:-
1) Diplomatic Affairs.
Diplomatic affairs should be made public and the diplomatic
policy be determined. The territorial integrity and
sovereign rights of China should be preserved.
2) Home Affairs.
Chinese traitors should be severely punished and the
Government should pay attention to the critical situation
in East Hopei and North China.
3) Educational Affairs.
Education during the period of national crisis should
be clearly defined. Textbooks should not be recklessly
amended. The physical training of students should be
intensified.

At 8 a.m. January 16 the Reception Office will
prepare cars in which the representatives will tour the
Capital. At 3 p.m. they will attend the giving of
instructions by General Chiang Kai Shek. At 7 p.m. the
Secretary-General of the Central Kuomintang Headquarters
and the Minister of Education will entertain them to dinner
at the Officers Moral Endeavour Association.
Several tens of letters containing views of various
representatives have been received by the Reception Office
up to January 15.

As a result of the students trouble at Canton,
Tseu Loo (魯), President of Chung San (中山)
University, has tendered his resignation to the Ministry of
Education. It is understood that the Ministry has sent
a telegram asking him to remain at his post.
pages.zh:
1936年1月16日。上午译文。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

蒋介石接见学生代表

1月15日上午，前来南京聆听行政院院长蒋介石将军训示的各地300名大学和中学校长及学生代表，谒祭了孙中山博士陵墓。中午，蒋介石将军在励志社（Officers Moral Endeavour Association）举行午宴，上述代表、教育部副部长及接待处数名官员出席。
下午3时，蒋介石将军在励志社接见了89位大学校长和75位中学校长。
胡适之（Ho Sheh Tse）及其他代表提交了各地教育界对民族危机和学生爱国运动的看法。他们希望政府保持中国的领土完整和主权，并希望政府与教育界共同制定适当措施，处理学生的爱国运动并培养这些青年为国家服务。
1月15日下午3时，各地140名学生代表在行政院礼堂受到接见。行政院秘书长翁文灝（Oong Wen Hao）主持。
以下是约50名学生代表提交的主要要点：
1) 外交事务。
外交事务应公开，并确定外交政策。应保持中国的领土完整和主权。
2) 内政。
应严惩汉奸，政府应关注冀东和华北的危急局势。
3) 教育事务。
应明确界定民族危机时期的教育。不应随意修改教科书。应加强学生的体育训练。

1月16日上午8时，接待处将准备车辆供代表游览首都。下午3时，他们将参加蒋介石将军的训示。晚上7时，国民党中央党部秘书长和教育部长将在励志社宴请他们。
截至1月15日，接待处已收到数十封包含各位代表意见的信件。

由于广州的学生骚乱，中山大学（Chung San University）校长鲁（Tseu Loo）已向教育部提出辞呈。据悉，教育部已发电报要求他留任。

pages.en:
D.7108
January 16, 1936.

Chinese Seamen's National Salvation Federation - dissolved

In accordance with an order from the Special Kuomintang
Delegate for Seamen's Affairs, the Chinese Seamen's National
Salvation Federation was dissolved on January 15, 1936. This
Federation was formed by local seamen's associations on
January 8, 1936 with an office in the China Steamer Engineers'
Federation, Room 505, No.263 Min Kuo Road, Nantao.

Student activities in connection with autonomy movement
in North China

Students of the Fuh Tan University, Kiangwan, continued
their anti-autonomy propaganda movement during the after-
noon of January 15 by delivering open-air lectures in
Woosung and Kiangwan.

D.7108
1936年1月16日。

中国海员救国联合会——解散

根据国民党海员事务特别代表的命令，中国海员救国联合会于1936年1月15日解散。该联合会由本地各海员团体于1936年1月8日组建，办事处设在南市民国路263号中国轮船司机联合会505室。

与华北自治运动有关的学生活动

江湾复旦大学的學生在1月15日下午继续开展反自治宣传运动，在吴淞和江湾举行露天演讲。

pages.en:
January 15, 1936.    3,    Morning Translation.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

FIRST SPECIAL DISTRICT COURT ADOPTS THE ANTI-OPIUM AND
THE ANTI-NARCOTIC REGULATIONS

In compliance with the instructions of the
Ministry of Justice, the First Shanghai Special District
Court had originally intended to try opium and narcotic
cases under the Anti-Opium and the Anti-Narcotic
Regulations as from January 11. In view of the fact
that the officers of the Police Force are not yet familiar
with these two regulations, the S.M.C. still charged
offenders in opium and narcotic cases under the Articles
of the Criminal Code.
Subsequently, Kwok Yuin Kwei (郭云观),
President of the 1st Special District Court, instructed
the Judges in the criminal division to try opium and
narcotic cases under the Anti-Opium and the Anti-Narcotic
Regulations as from January 14 so as to facilitate the
anti-opium movement. Therefore, although the S.M.C. was
still charging offenders in opium and narcotic cases
under the Criminal Code, the Judges trying such cases
on the morning of January 14 announced that these cases
must be dealt with in accordance with the new regulations.
On January 13, the Court designated lawyers
to undertake the defence of opium offenders who were
unprovided with legal assistance. This practice will be
continued until further orders.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

LOANS AGAINST REAL ESTATE IN CHINESE CONTROLLED TERRITORY

Loans are issued by banks against real estate
in the foreign Settlements as security, but they do not
accept real estate outside the Settlements.
The Land Bureau of the Shanghai City Government,
in a letter to the Bankers' Association and the Native
Bankers Guild yesterday, pointed out that real estate
outside the foreign Settlements should also be accepted
as security against loans.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

CHIANG KAI SHEK TO RECEIVE STUDENTS REPRESENTATIVES
TO-DAY

The 40 representatives of presidents,
principals and students of various local colleges and
high schools left Shanghai by train at 8 a.m. yesterday
to attend the giving of instructions by General Chiang
Kai. The representatives of the college presidents
and high school principals are carrying with their letters
containing their views to be submitted to the Executive
Yuan.
Zung Tsi Zung (陳濟成), Chu Fu Zung (褚輔成),
Li Chao Kwei (黎照寰) and Lieu Hai Soo (劉海粟) left
for Nanking on the evening of January 13 and 14.

1936年1月15日。 3, 晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

第一特区法院采用禁烟禁毒条例

遵照司法部指令，上海第一特区地方法院原拟自1月11日起，依据《禁烟条例》和《禁毒条例》审理鸦片及毒品案件。鉴于警务处人员尚不熟悉这两项条例，工部局仍依据《刑法》条款对鸦片及毒品案件罪犯提起公诉。
随后，第一特区地方法院院长郭云观指示刑事庭法官，为便利禁烟运动，自1月14日起依据《禁烟条例》和《禁毒条例》审理鸦片及毒品案件。因此，虽然工部局仍依据《刑法》对鸦片及毒品案件罪犯提起公诉，但1月14日上午审理此类案件的法官宣布，这些案件必须按照新条例处理。
1月13日，法院指定律师为未聘请法律协助的鸦片案犯进行辩护。此做法将持续至另有命令为止。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

华界房地产抵押贷款

银行接受租界内房地产作为抵押发放贷款，但不接受租界外的房地产。
上海市政府地政局昨日致函银行业同业公会及钱业公会，指出租界外的房地产也应被接受为贷款抵押品。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

蒋介石今日接见学生代表

本地各大专院校及高中的校长、院长和学生代表共40人，于昨日上午8时乘火车离开上海，前往聆听蒋介石将军训示。各大专院校校长及高中院长代表携带载有其观点的信件，准备提交给行政院。
陈济成、褚辅成、黎照寰和刘海粟于1月13日和14日晚前往南京。

Yuan, will receive the representatives of various presidents,

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated Jan.14:

Futan University Students Deliver Open Air Lectures
in Chapei

On the morning of January 14 some eight students
of Futan University delivered open air lectures on
national salvation in various districts in Chapei with a
view to arousing public attention to the tense situation
in North China.
It is learned that the students of this
University will proceed to their respective native places

南京电报

行政院院长蒋介石将军将于1月15日接见各大专院校及高中的校长、院长和学生代表。

1月14日《大美晚报》：

复旦大学学生在闸北发表露天演讲

1月14日上午，约八名复旦大学学生在闸北各区发表关于救国的露天演讲，旨在引起公众对华北紧张局势的关注。
获悉，该校学生将在寒假期间返回各自家乡，开展救国宣传。

January 15, 1936. Morning Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

LEE LEE GARAGE TO SUSPEND OPERATIONS

Owing to business depression coupled with the increase in the cost of gasoline and severe competition, the Lee Lee (Ho Kee) Garage suspended operations yesterday.
150 chauffeurs and mechanics of the garage assembled at the head office yesterday seeking information.
It is said that the manager and the members of the staff of the this garage have all gone into hiding. It is learned that the garage has not paid the wages of its workers for three months.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE SEAMEN'S NATIONAL SALVATION FEDERATION

The National Salvation Federation promoted by the various Chinese seamen's bodies is an illegal body. At 9 a.m. yesterday, General Yang Fu, the Special Delegate of the Chinese Seamen's Tangpu, summoned the representatives of over ten seamen's bodies to his office at Chaokia Road, Nantao, when he spoke to them about the irregularity in the formation of the Federation for National Salvation, although he declared that he was in sympathy with their object.
The seamen's bodies have now voluntarily dissolved the Federation and will establish a proper organization.under the direction of the Tangpu.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE NEW PRESIDENT OF SECOND BRANCH OF KIANGSU HIGH COURT

Under the supervision of officials from the Ministry of Justice, Zee Vee Tseng (柴維案), President of the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court, will take oath of office at 10 a.m. January 16 at No. 191 North Chekiang Road.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE TELEPHONE QUESTION

Yesterday the Special District Telephone Committee sent a circular letter to the various public bodies in Shanghai asking them to protest energetically against the new system of collecting telephone rates according to the number of calls. The system has been approved by the Municipal Authorities of the International Settlement and the French Concession and will come into force on March 1, this year.

利利汽车行停业

由于生意萧条，加之汽油成本上涨及竞争激烈，利利（Ho Kee）汽车行于昨日停业。
该行150名司机和机修工昨日聚集在总管理处询问情况。
据说，该车行经理及全体员工均已躲藏起来。获悉，该车行已拖欠工人工资三个月。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

海员救国联合会

由各中国海员团体推动成立的救国联合会是一个非法组织。昨日上午9时，中国海员党部特别代表杨虎将军在南市曹家路办公室召见了十多个海员团体的代表，向他们指出成立救国联合会的程序违规，尽管他表示同情他们的目标。
目前，各海员团体已自愿解散该联合会，并将在党部指导下建立正式组织。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

江苏高等法院第二分院新任院长

在司法部官员监督下，江苏高等法院第二分院院长柴維案（音译）将于1月16日上午10时在浙江北路191号宣誓就职。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

电话问题

昨日，特区电话委员会向上海各公共团体发出通函，要求他们强烈抗议按通话次数收取电话费的新制度。该制度已获国际租界和法租界市政当局批准，将于今年3月1日生效。

'UNIVERSITY PROFESSORS' NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION' FORMED

A new body known as the "University Professors' National
Salvation Association" (各大学教授救國會) has been formed by ten
professors of local universitites under the leadership of Sung

Student activities

“大学教授救国会”成立

January 14, 1936.
Morning Translation.

Min Pao dated Jan.13

BAN ON SEAMEN'S NATIONAL SALVATION FEDERATION

The various bodies of Chinese seamen were greatly surprised at reading a report in certain newspapers on January 9 to the effect that certain seamen's bodies had formed a national salvation federation. They have petitioned the Seamen's Tangpu to conduct an investigation. This National Salvation Federation was regarded as illegal by the Seamen's Tangpu for it had omitted to submit a petition to the Tangpu for approval prior to its formation, nor had it made any report, for purposes of record, on its inauguration.
Various seamen's bodies deny having joined the Federation. It is understood that the Federation has been banned.

Sin Wan Pao (Peiping correspondence):

GENERAL SHIH YEU SAN'S NEW APPOINTMENT

Lieu Kya Leu (刘家骝), ex-Chief of Staff to the Garrison Commissioner's Headquarters, has been appointed Commissioner of the Tientsin Peace Preservation Corps, while Shih Yeu San (石友三) has been appointed Commissioner of the Peiping Peace Preservation Corps.
The district authorities have telegraphed the Central Authorities requesting them to cancel the order for Shih's arrest.
Shih Yeu San will come to Peiping from Tientsin to assume office as soon as the order for his arrest has been withdrawn.

Shun Pao (Swatow Correspondence) -

THE ACTIVITIES OF RONINS IN SOUTH CHINA

At 4 p.m. January 4, a boat laden with over one hundred bales of smuggled rice and beans was discovered near Chaoyang. The boat was taken to the wharf of the Teh Kee Company at Swatow and officers were detailed by the Smuggling Prevention Bureau to supervise the unloading of the rice and beans. In the evening more than ten ronins, armed with knives and axes, appeared at the wharf and assaulted the inspectors. They then cut the ropes of the boat with the intention of removing the vessel, but were prevented by the inspectors. The Bureau, upon being notified, sent fifty armed policemen who dispersed the ronins. All the smuggled goods in the boat were eventually taken to a granary.
On the following morning a certain ronin, claiming to be the owner of the smuggled goods, called on Siao Sung Zee, Director of the Bureau, and made several unreasonable demands. Lee Yoh Kun, a Staff Officer, and Lee Yuan Ho, the Mayor, were informed and they in turn made a report to the Kwangtung Provincial Government requesting the early return to Swatow of one Lee Han Vung to handle the affair.

1月13日《民报》

禁止海员救国联合会

各中国海员团体对1月9日某些报纸刊登的关于某些海员团体成立救国联合会的报道感到大为惊讶。他们已请愿海员党部进行调查。海员党部认为该救国联合会非法，因为它在成立前未向党部提交申请以获得批准，也未就其成立进行备案报告。
各海员团体否认加入该联合会。据悉，该联合会已被取缔。

《辛闻报》（北平通讯）：

石友三将军的新任命

原卫戍司令部参谋长刘家骝已被任命为天津保安总队队长，而石友三已被任命为北平保安总队队长。
地方当局已致电中央当局，请求撤销对石的逮捕令。
一旦逮捕令撤销，石友三将从天津前往北平就职。

《申报》（汕头通讯）-

华南浪人的活动

1月4日下午4时，在朝阳附近发现一艘装载有一百多包走私米豆的船只。该船被带至汕头德记公司码头，缉私局指派官员监督米豆卸货。当晚，十多名手持刀斧的浪人出现在码头，袭击检查员。随后他们割断船绳，意图将船移走，但被检查员阻止。缉私局接到通知后，派出五十名武装警察驱散了浪人。船上所有走私货物最终被运往仓库。
次日早晨，一名自称是走私货物所有者的浪人拜访了缉私局局长萧颂兹，并提出多项无理要求。此事已告知参谋李耀坤和市长李源浩，他们随即向广东省政府报告，请求尽快让李汉云返回汕头处理此事。
