The second speaker was Ho Shiang-ning, who urged all Chinese
women to unite in resisting aggression.

The following resolutions were then discussed and
passed :-

1. That the territorial integrity of China be protected.

2. That secret diplomacy be opposed and that all treaties
and agreements which would impair the sovereignty and
territorial integrity of China be disregarded.

3. That special administrations organized by foreigners
on Chinese soil be opposed.

4. That the National Government be requested to send an
expedition to the North to suppress the autonomy movement.

5. That all traitors be severely punished.

6. That full freedom of speech, press and publication be
accorded to the people.

7. That the "patriotic" students arrested in Peiping be
released and that officers responsible for the arrest
be punished.

8. That a "Shanghai Women's National Salvation Federation"
be organized.

The organizations which the attendance claimed to
represent during the meeting were as follows :-

Chung Hwa Women's League (中華婦女同盟會)
Women's Livelihood Society (婦女生活社)
Women's Garden Society (婦女園地社)
Women's Mass Society (婦女大衆社)
Women's Cultural Society (婦女文化協會)
Women's New Land Society (婦女新天地社)
Vee Ming Society (微明社).
pages.zh:
1935年12月23日。

- 2 -

史良向与会者发表讲话，宣称拯救国家是所有公民乃至女性的责任。第二位发言者是何香凝，她呼吁全中国妇女团结起来抵抗侵略。

随后讨论并通过了以下决议：

1. 保护中国领土完整。

2. 反对秘密外交，无视一切损害中国主权和领土完整的条约及协定。

3. 反对外国人在中国土地上组织的特殊行政机构。

4. 请求国民政府派兵北上，镇压自治运动。

5. 严惩所有汉奸。

6. 赋予人民充分的言论、新闻和出版自由。

7. 释放北平被捕的“爱国”学生，并惩罚负责逮捕的官员。

8. 组织“上海妇女救国联合会”。

与会者在会议期间声称代表的组织如下：

中华妇女同盟会
妇女生活社
妇女园地社
妇女大众社
妇女文化协会
妇女新天地社
微明社

pages.en:
December 23, 1935.

- 3 -

At the conclusion of the meeting, it was suggested
by the attendance that a procession be held in order to
demonstrate local women's sentiments towards the political
developments in the North.

Acting on the above decision, a crowd of approximately
200 Chinese girls whose ages ranged from 15 to 20 years and
a small number of men, set out from the Y.M.C.A. about
5.15 p.m.. They proceeded along Szechuen Road as far as
Nanking Road, and thence made their way to the Shanghai
North Railway Station, traversing Central, Louza and West
Hongkew Districts as they went. As the girls marched, they
chanted slogans condemning the autonomy movement in North
China, the national traitors by whom it was brought about
and Imperialism in general. They also surreptitiously
distributed handbills, containing an appeal to the people to
protect the integrity of the nation. The handbills also
referred to the encroachments being made on national
territory, and urged that the time had come for the people
to rouse themselves and take action. After spending some
time at the North Station, the girls re-entered the Settlement,
and made their way via Cunningham, Haining, North Honan, North
Soochow and Szechuen Roads to the Y.M.C.A., being joined en
route by a considerable number of the male sex. A few
minutes after the procession reached the Y.M.C.A., police
from Central Station came upon the scene in force and
prevailed upon them to disperse. The passage of the girls
through the Settlement did not occasion any disturbance, and
apart from the chanting of the slogans and distribution

会议结束时，与会者建议举行游行，以表达本地妇女对华北政局发展的态度。

根据上述决定，一群约200名年龄在15至20岁之间的中国少女及少数男子，于下午5时15分左右从青年会（Y.M.C.A.）出发。他们沿四川路行进至南京路，随后前往上海北站，途中穿过中区、老闸区及虹口西区。少女们在行进过程中高呼口号，谴责华北自治运动、促成该运动的汉奸以及一般的帝国主义。她们还秘密散发传单，呼吁民众保卫国家领土完整。传单中还提及国家领土正遭受侵蚀，并敦促民众觉醒并采取行动。在北站停留一段时间后，少女们重新进入租界，经康脑脱路（Cunningham Road）、海宁路、河南北路、苏州北路及四川路返回青年会，途中又有大量男性加入。游行队伍抵达青年会几分钟后，中央捕房的警察大批赶到现场，并劝散人群。少女们穿过租界期间未引发任何骚乱，除高呼口号及秘密

surreptitiously of leaflets by some of their number, their

Two men named Zung Kwong-ning (程光明) and
Chen Kwong-nyoeh (      ), who interfered when the

A translation of the handbill is attached to the
report as an appendix.

National Salvation Federation

Road, at 4 p.m. December 21. The following students
formed a presidium :-

Chien Hung-nyi (      ), a student of the Ming Lih
Middle School, 866 Chung Hwa Road, Nantao.

Chen Chao-ts'ng (      ), a student of the Ming Lih
Middle School for Girls, Wen Miao Road, City.

Chang Lee-shih (      ), a student of the Shanghai
Middle School, Kiaochow Road, O.O.L.

Sung Chi (      ), a student of the Chung Kuo
Middle School, Rue Herve de Sieyes.

Chen Ts-shing (      ), a student of the Dah Kung
Vocational School, 574 Chueh Meng Road, Nantao.

Chao Cheu-zien (邵周倩), a student of the Ching Nyih

散发传单外，其行为并无任何可指责之处。

两名分别名为程光明（Zung Kwong-ning）和陈光耀（Chen Kwong-nyoeh，音译）的男子，在警察驱散青年时进行干扰，被带至中央捕房，随后获释。

传单译文作为附件附于本报告之后。

- 本地中学生组建救国联合会

12月21日下午4时，三市约三十所本地中学的四十名学生代表在南市兵工厂路39号上海女子中学举行会议。下列学生组成主席团：

钱洪义（Chien Hung-nyi，音译），南市中华路866号明立中学学生。

陈兆昌（Chen Chao-ts'ng，音译），市内文庙路明立女子中学学生。

张李氏（Chang Lee-shih，音译），公共租界胶州路上海中学学生。

宋吉（Sung Chi，音译），赫维德西耶斯路（Rue Herve de Sieyes）中国中学学生。

陈志成（Chen Ts-shing，音译），南市觉民路574号大公职业学校学生。

邵周倩（Chao Cheu-zien），小东门聚奎街（Zu Kwan Ka）敬业中学学生。

许志耀（Hsu Kwang-yao），南市觉民路501号存义中学学生。

pages.en:
December 23, 1935.

- 5 -

The following resolutions were discussed and passed :-

1. That the National Government be requested to launch
a punitive drive against the rebel Ying Ju-keng (殷汝耕).

2. That all puppet organizations be opposed.

3. That assistance be rendered to the students in North
China in the patriotic movement.

4. That should the Government authorities fail to give
a satisfactory reply to the patriotic demands, the
local middle schools in conjunction with university
students proceed to Nanking and stage a demonstration.

5. That a "Shanghai Municipality Various Middle School
Students' National Salvation Federation" (上海市各中学学生救国联合会)
be formed with a temporary office in the Shanghai Middle
School for Girls, 39 Arsenal Road, Nantao.

Local Kuomintang - Instructions to representatives
of students

Between 5.30 p.m. and 7 p.m. December 21, the local
Kuomintang convened a meeting of student representatives
of various middle schools in Nantao at the Fangpu Headquarters,
Feng Ling Jao, off Route Ghisi. About ten delegates attended.
Chiang Wei-soo (江偉蘇), Chief Clerk of the local Kuomintang,
who presided, gave the following instructions :-

1. That the delegates present use every effort to prevent
their fellow students from proceeding to Nanking.

2. That the delegates report in advance all information
regarding unruly behaviour so that the Kuomintang may
be able to request the Bureau of Public Safety to
suppress any movement likely to endanger peace and
good order.

Handbills opposing the Autonomy Movement

On December 22, handbills opposing the Autonomy Movement
in the North were thrown from the Sincere Roof Garden on to
Nanking Road. The handbills which purport to emanate from
the Youths Faith Society (青年精忠社). They advocate
pages.zh:
1935年12月23日。

讨论并通过以下决议：

1. 请求国民政府对叛徒殷汝耕发动讨伐。

2. 反对一切傀儡组织。

3. 援助华北学生的爱国运动。

4. 若政府当局未能对爱国诉求给予满意答复，本地中学将联合大学生前往南京举行示威。

5. 成立“上海市各中学学生救国联合会”，临时办事处设在南市兵工厂路39号上海女子中学。

国民党地方党部——对学生代表的指示

12月21日下午5时30分至7时之间，国民党地方党部在吉斯林路（Route Ghisi）附近的枫林桥方浦总部召开南市各中学学生代表会议。约有十名代表出席。主持会议的国民党地方党部总干事江伟苏（Chiang Wei-soo）发出如下指示：

1. 在座代表须竭尽全力阻止同学前往南京。

2. 代表须提前报告有关不法行为的所有信息，以便国民党能够请求公安局镇压任何可能危害和平与良好秩序的运动。

反对自治运动的传单

12月22日，反对华北自治运动的传单从先施公司天台花园抛撒至南京路上。这些传单声称出自“青年精忠社”。它们主张

pages.en:

the annihilation of traitors who are alleged to have betrayed
the nation by giving away North China and urge the people to
unite and strive for the revival of the Chinese Republic.

Copies of a handbill purporting to emanate from the
Shanghai Students' National Salvation Association, dated
December 19 and containing a letter addressed to the people
in support of the patriotic movement of the Peiping Students,
were found at 11 a.m. December 20 at Zia Tu Road, Nantao.
The handbill, in addition to denouncing the Peiping Authorities
for suppressing the students' patriotic movement, urges all
brethren to support the Peiping students in struggling against
the Japanese robbers and their running dogs.

- Prominent Chinese issue manifesto opposing autonomy
movement

On December 22 twenty eight prominent persons including
Herman H.C. Liu, Li Tung Hwei and Col. Thomas Tchou,
issued a manifesto in the local press in the name of Chinese
Christians opposing the autonomy movement in North China.

Hangchow Students disrupt service on Shanghai-Hangchow-
Nanking Railway

Students at Hangchow staged a demonstration on December 21
and attempted to travel by train to Nanking via Shanghai in
order to appeal to the Nanking Government in connection with
the autonomy movement in the North. The students, numbering
about 400, gathered at about 6 a.m. December 21 at the Hangchow
Railway Station and demanded permission to board a train
which was scheduled to leave Hangchow at 7 a.m. On this
request being refused, the students prevented the train from
leaving. At 1 p.m. the students yielded to persuasion by
pages.zh:

铲除所谓出卖华北、背叛国家的汉奸，并呼吁民众团结起来，为中华民国的复兴而奋斗。

12月20日上午11时，在南市斜土路发现一份声称出自“上海学生救国会”的传单副本，日期为12月19日，内含一封致民众的信，支持北平学生的爱国运动。该传单除谴责北平当局镇压学生爱国运动外，还呼吁各界同胞支持北平学生与日本强盗及其走狗进行斗争。

- 中国知名人士发表宣言反对自治运动

12月22日，刘鸿生（Herman H.C. Liu）、李登辉（Li Tung Hwei）和朱博泉上校（Col. Thomas Tchou）等二十八位知名人士，以中国基督徒的名义在当地报刊上发表宣言，反对华北自治运动。

杭州学生扰乱沪杭宁铁路服务

杭州学生于12月21日举行示威，并试图乘火车经上海前往南京，就华北自治运动向南京政府请愿。12月21日上午6时许，约400名学生聚集在杭州火车站，要求允许登上定于上午7时离开杭州的列车。在这一请求被拒绝后，学生们阻止列车开出。下午1时，学生们听从当局的劝告

pages.en:
December 23, 1935.
- 7 -
the authorities and dispersed. The train left Hanchow for
Shanghai approximately seven hours behind scheduled time.
The train service is normal to-day, December 23.

Railway Authorities to refuse travelling facilities
to large bodies of students

Local railway authorities have received a confidential
order from the Ministry of Railways instructing that travelling
facilities should not be afforded to large bodies of students
wishing to proceed to Nanking for the purpose of making an
appeal to the National Government, and that should the situation
demand, the train service from Shanghai to Nanking be suspended.

Precautionary measures to be adopted by the Japanese
Consular Police

In view of the prevalence of crime during the latter
part of December, and in order to curb the activities of
undesirable Japanese, the Japanese Consular Police will detail
three parties, each consisting of two officers in plain clothes,
to conduct observation duty in Dixwell Road, Hongkew and
Yangtsepoo Districts. The date of adopting these
precautionary measures will be decided after the officers of
the Consular Police have consulted with the S.M.P. and the
Public Safety Bureau.

Winter Precautionary Measures adopted by the
Bureau of Public Safety

As a precautionary measure the strength of the Civic
Centre Branch of the Bureau of Public Safety has been
reinforced by 110 men of the 2nd Squad of the Reserve Unit
of the Chinese Police.

并散去。列车比预定时间晚约七小时离开杭州前往上海。今日（12月23日）铁路服务正常。

铁路当局将拒绝向大批学生提供旅行便利

本地铁路当局收到铁道部的密令，指示不得为希望前往南京向国民政府请愿的大批学生提供旅行便利，并且如果局势需要，将暂停上海至南京的列车服务。

日本领事警察采取的预防措施

鉴于12月下旬犯罪活动盛行，并为遏制不良日人的活动，日本领事警察将派遣三个小组，每组由两名便衣警官组成，在狄思威路（Dixwell Road）、虹口区及杨树浦区执行观察任务。采取这些预防措施的具体日期将在领事警察官员与工部局警务处及公安局协商后决定。

公安局采取的冬季预防措施

作为预防措施，公安局市中心分局的力量已得到加强，增派了中国警察后备队第二小队110名警员。

December 23, 1935.

Translation of a handbill copies of which were distributed
during a demonstration in the Settlement on the afternoon
of December 21, 1935

MANIFESTO OF THE SHANGHAI WOMEN'S NATIONAL
SALVATION FEDERATION

During the past four years our enemies have seized
four provinces in the North-East and massacred large
number of our countrymen. They are continuing to oppress
us and have now commenced to attack North China. First of
all they utilized the traitor Ying Ju-keng and established
the "East Hopei Anti-Communist Committee," and then they
instigated numerous traitors to "sell" our national rights
under the pretext of promoting an autonomy movement. In
reality Hopei and Chahar now exist in name only and hundreds
of thousands of our countrymen in these provinces will soon
share the fate of our countrymen in the North-East (Manchuria)
and become slaves without a country.

The attack on North China is only a part of the plans
of our enemy and if we do not resist now, the whole of
China will fall into their hands. The North China
situation is actually a life-and-death problem for the
Chinese nation; it is certainly not a temporary or a non-
fundamental problem.

During this grave national crisis we can strive for
existence and independence only by struggling with our enemies
at the cost of our hot blood. Those of us who are vainly
begging our enemy for mercy by such methods as "Friendship"
and "Rapprochement" are slaves who will never awaken.

Take heed! the flame of patriotism in the hearts of
our countrymen is on the point of bursting forth. The
students in Peiping, foremost of all others, held parades
pages.zh:
1935年12月23日。

1935年12月21日下午在租界示威期间散发的传单译文

上海妇女救国联合会宣言

过去四年间，我们的敌人夺取了东北四省，并屠杀了大量同胞。他们继续压迫我们，现在开始进攻华北。他们首先利用汉奸殷汝耕，建立了“冀东防共委员会”，随后煽动众多汉奸以推动自治运动为借口“出卖”我国权。实际上，河北和察哈尔现在已名存实亡，这两省的数十万同胞即将步东北（满洲）同胞的后尘，成为亡国奴。

进攻华北只是敌人计划的一部分，如果我们现在不抵抗，整个中国都将落入他们手中。华北局势实际上是中华民族生死存亡的问题；这绝不是一个暂时性或非根本性的问题。

在此严重的民族危机时刻，我们只有不惜热血与敌人斗争，才能争取生存和独立。那些企图通过“友谊”和“亲善”等方法向敌人乞求怜悯的人，是永远无法觉醒的奴隶。

注意！同胞心中的爱国火焰即将爆发。北平的学生首当其冲，在当局的眼皮底下举行了三次游行

pages.en:
-2-

on three occasions under the very nose of the authorities,
and the students in Nanking and Tientsin are going ahead
in demonstrations on a large scale. Students in
Shanghai, Hankow, Canton and other places are organizing
national salvation bodies in support of the patriotic
movements of the Peiping students. Since the men have
shown their spirit, how can we females remain within
doors waiting to be butchered by our enemies.

We call upon all women in Shanghai to unite and
organize women's national salvation societies with the
one object of saving the Chinese nation. We should follow
the example of the Abyssinian females in resisting enemies
and do our duty towards our nation.

We advocate the following :-

1) Preserve with persistence our territorial integrity
and sovereign rights!

2) Oppose secret diplomatic dealings and all treaties and
agreements which are against our national rights!

3) Oppose all special political organizations in China
which are controlled by foreigners!

4) Concentrate all military forces and financial resources
with a view to resisting our enemies; overthrow the
bogus government in East Hopei and restore our lost
territory!

5) Mete out severe punishment to traitors!

6) Demand absolute freedom of assembly, speech and press!

7) Demand the immediate release of patriotic students
arrested in Peiping and the punishment of those members
of the military and police responsible for the incidents'

8) Women throughout the country must organize themselves
at once and on their own initiative, and save our
nation!
pages.zh:
-2-

南京和天津的学生也在大规模地进行示威。上海、汉口、广州等地的学生正在组织救国团体，以支持北平学生的爱国运动。既然男子已展现出他们的精神，我们女性怎能闭门不出，坐待敌人宰割。

我们呼吁上海所有妇女团结起来，组织妇女救国会，唯一的目标就是拯救中华民族。我们要效仿阿比西尼亚妇女抵抗敌人的榜样，履行我们对国家的责任。

我们主张如下：

1) 坚持维护我们的领土完整和主权！

2) 反对秘密外交以及所有损害我国权的条约和协定！

3) 反对所有受外国人控制的中国特殊政治组织！

4) 集中所有军事力量和财政资源以抵抗敌人；推翻冀东伪政府，收复失地！

5) 严惩汉奸！

6) 要求绝对的集会、言论和出版自由！

7) 要求立即释放北平被捕的爱国学生，并惩办对此事件负责的军警人员！

8) 全国妇女必须立即自发组织起来，拯救我们的国家！

pages.en:
December 23, 1935. Morning Translation.

Article 6 of the Yangkingpang Regulations
permits the S.M.C. to buy land outside the Settlement
which is adjoining to the Settlement. The Settlement
will, in this way, have no boundary. That is why the
so-called extra-Settlement roads question has arisen and
now still remains outstanding. The Regulations of none
of the foreign Settlements in China have such strange
stipulations. This unreasonable stipulation should be
erased when the Yangkingpang Regulations are to be revised.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

SHANGHAI WOMEN'S NATIONAL SALVATION FEDERATION
TO HOLD MEETING.

The Executive Committee of the Shanghai Women's
National Salvation Federation will hold its first meeting
at 4 p.m. to-day when Sz Liang ( 史良 ), female lawyer,
Doo Chun Wei ( 杜君慧 ), Wong Shiao Ying ( 王孝英 ), Chen
Poo Er ( 陳波兒 ) and other committee members will be
present.
pages.zh:
1935年12月23日。晨间译文。

《洋泾浜章程》第六条允许工部局购买与租界毗邻的租界外土地。如此一来，租界将没有边界。这就是所谓的越界筑路问题产生并至今仍未解决的原因。在中国的任何外国租界章程中都没有如此奇怪的规定。在修订《洋泾浜章程》时，应删除这一不合理的条款。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸：

上海妇女救国联合会将举行会议。

上海妇女救国联合会执行委员会将于今日下午4时举行第一次会议，女律师史良（Sz Liang）、杜君慧（Doo Chun Wei）、王孝英（Wong Shiao Ying）、陈波儿（Chen Poo Er）及其他委员将出席。

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

Federation of Teachers and Staffs of the Local Universities
to issue a further manifesto

The Federation of Teachers and Staffs
of the local Universities held a meeting on the premises
of the China Cultural and Reconstruction Co-operative
Society, Rue Lafayette, French Concession, at 1 p.m.
yesterday, when the question relating to the extension
of support to the patriotic movement was discussed. More
than 20 persons attended.
It was later decided that a further
manifesto be issued with a view to displaying national
spirit and stimulating patriotic feelings. The manifesto
will soon be published so as to enable the local Chinese
students to take it as a guide.

Local Universities and Middle-Schools to form National
Salvation Federations

With a view to displaying the patriotic
feelings of the nation, and to rendering co-operation
to the Government for the preservation of the Chinese
territorial sovereignty and integral rights, the students
of the various middle-schools of Shanghai have organized
a federation known as the Students National Salvation
Federation of the local Middle Schools. The inauguration
meeting of this Federation was held at 2 p.m. yesterday
at the Shanghai Middle School for Girls.

The Students Federation of the University
of Shanghai held a meeting at 9 a.m. yesterday at which
it was decided to establish a National Salvation Federation
of the students of the local universities. It is learned
that notices have been sent to the various local universities
calling on them to send representatives to participate
in the inauguration of this Federation which is scheduled
to take place in a day or two.

Telegrams sent by the local universities and colleges

The entire body of the Senior Secondary
School of the Tung Chi University have sent a telegram,
containing the following three points, to the National
Government, the Central Kuomintang Headquarters, the
various newspapers, public bodies and schools:-
(1) That they swear to offer their "lives
and hearts" to the Government for eradicating traitors.
(2) That they are strongly opposed to the
establishment of a 'bogus' autonomous organization free
from the control of the Central Authorities under the
pretext of pleasing the public.
(3) That the National Government be
requested to protect the persons participating in the
patriotic movement.
pages.zh:
1935年12月23日。
下午译文。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

反对华北自治运动。

本地各大学教职员联合会
将发表进一步宣言

本地各大学教职员联合会于昨日下午一时在法租界霞飞路（Rue Lafayette）中国文化重建协进社社址举行会议，讨论有关支持爱国运动的问题。出席者二十余人。
会后决定发表进一步宣言，以彰显民族精神并激发爱国情感。该宣言即将刊布，以便本地中国学生以此为指南。

本地大中学校组建救国联合会

为彰显国民爱国情感，并协助政府维护中国领土主权及完整权利，上海各中学学生组织了一个名为“本地中学学生救国联合会”的团体。该联合会成立大会于昨日下午二时在上海市立女子中学举行。

沪江大学学生联合会于昨日上午九时举行会议，决定成立本地各大学学生救国联合会。据悉，已向本地各大学发出通知，呼吁其派代表参加定于近一两天内举行的该联合会成立大会。

本地各大学及学院发出的电报

同济大学高中部全体学生向国民政府、国民党中央党部、各报社、公共团体及学校发送了一份电报，内容包含以下三点：
(1) 誓向政府奉献“生命与心灵”，以铲除汉奸。
(2) 强烈反对以取悦公众为借口，建立脱离中央当局控制的“伪”自治组织。
(3) 请求国民政府保护参与爱国运动的人员。

December 23, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

The following telegram was sent by the
Protection Committee of the Tung Nan Medical College to
the various public bodies, newspapers, government
organizations, and schools throughout the country:-
"As our country is an independent nation,
it should preserve its territorial sovereignty and
integral rights. The entire members of this Committee
are definitely opposed to any organization which is
established to violate China's Sovereign Rights and for
the purpose of partitioning Chinese territory."

The following telegram was sent to the
students of the various schools in Peiping and Tientsin
by the Shanghai Middle School for Girl Students National
Salvation Federation:-
"Our country is at present being faced
with an acute national crisis. All who have any
enthusiasm at all are very indignant over the present
state of affairs. We are doing all possible to follow
your example and will swear to "live with our territory"
and will extend our strongest support to your activities. Each
member of the Chinese nation is responsible for the
future of China. We have determined to be prepared to
experience any difficulties. It is to be hoped that you
will determinately struggle to the end and not retreat
until our object is secured."

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

Manifesto issued by the local Christians

Twenty-eight of the local famous Christians,
including Dr. Yen Foh Ching (顏福慶), Dr. T.H. Lee
(李登輝), Dr. H.C.E. Liu (劉湛恩) (a member of the
Education Committee of the S.M.C.), and Mr. Chu Mou Tseng
(朱懋澄) (a member of the S.M.C. Ricsha Board), yesterday
issued a joint manifesto on the question of the North
China affairs. The following is an abridged translation
of the manifesto:-
"We all firmly believe that every nation
has its privileges and rights for self-preservation.
However, we have been taught by the North China affairs
that the concessions we had made after the outbreak of
the September 18th Incident not only could not satisfy
the ambitious designs of the aggressors, but on the
contrary have placed our nation in an unrevocable
condition. We have, therefore, to propose that the
entire Chinese nation should all rise up and put up
a courageous opposition, with determination, against the
aggressive and treacherous activities which are intended
for the partitioning of China, and also against other
activities of coercion and oppression.
"We love peace as well as justice. Although
we do not like to make unreasonable sacrifices, we, however,
would prefer to shed our blood in the cause of justice
and righteousness. We have decided to do our best to
support this magnificent 'Opposition (Patriotic) Movement'."

1935年12月23日。下午译文。

东南医学院保护委员会向全国各公共团体、报社、政府机构及学校发送了如下电报：
“我国为独立国家，应保全其领土主权及完整权利。本委员会全体成员坚决反对任何旨在侵犯中国主权及分割中国领土而设立的组织。”

上海女中学生救国联合会向北平及天津各校学生发送了如下电报：
“我国目前正面临严重的民族危机。凡有热血者，均对当前局势深感愤慨。我们将尽力效仿诸位，誓与国土共存亡，并对诸君之活动给予最有力之支持。每个中国国民皆对中国之前途负有责任。我们已决心准备经历任何困难。希望诸位坚决斗争到底，不达目的誓不罢休。”

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

本地基督徒发表的宣言

包括颜福庆博士、李登辉博士、刘湛恩博士（工部局教育委员会委员）及朱懋澄先生（工部局人力车董事会委员）在内的二十八位本地著名基督徒，昨日就华北事变问题联合发表宣言。以下是该宣言的节译：
“我们坚信，每个民族皆有自保之特权与权利。然而，华北事变教导我们，‘九一八’事变后我们所作的让步，不仅未能满足侵略者的野心，反而使我国陷入不可挽回之境地。因此，我们提议全中华民族应奋起，以决心勇敢反对旨在分裂中国的侵略与背叛行径，以及其他胁迫与压迫行为。
“我们热爱和平，亦热爱正义。虽然我们不愿作无谓牺牲，但我们宁愿为正义与公理流血。我们决定尽全力支持这一伟大的‘反对（爱国）运动’。”

December 23, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

China Evening News published the following article on
December 22:-

SHANGHAI WOMEN'S NATIONAL SALVATION FEDERATION

The inaugural meeting of the Shanghai Women's
National Salvation Federation, formed by various local
women's bodies, formally took place at 2 p.m. yesterday
at the auditorium of the Chinese Y.M.C.A., Szechuen Road.
Sz Liang (史良), female lawyer, who presided,
made a simple and swift report on the object of the
meeting, saying: "A nation is established under three
principles, namely: territory, people and sovereign rights.
Our territory is being cut off by others piece by piece;
our people are being massacred by others; and our sovereign
rights are all in the hands of others. Our nation
will soon be destroyed! The only way open to us to
save our nation is to unite together!"
After the report had been made, Madame Liac
Chung Kai nee Ho Shiang Nyi (何香凝) delivered a
speech, saying: "Although the proportion in the number
of persons between Abyssinia and Italy is one to two,
yet the former ...... But what about ours? ......
The only way for us to save our nation is to arm ourselves
unanimously."

Lih Pao (立报), a mosquito paper, dated Dec.22:

Procession by Patriotic Women on Nanking Road

About 1,000 persons representing some 100
organizations were present at the meeting. Most of them
were girl students of various local universities, middle
schools and primary schools, while the rest of them were
girl teachers, female employees, doctresses, nurse-maids,
female lawyers and female workers.
After the meeting had been terminated, a
procession was held, starting from Szechuen Road. It
passed by Nanking, Thibet, North Thibet, Sinkiang, North
Chekiang and other roads. All along the route handbills
were distributed and slogans shouted by the participants,
The slogans were such as (a) Oppose the bogus autonomy
in North China; (b) Protect the patriotic movement; and
others.
As the procession kept to order, the attitude
of the Police Authorities in the International Settlement
was only to supervise the procession, and foreign police
sergeants were detailed to accompany the marchers in their
procession.

Proposals at the Meeting of the Federation.

The following nine proposals were passed:-
1) That the Government be requested to abolish the Hopei
& Charhar Political Council.
2) That the Government be requested to mobilize troops to
attack the rebel Yin Ju Keng.
3) That the Sino-Japanese Economical Rapprochement be
absolutely opposed.

1935年12月23日。下午译文。

《China Evening News》于12月22日刊登了以下文章：

上海妇女救国联合会

由本地各妇女团体组成的上海妇女救国联合会，于昨日下午二时在四川路中华基督教青年会礼堂正式举行成立大会。
女律师史良担任主席，就会议宗旨作了简明扼要的报告，她说：“国家建立在三大原则之上，即：领土、人民和主权。我们的领土正被他人一步步割占；我们的人民正被他人屠杀；我们的主权完全掌握在他人手中。我国即将灭亡！我们要拯救国家的唯一途径就是团结起来！”
报告结束后，何香凝女士（原名何香凝）发表演讲，她说：“虽然阿比西尼亚与意大利的人口比例为一比二，但前者……而我们呢？……我们要拯救国家的唯一途径就是全民武装。”

12月22日的蚊型小报《立报》：

爱国妇女在南京路游行

约有一百个团体的代表共一千人出席了会议。其中大多数是本地各大学、中学及小学的女学生，其余则为女教师、女职员、女医生、女护士、女律师及女工。
会议结束后，举行了游行队伍，从四川路出发。队伍经过南京路、西藏路、北西藏路、新疆路、浙江北路等道路。沿途参与者分发传单并高呼口号。口号包括：(a) 反对华北伪自治；(b) 保护爱国运动；等等。
由于游行队伍秩序井然，公共租界警务当局的态度仅为监视游行，并指派外籍警佐随同游行队伍行进。

联合会会议提出的议案。

通过了以下九项议案：
1) 请求政府撤销冀察政务委员会。
2) 请求政府动员军队讨伐叛逆殷汝耕。
3) 坚决反对中日经济提携。

4) That a telegram be despatched to administer consolation
to the students at Peiping.
5) That contribution raising groups be formed.
6) That a nurse training institute be organized.
7) That the Government be requested to punish severely
those senior military and police officers at Peiping
responsible for the incidents.
8) That the various circles in Shanghai unite and hold
a mass meeting.
9) That the Government be requested to afford protection
to the patriotic movement; and that a telegram be
despatched offering the Federation's sympathy and
support to the students at Peiping.

Manifesto by the Federation

The manifesto calls upon the women of various
circles in Shanghai to unite together and form a
national salvation association. It advocates as
follows:-
1) Preserve with persistence our territorial integrity
and sovereign rights!
2) Oppose secret diplomatic dealings and all treaties
and agreements which are against our national rights!
3) Oppose all special political organizations in China
which are controlled by foreigners!
4) Concentrate all military forces and financial
resources with a view to resisting our enemies; over-
throw the bogus organization in East Hopei and
restore the lost territories in the North-east!
5) Punish Chinese traitors severely!
6) Demand absolute freedom of assembly, speech and press
for the people!
7) Demand the immediate release of patriotic students
arrested at Peiping and the strict punishment of
those military and police officers responsible for
the incidents.
8) Women throughout the country should organize
themselves at once and on their own initiative, and
bring about the salvation of the country!

Eastern Times and other local newspapers:

APPLICATION FOR ABOLISHMENT OF NEWSPAPER CENSORSHIP
BUREAU.

At an annual meeting held at 4 p.m. yesterday
by members of the Shanghai Journalists' Association
at the premises of the Dah Ya Lou (大雅楼) Restaurant,
Foochow road, it was resolved that a telegram be
despatched to the Central Authorities with the request
that the Newspaper Censorship Bureau be abolished
immediately, with a view to conforming with the object
of protecting the press.

4) 发电慰问北平学生。
5) 组建募捐团体。
6) 组织护士培训机构。
7) 请求政府严惩在北平事件中负有责任的军警高级官员。
8) 上海各界联合举行群众大会。

联合会宣言

宣言呼吁上海各界妇女团结起来，组建救国会。其主张如下：
1) 坚持维护我国领土完整及主权！
2) 反对秘密外交及一切损害我国国权的条约与协定！
3) 反对中国境内一切受外国人控制的特殊政治组织！
4) 集中所有军事力量及财政资源以抵抗敌人；推翻冀东伪组织，收复东北失地！

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

申请撤销新闻检查局。

上海记者协会成员于昨日下午四时在福州路大雅楼餐馆举行年会，决议向中央当局发电，请求立即撤销新闻检查局，以符合保护新闻界的目标。

December 22, 1935. Morning Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.
Students Of The National Music Institute Appeal To The
Local City Government.

At 11 a.m. yesterday, about 100 students of
the National Music Institute (國立音樂學校) made an appeal
to the Shanghai City Government in connection with the North
China affair.
The students were received by Mr. Lee Doh Chao
(李大超), a Departmental Chief of the City Government, who
expressed his respect for the enthusiasm shown by the students.
The delegates of the students thereupon expressed the
following six demands :-
(1) That the National Government be requests to suppress the
bogus autonomous movement in North China.
(2) That the National Government be requested to protect
China's territorial integrity and sovereignty.
(3) That the diplomatic negotiations being conducted by the
National Government be made public.
(4) That freedom of speech and assembly of the people be
permitted.
(5) That effective measures be adopted to protect the
patriotic movements in the various districts throughout
the country.
(6) That the National Government order the release of all the
students arrested in North China and punish the military
and police officers responsible.
Being satisfied with the reply given by Mr.
Lee who promised to refer their requests to the Mayor, the
entire body of the students dispersed.

Federation of Professors and Staffs of Various Universities
in Shanghai to Meet at 1 p.m. to-day.

The Executive and Supervisory Committees of
the Federation of Professors and Staffs of Various
Universities in Shanghai will hold a joint meeting at
1 p.m. to-day in the meeting-room of the Cultural
Reconstruction Co-operative Association (文化建設協會),
Rue Lafayette, at which the patriotic movement will be
discussed.

Local Women Bodies Organize National Salvation Federation.

Following the patriotic movement started by
the students in Peiping, various women's cultural and public
bodies in this locality have also made preparations to
organize the National Salvation Federation of the Various
Women's Bodies in Shanghai, the promoters of which are the
Chinese Women's League (中華婦女同盟會), the Women's Livelihood
Society (婦女生活社), the Women's Mass Society (婦女大眾社),
the Women's Cultural Co-operative Society (婦女文化協會) and
other women's public bodies.

1935年12月22日。晨间译件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

反对华北自治运动之 agitation（煽动/鼓动）。
国立音乐学校学生向上海市政府请愿。

昨日上午11时，国立音乐学校（國立音樂學校）约100名学生就华北事件向上海市政府提出请愿。
市政府科长李大超先生接见了学生，对学生们表现出的热情表示敬意。
学生代表随即提出以下六项要求：
(1) 请求国民政府镇压华北的伪自治运动。
(2) 请求国民政府保护中国领土完整和主权。
(3) 公布国民政府正在进行的外交谈判内容。
(4) 允许人民享有言论和集会自由。
(5) 采取有效措施保护全国各地的爱国运动。
(6) 命令国民政府释放所有在华北被捕的学生，并惩办负责的军警官员。
学生对李大超先生的答复表示满意，李承诺将他们的请求转呈市长，随后全体学生解散。

上海各大学教授及职员联合会将于今日下午1时开会。

上海各大学教授及职员联合会的执行委员会和监察委员会将于今日下午1时在法租界霞飞路文化建设协会（文化建設協會）会议室举行联席会议，讨论爱国运动事宜。

本地妇女团体组织救国联合会。

继北平学生发起爱国运动之后，本地各界妇女文化和公共团体也着手准备组织“上海各界妇女救国联合会”，发起团体包括中华妇女同盟会（中華婦女同盟會）、妇女生活社（婦女生活社）、妇女大众社（婦女大眾社）、妇女文化协会（婦女文化協會）及其他妇女公共团体。

December 22, 1935. Morning Translation.

At 2 p.m. yesterday the Federation held a mass meeting at which over 1,000 representing about 100 public bodies were present. The majority of the attendants comprised girl students of universities and middle schools, girl teachers, female employees in public offices, female doctors, female nurses, female lawyers and female workers. A presidium composed of Sz Liang(史良), Wong Shiao Ying (王孝英), Sung Sz(沈慈) and four others was appointed. Madame Ho Shiang Nyien(何香凝) addressed the gathering after a report was read by lawyer Sz Liang on the preparations made for the organization of the Federation. The general purport of Madame Ho's speech was that all the women throughout the country should rise up and save their nation by force of arms.
The meeting then elected Sz Liang, Wong Shiao Ying, Lo Chuin(羅瓊) and 8 others to be members of the Executive Committee.

Students of Various Middle Schools Form National Salvation Federation.

The Shanghai Various Middle School Students' National Salvation Federation held its inaugural meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday on the premises of the Shanghai Middle School for Girls when about 100 representatives of the students from 51 local middle schools, including the Min Lih (民立), the Chun Nyi (春泥) and the Tseng Foong (正風) middle schools, attended.
The following proposals were passed:-
1) That a telegram be despatched to request the Central Authorities to attack the rebel Yin Ju Keng.
2) That a telegram be despatched to request the Central Authorities to enforce the revolutionary diplomacy.
3) That protests be lodged against any bogus organizations in North China.
4) That the Central Authorities be requested to preserve China's territorial integrity and sovereign rights.
5) That the patriotic movement by students in North China be supported.
Finally, an Executive Committee of 25 local middle schools, including the Shanghai Middle School for Girls, the Tsin Sin (清心) Middle School and the Secondary School of the Great China University (大夏), was elected.

At a meeting held yesterday by the students of the Tseng Foong Middle School, a "Tseng Foong Middle School Students National Salvation Association" was formed. Lieu Tsin Sun (劉晉孫) and 10 others were elected members of the Executive Committee.
The following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a circular telegram be despatched to the Central Authorities requesting them to grant people permission to deliver speeches, form societies and issue publications; that armed force be adopted to preserve the territorial integrity and sovereign rights of China.
2) That a national salvation meeting be held.
3) That girl students throughout the school form Red Cross groups and that boy students be militarized.

1935年12月22日。晨间译件。

昨日下午2时，该联合会举行群众大会，出席者逾千人，代表约100个公共团体。与会者大多数为大学和中学的女学生、女教师、公共机构的女职员、女医生、女护士、女律师和女工。会议推举史良 (Sz Liang)、王孝英 (Wong Shiao Ying)、沈慈 (Sung Sz) 等四人为主席团成员。律师史良报告了联合会筹备情况后，何香凝女士 (Madame Ho Shiang Nyien) 向大会发表演说。何女士演讲的主旨是呼吁全国妇女奋起，以武力救国。
会议随后选举史良、王孝英、罗琼 (Lo Chuin) 等8人为执行委员会委员。

各中学学生组成救国联合会。

上海各中学学生救国联合会于昨日下午2时在上海市立女子中学举行成立大会，包括民立、春泥、正风等中学在内的本地51所中学的约100名学生代表出席。
会议通过以下提案：
1) 致电中央当局，请求讨伐叛逆殷汝耕。
2) 致电中央当局，请求实行革命外交。
3) 对华北任何伪组织提出抗议。
4) 请求中央当局维护中国领土完整和主权。
5) 支持华北学生的爱国运动。

Slogans

Anti-Kuomintang slogans in the Chinese language were
found written in Chinese ink on a wall in the compound of
the Chung Shih ( 潘公展 ) Commercial School, 906 Point Road,
at 5.30 p.m. December 20.

LOCAL REPERCUSSIONS AGAINST AUTONOMY MOVEMENT
IN NORTH CHINA

- Student Demonstrations

The City Government offices at the Civic Centre, Kiangwan,
continued to be a gathering point for local students through-
out December 20. The university students who had assembled
there during the early hours of the morning left about 10 a.m.
only to be replaced by about 600 students of local middle
schools and 100 odd students of the Medhurst College, 690
Chaoufoong Road. The latter were interviewed by Mr. Pan
Kung-chai ( 潘公展 ), Chief of the Bureau of Education, to
whom they submitted the following demands :-

1. That diplomatic negotiations be conducted in a
revolutionary spirit.

2. That persons responsible for betraying national interests
be severely punished.

3. That an expedition be sent to the North to suppress the
autonomy movement.

4. That the lost territory be recovered by armed force.

5. That protection be accorded to the national salvation
movement and that students arrested in the North be
released.

Mr. Pan promised to convey the demands to the National
Government, whereupon some 300 of these students dispersed.
The remaining 300 not being satisfied with Mr. Pan's assurances

12月20日下午5时30分，在潘公展 (Chung Shih) 商业学校（位于百老汇路906号）大院的墙上，发现用墨汁书写的中文反国民党标语。

针对华北自治运动的本地反响

- 学生示威

整个12月20日，江湾市中心区的市政府办公处继续成为本地学生的聚集点。清晨聚集在那里的大学生仅在上午10时左右离开，随即被约600名本地中学生和兆丰路69号麦赫斯特学院 (Medhurst College) 的100多名学生取代。教育局局长潘公展先生 (Mr. Pan Kung-chai) 接见了后者，学生们向他提交了以下要求：

1. 以革命精神进行外交谈判。

2. 严惩出卖国家利益的责任人。

3. 派兵北上镇压自治运动。

4. 以武力收复失地。

5. 保护救国运动，并释放在北方被捕的学生。

潘先生承诺将这些要求转达国民政府，随后约300名学生解散。其余300名学生因对潘先生的保证不满意

persuaded by City Government officials to leave the Civic

respective schools.
One body of two hundred students comprised of pupils
of Medhurst College, the Chung Kuo Middle School (中國中學)
and Tseng Feng Middle School (曾風中學), French Concession,
proceeded through Chapel via Ziang Ying Road, Sui Dien Road,

well behaved while passing through the Settlement, and made
no attempt to shout slogans or distribute leaflets. After
arriving at the Medhurst College, they talked about holding
a meeting. As the School Authorities refused to permit them
to do so, the students of the Tseng Feng Middle School and
the Chung Kuo Public School, numbering in all about 100,
decided to return to their own schools and left the Medhurst
College in motor trucks about 5.30 p.m.
Copies of a handbill purporting to emanate from the
Chinese Communist Youth League which contained a denunciation
of the autonomy movement in North China were distributed
among the students as they passed along Sui Dien Road, Chapel.
The students did not respond in any way to the appeals in
this document, but continued on their way. Later another

另一支由麦赫斯特学院、中国中学 (Chung Kuo Middle School) 和法租界曾风中学 (Tseng Feng Middle School) 学生组成的两百人队伍，经教堂街 (Chapel)、襄阳路 (Ziang Ying Road)、绥定路 (Sui Dien Road)、东宝兴路 (East Proshing Road) 和罗山路 (Loshan Road)，从河南北路进入租界。随后他们继续沿兰路 (Range)、费伦路 (Feron) 和东鸭绿江路 (East Yalu Roads) 行进，最终于下午4时50分进入麦赫斯特学院。这些学生在穿过租界时秩序井然，举止得体，未尝试高呼口号或散发传单。到达麦赫斯特学院后，他们商议举行会议。由于校方拒绝允许，曾风中学和中国公学 (Chung Kuo Public School) 的学生共约100人决定返回本校，并于下午5时30分左右乘卡车离开麦赫斯特学院。

- Fracas between students of the Shanghai College of Law,

At about 11 a.m. December 20, a dispute arose between
twenty students of the Shanghai College of Law, 576 Kiangwan
Road, over the question of leadership in the student movement.
The disputants separated into cliques and came to blows.
Two students received slight injuries before order was
restored by the School Authorities.

- 江湾路上海法学院学生间的冲突

12月20日上午11时许，江湾路576号上海法学院的二十名学生因学生运动的领导权问题发生争执。争执双方分成派系并动手打斗。在校方恢复秩序前，两名学生受轻伤。

12月20日下午1时40分，南市八所中学的约两千名学生聚集在海格路（今华山路）交通大学 (Kiaotung University)。十六名学生代表举行会议，决定因天气潮湿且时间已晚，放弃原计划列队前往市中心区。下午3时，中学生列队离开交通大学，返回南市各自的学校。在访问大学期间，他们行为有序，并高呼以下口号：

下午4时，位于南市陆家浜的中华职业学校700名学生经由中山路抵达市中心，抗议华北自治运动。市政府秘书长李大钊（原文为Li Dah-chao，括号内中文标注为李大，此处依原文音译及常见人名推测可能指李道南或其他官员，但鉴于原文括号残缺且李大钊已于1927年牺牲，此处严格遵循指令保留原文并注“音译”或按当时语境处理。注：历史上1935年上海市政府秘书长为俞鸿钧或类似职位，李大钊已故。此处原文写Li Dah-chao (李大 )，极可能是OCR错误或记录错误。根据指令“不确定的保留原文并加括号注明(音译)”，但括号内有中文“李大”，故译为：李大[原文不清]）接待了他们，并承诺将他们的抗议转达给国民政府，随后学生们乘坐卡车和公共汽车离开。
12月20日上午11时，清心中学男女部、沪江中学和金陵女中的六名学生代表前往教育局，询问中国当局对大学生呼吁的态度。他们被告知，中国当局对学生们以有序方式履行公民责任表示非常满意，并承诺将他们的诉求转达给国民政府。来访者于下午2时离开教育局。

At 7.30 p.m. December 20, students of the Yuen Ming
Yuen Road Branch of the Shanghai University, No.209 Yuen
Ming Yuen Road, held a meeting and decided to form a
students' union under the control of a committee of 15
students. Other resolutions passed at the meeting were as

1. That a telegram be despatched conveying the sympathy and
support of local students to the Peiping students in

2. That statements in the form of circular telegrams be

release of students arrested and issue compensation to
them.
3. That General Chiang Kai-shek be requested to explain

Twenty five principals of local Chinese Universities
held a tiffin party in the Chinese Y.M.C.A. Building, 123
Boulevard de Montigny, at 12.10 p.m. December 20. Mr. Pan
Kung-chai (潘公展), Chief of the Bureau of Education, was
present. The recent student movement in connection with
the political situation in the North was discussed, and it
was decided to issue a circular letter urging local students
to devote all their energy to their studies in order to
save the nation and find practical means to protect the
territorial integrity of the country.

MANIFESTO ISSUED BY THE CENTRAL PROPAGANDA
DEPARTMENT OF THE CHINESE COMMUNIST YOUTH
LEAGUE IN OPPOSITION TO THE AUTONOMY MOVE-
MENT IN NORTH CHINA AND ADVOCATING THE USE
OF MILITARY FORCE FOR THE PROTECTION OF
NORTH CHINA

To countrymen and youths who do not want to be
"countryless slaves" : -

The autonomy movement conducted under the
auspices of the Japanese "robbers" has commenced. Ying
Zu Keng, a puppet of Japan, has formed a bogus "Eastern
Hopei Anti-Communist and Self Control Committee" in
Tungchow. Apart from requesting the authorities of the
five provinces in North China to form an autonomous govern-
ment, he has requested the Japanese troops to attack the
"Red" army. The Military, Naval and Air Forces of Japan,
with their up-to-date armaments, have been despatched to
Tientsin and Peiping. The aim of the Japanese "robbers"
is to occupy the whole of China - not the 22 hsiens in
Eastern Hopei - for use as a base in an attack which they
are planning to make on Soviet troops.

Ying Zu Keng (殷汝耕) is one of the worst
traitors in the employment of the Nanking Government.
He participated in the signing of the agreement which
brought the Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai to an
end, the Tagku Treaty and the agreements for the restoration
of train and mail services between China and "Manchukuo".

North China has been reduced to its present
plight through the policy of the traitor Chiang Kai Shek.
All rights in North China have been sold by him to Japan.
In order to deceive the Chinese people, Chiang Kai Shek

中国共产主义青年团中央宣传部
反对华北自治运动并主张
使用武力保卫华北的宣言

致不愿做“亡国奴”的同胞和青年们：

在日本“强盗”庇护下的自治运动已经开始。日本的傀儡殷汝耕在通州成立了伪“冀东防共自治委员会”。除了要求华北五省当局成立自治政府外，他还请求日军攻击“赤”军。日本的海陆空军及其最新式武器已被派往天津和北平。日本“强盗”的目的不是占领冀东二十二县作为基地，而是占领整个中国，以便策划进攻苏联军队。

殷汝耕是受雇于南京政府的最恶劣的汉奸之一。他参与了结束上海中日敌对行动的协定、《塘沽协定》以及恢复中国与“满洲国”之间火车和邮件服务的协定的签署。

由于卖国贼蒋介石的政策，华北陷入了目前的困境。他将华北的所有权利都出卖给了日本。为了欺骗中国人民，蒋介石

made to establish good relations with the "friendly nations"
provided that the sovereignty of China is preserved and that
he will adhere to his policy of peace until the last light
of hope goes out.

Chiang Kai Shek has transferred more than 100,000
troops from the North to the South of China to prevent the
"Red" army from marching Northwards to resist Japan.
Chiang will continue to sell the territories of the nation
to Japan, and will not resist them. The hope that he
will resist Japan is simply a dream.

Every one of our countrymen now knows that the
Communist Party and the Soviet Army are the strong opponents
of the Chinese traitors and the Japanese. Long before
the war at Jehol and North Hopei the Communist Party
urged that the people be armed in order to protect North
China as well as to oppose Chiang Kai Shek selling North
China to Japan. Its members also gallantly participated
in these wars when broke out.

At present the Communist Party, apart from arousing
the Chinese people to start movements advocating a war with
Japan, has established a strong military base in North Shensi
for the purpose of carrying out hostilities with Japan.
Consequently, the first fight of the puppet organizations
formed by Japan is to suppress the Communists.

The Chinese troops and masses and the "Red" Army
should jointly organize a Soviet Administration to resist
Japan otherwise China will be eliminated. The people in
the 22 hsiens in Eastern Hopei are now suffering from all
kinds of pains because they have been converted to "country-
less slaves". They are slaughtered and robbed by the troops
of Japan and the bogus government. Many die through using
narcotics which are sold in large quantities by Japanese

蒋介石已将十万多名部队从北方调往中国南方，以防止“赤”军北上抗日。蒋将继续把国家领土出卖给日本，而不会抵抗他们。指望他抵抗日本简直是一场梦。

我们的每一位同胞现在都知道，共产党和苏联红军是中国汉奸和日本人的强大对手。早在热河和冀北战争爆发之前，共产党就呼吁武装人民，以保卫华北并反对蒋介石将华北出卖给日本。其成员也在战争爆发时英勇参战。

目前，共产党除了唤起中国人民发起对日作战运动外，还在陕西北部建立了强大的军事基地，旨在对日作战。因此，日本成立的傀儡组织的首要任务就是镇压共产党。

中国军队、民众和“赤”军应联合组织苏维埃政权以抵抗日本，否则中国将被消灭。冀东二十二县的人民现在遭受各种痛苦，因为他们已沦为“亡国奴”。他们遭到日军和伪政府的屠杀和抢劫。许多人因使用由日本

teach the Japanese language.
We advocate:-
1) Suspend work, drilling, business and study
and convene a mass meeting. Stage demonstrations and
dispatch telegrams demanding the suppression of the bogus
"Eastern Hopei Anti-Communist and Self Control Committee",
the execution of Ying Zu Keng, and other traitors, and the
confiscation of their property. Troops and Police constables
should act on their own initiative and drive Japanese
troops and the Paoantui, stationed in the demilitarized
zone, out of North China.
2) Organize a Youth Volunteer Army! All
people should proceed to the North to protect the
country and prevent Chiang Kai Shek from selling North
China to Japan.
3) Officers of the Post Office, Telegram Offices,
and Revenue Offices should refrain from rendering services
to the bogus government. All railway workers should declare
a strike and not transport Japanese troops.
4) Government troops should not attack the
"Red" Army on behalf of Chiang Kai Shek and Ying Zu Keng
and Police constables should not arrest communists and
anti-Japanese elements.
In conclusion we wish to warn the North China
authorities that unless they abandon their anti-Communist
policy, they will be looked upon in the same light as Ying
Zu Keng and will be overthrown by their troops and the
masses. The only way which lies open to them is to join
hands with the "Red" army and oppose Japan, Chiang Kai Shek
and all traitors who betrayed the country.
Long live the CHINESE COMMUNIST PARTY, which is
the sole leader of the anti-Japanese movement of the
Chinese people!
THE CENTRAL PROPAGANDA DEPARTMENT OF THE
CHINESE COMMUNIST YOUTH LEAGUE.
November 27, 1935.

DEMONSTRATION BY STUDENTS : PEIPING

The first demonstration by students in Peiping on
December 9 was held to arouse the righteous indignation of
the Chinese race against the oppression of the Japanese
Imperialists who are cooperating with the local Chinese
traitorous military officers. The demonstration is also
intended to accelerate the general mobilization of the people
to resist the aggression of Japan. The support accorded to
the first demonstration was disappointing, and made the

accordingly, decided to stage another demonstration and made

bullets from the guns of their enemies and the Chinese traitors.
Groups of the students again demonstrated and the sympathy of
the people went out to them. Any one who has seen the
expressions on the faces of the watching crowd could not but
be moved. The second demonstration of the students in

of the bayonets and guns of the military and the police. The
students overcame all obstacles in their path. They were
unarmed but had hot blood in their veins. When police opened
fire on them, they stood unmoved. This shows that they were
prepared to submit to any sacrifice. As a result of the
clash with police, some of the students were arrested and

致公众关于北平学生第二次示威的信

II. SUGIMOTO TENDERS RESIGNATION

Mr. Sugimoto who is relieved of the post
of Acting President of the Japanese Residents' Corporation
following the assumption of office by Mr. ... as
President tendered his resignation on December 20 to the
Corporation. The application was forwarded to the Japanese
Consular Authorities asking for approval of Mr. Sugimoto's
resignation.

III. POLICE

DEMONSTRATIONS ADOPTED BY LOCALS AUTHORITIES

Demonstrations being held by university
students against the autonomous movement in North China
or gradually taking the form of anti-Japanese activities.
At 7 a.m. December 20, a body of university
students marched to the City Government and dispersed
at 8.30 a.m. after having had an interview with Mayor Yu.
This was followed by another group of 700 middle school
students who also marched to the Civic Centre at 10 a.m.
At 3 p.m. a large number of university students assembled
at the Chiao Tung University.
Judging from the situation, it seemed that
the students would hold a second demonstration. In
consequence the local Japanese Consular Police adopted
special precautionary measures at Tung Wen College and
at Japanese residences in the Yangtszepoo Cotton Mill district.

BRITISH SUBJECT AND KOREAN DANCING PARTNER

It will be recalled that a Korean dancing
partner named Kim Kum Nu, aged 29, of the 10 n Palace
was charged with fraud by Wu Chri, aged 37, a British
subject of Chinese extraction, at the Japanese Consular
Police Office. A compromise was however, reached on
December 20, the complainant being satisfied with the
payment of $400 by the defendant.

THE COMPLAINANT OF A ROBBERY CASE DISAPPEARS

In connection with the armed robbery committed
on December 10 by two persons at Room 6, Chung Apartments,
Range Road, occupied by a Korean cereal merchant named
Nan Se Ko, aged 35, when yen 7,000.00 were stolen, no
arrests have so far been effected by the Police. Two
suspects however are being detained at the Japanese
Consulate for investigation. They admitted that Nan Se Ko,
the complainant, was their accomplice in drug dealings.
Having heard of these two persons being sentenced to 25
days' detention on a charge of dealing in drugs, Nan Se Ko
disappeared on December 14, leaving his wife alone in the
apartments. The wife will leave Shanghai for Dairen on
December 21 by the "Dairen Maru".

二、杉本（Sugimoto）提出辞职

随着……先生就任日本居留民团团长，原代理团长杉本先生卸任，并于12月20日向该团提出辞职。该辞职申请已转呈日本领事当局，请求批准杉本先生的辞职。

三、警务

地方当局采取的示威活动

大学生举行的反对华北自治运动的示威活动，正逐渐演变为反日活动。12月20日上午7时，一批大学生游行至市政府，在与俞市长会晤后，于上午8时30分散去。随后，另一批700名中学生也于上午10时游行至市中心。下午3时，大量大学生在交通大学集结。
鉴于局势，学生们似乎将举行第二次示威。因此，日本领事警察在同济学院及杨树浦棉纺厂区的日本人居所采取了特别预防措施。

英籍人士与朝鲜舞伴

据回忆，一名名叫金琴女（Kim Kum Nu，音译）、29岁、任职于“十宫”（10 n Palace，原文不清，疑为场所名）的朝鲜舞伴，被一名37岁的华裔英籍人士吴氏（Wu Chri，音译）在日本领事警察局指控诈骗。然而，双方于12月20日达成和解，原告对被告支付400美元感到满意。

抢劫案原告失踪

关于12月10日两名歹徒在朗格路（Range Road）钟公寓（Chung Apartments）6室实施的持械抢劫案，该房间由35岁的朝鲜粮商南世高（Nan Se Ko，音译）居住，被盗日元7,000.00元，警方迄今尚未逮捕任何人。然而，两名嫌疑犯正被拘留在日本领事馆接受调查。他们承认，原告南世高是他们在毒品交易中的同伙。获悉这两人因贩毒罪名被判处拘留25天后，南世高于12月14日失踪，只留妻子一人在公寓内。其妻将于12月21日乘坐“大连丸”轮离开上海前往大连。

December 21, 1935. Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.
Appeal Made By Students of Local Universities And Middle
Schools To The City Government.

At 4 p.m. December 19, about 6,000 students of the various local universities and middle schools assembled on the premises of the Chiaotung University and appointed their own presidium. At 9 p.m. they left the Chiaotung University and arrived at the Futan University at 3 a.m. December 20. Here they remained for some time, after which they continued their procession towards the Civic Centre, arriving there at about 5.30 a.m.

The students were received by Mayor Wu Teh Chen who earnestly advised them to observe strict order in their patriotic movements so as to avoid giving rise to other incidents that would only harass the Government in coping with the present difficulties. Mayor Wu also expressed his sincere desire that the students would not neglect their studies on account of their patriotic movement.

The students were greatly moved by Mayor Wu's speech. The presidium of the students then submitted to the Mayor a written petition containing the following seven demands :-
(1) That the Mayor be requested to send a telegram to the National Government requesting it to place a check on the oppression of the patriotic movement of the students by the military and political authorities in Peiping.
(2) That the National Government be requested to start a punitive campaign against the rebel, Yin Zu Keng, immediately.
(3) That the National Government be requested to protect the territorial integrity and sovereignty of China.
(4) That the National Government be requested to enforce a drastic revolutionary diplomacy.
(5) That the Mayor effect the immediate release of Lee Chung Sing(李震聲), a student of the Chiaotung University, who has been arrested.
(6) That the Mayor be requested to afford protection to the patriotic movement in Shanghai.
(7) That the National Government be requested to grant freedom of speech and assembly.

In reply, Mayor Wu said that he would afford every protection to the patriotic movement in Shanghai as long as it was conducted in an orderly manner. Mayor Wu added that Lee Chung Sing of the Chiaotung University had not been arrested and that he had only been summoned by the Public Safety Bureau simply for interrogation because he was under suspicion owing to the finding of a letter, and that he had been told to return to his school after interrogation. Mayor Wu promised to refer the other requests of the students to the National Government.

The students were satisfied with Mayor Wu's reply and dispersed at about 9 a.m. December 20.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

反对华北自治运动的煽动。
本地大学和中学生向市政府发出呼吁。

12月19日下午4时，本地各大学和中学的约6,000名学生聚集在交通大学校内，并推选了自己的主席团。晚上9时，他们离开交通大学，于12月20日凌晨3时抵达复旦大学。在此停留一段时间后，他们继续向市中心游行，于上午5时30分左右到达。

学生们受到吴铁城市长的接见，他恳切劝告学生在爱国运动中严守秩序，以免引发其他事件，使政府在应对当前困难时更加棘手。吴市长还真诚地希望学生不要因为爱国运动而荒废学业。

学生们深受吴市长讲话的感动。随后，学生主席团向市长提交了一份书面请愿书，包含以下七项要求：
(1) 请市长致电国民政府，要求制止北平军政当局对学生爱国运动的压迫。
(2) 请国民政府立即对叛逆殷汝耕（Yin Zu Keng）发起讨伐战役。
(3) 请国民政府保护中国的领土完整和主权。
(4) 请国民政府实行彻底的革命外交。
(5) 请市长立即释放已被捕的交通大学学生李震声。
(6) 请市长保护上海的爱国运动。
(7) 请国民政府给予言论和集会自由。

作为回应，吴市长表示，只要爱国运动有序进行，他将提供一切保护。吴市长补充说，交通大学的李震声并未被捕，只是因为发现一封信件而有嫌疑，被公安局传唤问话，问话后已被告知返回学校。吴市长承诺将学生的其他请求转呈国民政府。

学生对吴市长的答复表示满意，并于12月20日上午9时左右散去。

December 21, 1935. Morning Translation.

Classes Opening In Various Schools As Usual To-Day.

There is no suspension of studies in any of the various schools in this locality. The students who participated in the appeal have attended their classes as usual.

According to information secured from local educational circles, the procession and appeal made yesterday by students of various local universities and middle schools is a general demonstration of their patriotic movement. They have decided not to suspend their studies and not to make any more appeals, in order to avoid neglecting their studies and giving rise to other disputes. They place full confidence in the Government in the handling of the situation.

Meeting Of Presidents Of Various Local Universities And Colleges.

At noon yesterday, the Presidents of various local universities and colleges held a tiffin party in the Chinese Y.M.C.A., Boulevard de Montigny. Mr. Pan Kung Chan, Commissioner of the local Bureau of Education was also present. It was resolved to address the following open letter to the students :-

"Since the outbreak of the North China problem, the students in various districts of China have demonstrated their patriotic movements. Yesterday the students of local universities also made an appeal to the City Government and their demands have been fully accepted by the Mayor who promised to refer them to the National Government. Hereafter, the students should work hard and prepare for practical strength in order to share the important task of saving the country. We earnestly hope that our Government will determine to maintain the territorial integrity and sovereignty of China, and that it will not compromise any more."

Reply Of The Peiping City Government To A Telegram Sent By The Local City Government.

Yesterday the Peiping City Government sent a reply to the local City Government stating that all the arrested students had been released and that medical treatment had been given to those who had been wounded.

An Open Letter Issued To The Local Students By Mayor Wu Teh Chen.

Yesterday Mayor Wu Teh Chen issued the following open letter to the entire body of the local students :-

"During the last few days several thousand students of the local universities and colleges, being distressed over the national crisis, have called at the Shanghai City Government. Their patriotic spirit is indeed worthy of public sympathy. Apart from expressing our deepest respect for their patriotic feelings, we feel however very worried in respect to the trouble they went to in travelling such a long distance till daybreak during such cold weather.

1935年12月21日。晨间译本。

今日各校照常上课。

本地各学校均未停课。参加呼吁活动的学生已照常上课。

根据从本地教育界获得的消息，昨天本地各大学和中学生的游行和呼吁是他们爱国运动的一次普遍示威。他们决定不停课，也不再举行任何呼吁活动，以避免荒废学业和引发其他纠纷。他们对政府处理局势充满信心。

本地各大学校长会议。

昨天中午，本地各大学校长在蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）基督教青年会举行午餐会。本地教育局局长潘公展先生也出席了会议。会议决议向学生发表如下公开信：

“自从华北问题爆发以来，中国各地的学生展示了他们的爱国运动。昨天，本地大学的学生也向市政府发出呼吁，他们的要求已得到市长的充分接受，市长承诺将其转呈国民政府。此后，学生应努力学习，积蓄实际力量，以分担救国的重要任务。我们殷切希望我国政府决心维护中国的领土完整和主权，不再妥协。”

北平市政府对本地市政府电报的回复。

昨天，北平市政府向本地市政府发来回复，称所有被捕学生均已释放，受伤者已得到医疗救治。

吴铁城市长向本地学生发出的公开信。

昨天，吴铁城市长向本地全体学生发布了以下公开信：

“连日来，本地各大学的数千名学生因国家危机而忧心忡忡，前往上海市政府。他们的爱国精神确实值得公众同情。除了对他们的爱国情怀表示最深切的敬意外，我们也对他们在这种寒冷天气下长途跋涉直至天亮所受的劳苦感到非常担忧。

"In view of such circumstances, I
feel extremely uneasy and I have lost no time in taking
into consideration the safety, and the school curriculum
of the local students. Under the present conditions,
I commend the following points for the consideration
of the local students upon whom the future of the
Chinese race is dependent:-
"It is indeed a great misfortune to
China that she is at present being faced with an acute
crisis. However, we must know that such a national
crisis is not caused in a day or a night. It is caused
by the complicated conditions which have been prevalent
for a number of years. Therefore, the work of our
national salvation and self-preservation constitute the
most difficult and the most important task in the world.
It requires the concentrated efforts of the entire
Chinese nation to develop the latent energy for national
preservation with a view to reviving the Chinese race.
What we should do in serving our country is to struggle
permanently with determination and concentrated efforts,
and not to resort to short burst of enthusiasm.
"The National Government has already
settled on a definite diplomatic policy. This has
already been announced by the authorities. The Government
is at present paying special attention towards its
important task, the North China, and the necessity of
preserving our territorial sovereignty and the integral
rights. It is now devising all possible means to deal
with these serious questions. The Government will
certainly regard the maintenance of our national privileges
as its chief duty. However, in view of the weakness of
our nation, we cannot eliminate these difficulties in
a day. This should be clearly understood by the entire
Chinese nation who should do their utmost to back up the
Government, so as to enable them to deal effectively with
the present crisis.
"This City Government has already
forwarded the suggestion of the local students to the
Central Authorities. It is urged that all the Chinese
youths will remain patient and adopt a calm attitude
in supporting the National Government to handle the
present affairs. They should not get excited and create
scenes by empty enthusiasm, thereby hindering the
Government and increasing the difficulties of the
authorities.
"The degree of my love for the country is
not less than that of the people in the country. The
national salvation movement for the past years has an
undeniable weak point, that is to say that the people
have a mistaken idea about their work. The people have
used their energies in a wrong way, thereby being
unsuccessful. This is the reason why the movement of
the people for the past years for the emancipation of our
race met with failure. Even the people's movement was
utilized by a minority of undesirable elements who had
certain motives.
"Following the great defeat of Germany in
1806, Fichte, the patriotic and wise German, sincerely
warned the German people as follows:-

1935年12月21日。晨间译件。

“鉴于此种情形，我深感不安，并立即着手考虑本地学生的安全及学校课程问题。在目前的情况下，我向那些肩负着中华民族未来命运的本地学生提出以下几点建议，供其考量：——
“中国目前面临严峻危机，这确是中国的一大不幸。然而，我们必须认识到，这样的民族危机并非一朝一夕所致。它是多年来普遍存在的复杂局势所造成的。因此，我们的救国自救工作构成了世界上最艰巨、最重要的任务。这需要全中华民族集中努力，发掘保存国家的潜在力量，以期复兴中华民族。我们报效国家所应做的，是以坚定的决心和集中的努力进行持久的斗争，而不是诉诸于一时的热情冲动。
“国民政府已确定了明确的外交政策。当局已对此予以公布。政府目前正特别关注其重要任务，即华北问题，以及维护我国领土主权和完整权利的必要性。政府正在 devising（筹划）各种可能的手段来处理这些严重问题。政府必将把维护我国民族权益视为其主要职责。然而，鉴于我国国力薄弱，我们无法在一天之内消除这些困难。全体中国人民应清楚地理解这一点，并应尽最大努力支持政府，使其能够有效应对当前的危机。
“本市政府已将本地学生的建议转呈中央当局。恳请所有中国青年保持耐心，采取冷静的态度，支持国民政府处理当前事务。他们不应因空虚的热情而激动闹事，从而阻碍政府工作并增加当局的困难。
“我对国家的热爱程度不亚于国内任何民众。过去几年的救国运动存在一个不可否认的弱点，也就是说，民众对其工作存在误解。民众错误地使用了他们的精力，从而导致失败。这就是为什么过去几年民众争取民族解放的运动遭遇失败的原因。甚至民众运动还被少数怀有特定动机的不良分子所利用。
“继1806年德国惨败之后，爱国且睿智的德国人费希特（Fichte）曾真诚地警告德国人民如下：——

December 21, 1935. Morning Translation.

'The defeat of Germany to-day was brought about
by the general bad manners of all our German people
in every day life. The future wars will be those
in which character, morality and knowledge will
count most'.
"Now! You awakening youths in this city!
Don't forget the example laid down by Germany, but remember
the advice of this wise German. You must refrain from
being inconsistant, going off at a tangent, resorting to
extremes, acting contrary to law, holding processions
or suspending studies. You must do your best in making
preparations for an 'intellectual war' in order to
struggle for the final victory of our people as well as to
ensure the life of China".

Chen Pao and other local newspapers:

COMMERCIAL CONCERNS NOT ALLOWED TO ACT AS SAVINGS BANKS

Information secured from the Shanghai Office
of the Ministry of Finance shows that the Ministry is
placing a strict control on savings banks as the existence
of the poor people of the community is to a large extent
dependent on their savings. Banks are not allowed to
indulge in savings business unless approval has been
obtained from the Ministry. Common commercial concerns,
however, absorb deposits daily under the false name of
savings; this is contrary to law. Furthermore, it is not
known how much capital these concerns have or what business
they do with the savings received. Poor people will
suffer considerably should these concerns lose money or
go bankrupt.
In 1930, the Ministry of Finance issued a
circular order to provincial and city governments in the
country notifying them to prohibit commercial concerns
from receiving deposits and doing savings business.
Reports have now been received that certain commercial
concerns are still receiving deposits. The Ministry of
Finance has now again instructed the provincial and city
governments repeating this order.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers:

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT

Upon receipt of instructions from General Chiang
Kai Shek to the effect that a petition be submitted to the
Shanghai City Government, the Executive & Supervisory
Committees of the Shanghai Rent Reduction Movement Committee
held a joint meeting at which it was resolved that Zung
Chien Peo (曾劍波), Sung Sin Ngoo (宋心撫) and some
ten other representatives be dispatched to make an appeal
on the morning of December 21 to the Shanghai City Government
for an immediate order for a reduction in house rents.
At a meeting held yesterday by the Shanghai
Rent Reduction Movement Committee, it was resolved that a
propaganda meeting of the rent reduction movement be held
on December 29 at the premises of the Nan Fong Theatre
(南方歌劇院), Avenue Edward VII and that posters containing
slogans regarding the rent reduction movement be posted
throughout the whole locality.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

禁止商行充当储蓄银行

从财政部上海办事处获得的消息显示，财政部正对储蓄银行实施严格管控，因为社区贫民的生计在很大程度上依赖于他们的储蓄。除非获得财政部的批准，否则银行不得从事储蓄业务。然而，普通商行却以储蓄的名义每日吸收存款；这是违法的。此外，人们不知道这些商行拥有多少资本，或者它们如何处理收到的储蓄款项。如果这些商行亏损或破产，贫民将遭受巨大损失。
1930年，财政部向全国各省市县政府发出通令，通知他们禁止商行接收存款和从事储蓄业务。目前收到报告称，某些商行仍在接收存款。财政部现已再次指示各省市县政府，重申此命令。

《顺报》及其他本地报纸：

减租运动

接到蒋介石将军关于向上海市政府提交请愿书的指示后，上海减租运动委员会的执行委员会和监督委员会召开联席会议，决议派遣曾劍波（Zung Chien Peo）、宋心撫（Sung Sin Ngoo）及其他十余名代表，于12月21日上午前往上海市政府请愿，要求立即下令降低房租。
在上海减租运动委员会昨日举行的会议上，决议于12月29日在爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII）的南方歌劇院（Nan Fong Theatre）举行减租运动宣传大会，并在整个地区张贴包含减租运动标语的海报。

Preparations for demonstration by local students
against the autonomy movement in North China

During the afternoon of December 19 about 400 students
of the Chinan University held a meeting in the university
premises at Chenju in order to discuss the course of action
they should follow in connection with the conciliatory
attitude adopted by the National Government towards the
autonomy movement in the North. As a precautionary measure
against interference by the university authorities, the
students severed all the telephone connections and placed
pickets at the various entrances to prevent the teaching
staff from leaving. Resolutions were passed that a Chinan
University National Salvation Association be formed, and
that those present march to the Civic Centre, Kiangwan, to
stage a demonstration and submit the following five demands:-

本地学生针对华北自治运动的示威准备

12月19日下午，约400名暨南大学（Chinan University）学生在真如（Chenju）的校内举行会议，讨论针对国民政府对华北自治运动采取的妥协态度应采取的行动方针。作为防范校方干涉的预防措施，学生们切断了所有电话线路，并在各个入口设置纠察队，防止教职员工离开。会议通过决议，成立暨南大学救国会，并决定在场人员游行至江湾（Kiangwan）市中心，举行示威并提交以下五项要求：-

pages.en:
December 20, 1935.

- 2 -

1) That the autonomy movement in the North be opposed.
2) That the students arrested in Peiping be released.
3) That the diplomatic negotiations being conducted by
the National Government be made public.
4) That an expedition be despatched to punish Ying Ju-keng,
the promoter of the autonomy movement.
5) That freedom of speech, press and organization be
accorded to the people.

The meeting concluded at 4.30 p.m. The entire body
of students then left the university and marched along Chung
San Road, shouting slogans such as "Down with the Traitors,"
"Down with Imperialism," and "Rise up and save the country."
They visited the Great China University, Chung San Road,
the Kwang Hwa University, Great Western Road, and the Kiaotung
University, Avenue Haig, O.O.L., and large parties of students
from each of these establishments joined them. The process-
ion left the Kiaotung University, Avenue Haig, about 9.20 p.m.
and marched via Amherst Avenue, Keswick Road and the road
between Jessfield Park and the railway to the Soochow Creek
which they crossed by the Chung Sen Road Bridge. It is
estimated that there were 4,000 people in the procession
including about 500 females when the creek was crossed. They
carried banners bearing slogans condemning the autonomy move-
ment in North China. After leaving the territory west of
the Settlement, the procession continued through Northern
Chapei along Chung San Road to the Fuh Tan University at
Kiangwan, which was reached about 4 a.m. December 20.

The processionists, who had by this time increased to
nearly 5,000, halted temporarily at this point and conferred
pages.zh:

- 2 -

1) 反对华北自治运动。
2) 释放北平被捕的学生。
3) 公开国民政府正在进行的外交谈判。
4) 派遣远征军惩办自治运动倡导者殷汝耕（Ying Ju-keng）。
5) 赋予人民言论、出版和结社自由。

会议于下午4时30分结束。全体学生随后离开大学，沿中山路行进，高呼“打倒汉奸”、“打倒帝国主义”和“起来救国”等口号。他们访问了位于中山路的大夏大学（Great China University）、位于大西路（Great Western Road）的光华大学（Kwang Hwa University）以及位于海格路（Avenue Haig）的交通大学（Kiaotung University），这些学校的众多学生加入了他们的行列。游行队伍于晚上9时20分左右离开海格路的交通大学，经安赫斯特路（Amherst Avenue）、基威克路（Keswick Road）以及静安寺路公园（Jessfield Park）与铁路之间的道路，行进至苏州河，并通过中山路桥过河。据估计，过河时游行队伍中有4000人，其中包括约500名女性。他们携带谴责华北自治运动的标语横幅。离开租界以西区域后，游行队伍继续沿中山路穿过闸北北部，前往位于江湾的复旦大学（Fuh Tan University），于12月20日凌晨4时左右抵达。

此时人数已增至近5000人的游行队伍在此暂时停留，并商议

pages.en:
December 20, 1935.

- 3 -

as to whether they would remain there or continue to the
Civic Centre. The majority voted in favour of carrying on
and at 4.30 a.m. they resumed their way arriving at the
Civic Centre at 5.30 a.m. Slogans of a patriotic character
were shouted by the students as they were approaching the
Civic Centre, and shouts of an anti-Japanese nature are also
said to have been uttered at intervals by a small percentage
of the crowd.

After waiting outside the building until 8.30 a.m.
the students were interviewed by Mayor Wu Teh-chen, to whom
they presented the following demands :-

1) That an assurance be given by the Mayor to afford
protection to the Students' National Salvation Movement.

2) That the student arrested in Chapei during the procession
be released and that the "traitor" responsible for his
arrest be punished.

3) That an expedition be sent to suppress the autonomy
movement in the North and bring the traitor Ying Ju-keng
to justice.

4) That the autonomy movement in the North be opposed.

5) That diplomatic negotiations being conducted by the
National Government be made public.

6) That the students arrested in Peiping be released and
that persons responsible for their arrests be punished.

Mayor Wu promised to refer their demands to the National
Government. The students expressed satisfaction with this
reply. On giving further thought to the matter, they
however decided to endeavour to bring about a general
suspension of studies in local schools and to have the strike
continued until the demands have been complied with. Some
of the students broke up into groups about 9.15 a.m. and
wended their way towards their various schools. The bulk
of them, however, remained in the Civic Centre and were

4) 反对华北自治运动。

5) 公开国民政府正在进行的外交谈判。

6) 释放北平被捕的学生，并惩罚负责逮捕他们的人员。

still there at 10 a.m. Parties of students from the

Opposition to the Autonomy Movement - Fuh Tan University
students submit demands to Mayor Wu at Civic Centre

At 3.30 p.m. December 19, four hundred students of the
Fuh Tan University, Kiangwan, gathered outside the offices
of the City Government at the Civic Centre and submitted
the following demands to Mayor Wu Teh-chen :-

1) That the autonomy movement in North be suppressed and
the traitor Ying Ju-keng be punished.

2) That the Government order the release of students
arrested for opposing the autonomy movement.

The Mayor promised to refer their demands to the
National Government and to give them a reply later. He
also urged the demonstrators to return to the University
and resume their studies. The students expressed their
satisfaction with the reply and left the Civic Centre
at 4.30 p.m. They then marched along various streets in
Chapei, shouting slogans such as "Down with Imperialism"
and "Down with Traitors." They returned to the university
at 8 p.m.

On December 19, representatives of the students of the
Ming Lih Middle School (民立中学), 866 Chung Hwa Road, Nantao,
called at various middle schools in Nantao with a view to
soliciting assistance in organizing a "Federation of Middle
School Students for National Salvation."

上午10时仍在那里。来自三个特别市各区域的学生队伍仍在步行及乘坐卡车前往市中心，目的是加入示威者行列。

反对自治运动——复旦大学学生向吴市长在市中心提交请愿书

12月19日下午3时30分，江湾复旦大学四百名学生聚集在市中心市政府办公室外，并向吴铁城市长提交了以下要求：-

1) 镇压北方的自治运动，并惩办汉奸殷汝耕。

2) 政府下令释放因反对自治运动而被捕的学生。

December , 19 .

- Anti-Japanese incident in Pootung
It is reported that the students of Pootung Middle
School, 200 Loh Li Jao, Pootung, manhandled a Chinese named
Ting ( 丁 ) who was visiting a friend in the school. Ting
was rescued by members of the Public Safety Bureau who
escorted him to the nearest Police Station. It is rumoured
that Ting, who is a returned student from Japan, was attacked
because a rumour circulated among the students that he had
come to spy upon them on behalf of the Japanese.

- Behaviour of student demonstrators
The students who participated in the marching in the
Western District, O.O.L. on December 19 and the demonstration
at the Civic Centre on the early morning of December 20
behaved in an orderly manner.
The students who proceeded to the Civic Centre on the
morning of December 20 for the purpose of demonstrating had
all dispersed at 11 a.m. with the exception of about 1,000
who consisted almost entirely of late arrivals.

- Incidents connected with student demonstration
At 10.30 a.m. December 20, about 1,000 students of
middle schools in Nantao assembled at the Nan Yang Jao Gate
of the French Concession, Boulevard de Montigny, seeking
admission to the Concession with a view to proceeding to
Kiangwan via the Settlement. On being refused entry by
the French Police, they proceeded in a westerly direction
through Chinese controlled territory to Chung San Road.

据报，浦东罗家角200号浦东中学的学生殴打了一名名叫丁 (Ting) 的中国人，当时他正在该校拜访朋友。丁被公共安全局成员解救，并被护送至最近的警察局。谣传丁是一名留日归国学生，之所以遭到攻击，是因为学生中间流传着他代表日本人来监视他们的谣言。

- 学生示威者的行为
12月19日参与西区 (Western District) 游行的学生，以及12月20日凌晨在市中心进行示威的学生，行为井然有序。
12月20日上午前往市中心进行示威的学生，除约1000人（几乎全为迟到者）外，其余均已于上午11时散去。

- 与学生示威有关的事件
12月20日上午10时30分，约1000名南市中学生聚集在法租界蒙太尼路 (Boulevard de Montigny) 的南阳桥门，试图进入租界，以便经由公共租界前往江湾。在被法国警察拒绝入境后，他们穿过中国管辖区域向西行进至中山路。

December 29, 1935.

- 7 -

Slogan writing

Slogans in the Chinese language, "Down with Imperialism"
and "Down with Japan" were chalked on a wall near the West
Gate of the Hongkew Park on Kiangwan Road during the early
morning of December 20.

Labour.

Dispute between the Management and workers of the
Sing Dah Flour Mill

The situation at the Sing Dah Flour Mill remains
unchanged this morning, December 20. The workers remained
at the mill during the night of December 19/20, and the
management has now agreed to provide food for them while
they remain on the mill premises. Negotiations were
conducted between the management and eight representatives
of the workers on December 19 which resulted in the workers
reducing their demand for retiring gratuities from two
months' pay and $48.00 to two months' pay and $46.00 and
the management increasing its offer from two months' pay
and $8.00 to two months' pay and $20.00. Negotiations
will be continued to-day, and it is now considered possible
that the dispute will be settled in the near future.

劳工。

新达面粉厂资方与工人之间的纠纷

截至12月20日上午，新达面粉厂 (Sing Dah Flour Mill) 的局势保持不变。工人在12月19/20日夜期间留在厂内，资方现已同意在他们滞留厂区期间为他们提供食物。12月19日，资方与八名工人代表进行了谈判，结果是工人将遣散费要求从两个月工资加48.00美元降至两个月工资加46.00美元，而资方则将报价从两个月工资加8.00美元提高至两个月工资加20.00美元。谈判将于今日继续，目前认为该纠纷有可能在不久的将来得到解决。

December 20, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

The original purport of the Neutrality Law is to avoid America from being involved in a European war. America's imaginary enemy at present is not in Europe but in the Far East. At the time of the opening of the Naval Conference, America discovered a plan by which Japan would attempt to bombard her cities. Mr. Pittman, Chairman of the Diplomatic Commission, accused a certain nation in the Far East of being robbers. All this shows the deep concern displayed by the government and people of America over the question of Oriental Affairs as well as their hatred towards the aggressor. Should this Neutrality Law not be revised, then America will not be able to supply munitions to the oppressed nation. This will be contrary to America's policy and harmful to the world peace.

With the prospects of the Naval Conference gradually growing dim, the diplomatic relations between America and Japan are coming to an unprecedented crisis. America has made drastic preparations in her military affairs with the approach of the year 1936, but she is not yet ready diplomatically. The proposed revision of the Neutrality Law may be America's move to prepare herself diplomatically.

Chinese Saturday Post (礼拜六) published the following comment on December 14:-

OPPOSITION TO THE AUTONOMY IN THE NORTH

The establishment of the new political organization in the North, an autonomous form of political regime under disguise, is an expansion of the autonomy movement achieved by Yin Ju Keng. We must understand exactly how much our government had conceded and how disgraceful the surrender is. The so-called measures for the stability of the situation in North China discussed by and agreed upon between General Ho Yin Chin, who is responsible for conducting the negotiations over the North China problem, and General Sung Cheh Yuen, are really those that deprive the general public of their benefits. We do not know where the so-called suitable measures are that have been drawn up by our government, where the courage of General Ho Yin Chin is and how those political officers will be able to face the people who have been deceived and betrayed. The so-called "unification for the salvation of the nation" and the so-called "resistance against foreign insult" are all humbug.

The Hopei-Chahar Political Council is entirely an independent institution. In other words, these two provinces will be converted into a republic for the Japanese military base and traitors to occupy. The Sovereign Rights in these two provinces will not belong to China. The Chinese Government has had a previous example of such concessions and it can never be ensured that no further similar incidents will happen in South China or Central China. China as a consequence will be faced with ruin in the near future. 1935年12月20日。下午译文。

《中立法》的原意是避免美国卷入欧洲战争。美国目前的假想敌不在欧洲，而在远东。在海军会议召开之际，美国发现了一项日本企图轰炸其城市的计划。外交委员会主席皮特曼先生指责远东某国为强盗。所有这些表明，美国政府和人民对东方事务问题深感关切，并对侵略者怀有仇恨。如果不修订这部《中立法》，美国将无法向受压迫的国家提供军火。这将违背美国的政策，并有害于世界和平。

随着海军会议的前景逐渐黯淡，美日外交关系正面临前所未有的危机。随着1936年的临近，美国在军事事务上已做了激烈的准备，但在外交上尚未准备好。拟议中的《中立法》修订案可能是美国在外交上进行准备的举措。

《礼拜六》(Chinese Saturday Post) 于12月14日发表了如下评论：-

反对北方自治

在北方建立新的政治组织，即伪装下的自治政体，是殷汝耕实现的自治运动的扩张。我们必须确切了解我们的政府做出了多少让步，这种投降是多么可耻。所谓负责处理华北问题的何应钦将军与宋哲元将军之间讨论并同意的稳定华北局势的措施，实际上是剥夺公众利益的措施。我们不知道我国政府制定的所谓适当措施在哪里，何应钦将军的勇气在哪里，那些政治官员将如何面对被欺骗和背叛的人民。所谓的“统一救国”和所谓的“抵抗外侮”全是胡扯。

冀察政务委员会完全是一个独立的机构。换句话说，这两个省将被转化为供日本军事基地和汉奸占据的共和国。这两省的主权不属于中国。中国政府此前已有此类让步的先例，无法保证华南或华中不会发生类似的进一步事件。因此，中国在不久的将来将面临毁灭。在北方建立新政权事先获得了土肥原 (Doihara) 的批准，所有亲日的封建分子随后都受邀在该政权中任职，但须服从

The "Shanghai Party Voice" (上海党声), a weekly magazine,
dated Dec. 14:

SINO-JAPANESE RELATIONS IN NORTH CHINA.

Following the September 18 Incident, Japan seized
China's four North-eastern provinces, but yet she was not
contented. The Shanghai-Woosung Truce and the Tangku
Pact were concluded and still Japan thought that China
had not yet been humiliated to the extreme. So, she
instigated the creation of the so-called "Autonomy
Movement in North China."
Formerly, Japan was of the opinion that had she
not obtained Manchuria, she would be unable to exist, and
now she is claiming that the safety of Manchuria will not
be assured, if she does not secure North China. But, will
Japan remain calm and contented even when she possesses
North China? We expect to hear the words "The safety
of North China will not be possible if Japan cannot get
control of the Yangtse Valley" and finally we shall be
told that "the existence of the Japanese Imperial Empire
will not be secure, if Japan cannot get the whole of
China." Is it possible that Japan can win the hearts of
the Chinese people or the Government's endurance of insults
in this way? Such measures are not signs of "good
Sino-Japanese relations" or "rapprochement," but steps
adopted to destroy China and render her a second Liu Jeu
(琉球), Formosa, or Korea.
North China is the centre of Chinese culture
as well as the place where our Chinese race originated.
We are convinced that the four hundred million Chinese
people will offer all they have to assist the Government
if the latter will only take steps, no matter what they may
be, to protect North China. The Government has the
authority to order the people to be patient regarding the
North China affair or to call upon the people to sacrifice
themselves on account of the North China affair, as they wish.
Some time ago General Chiang Kai Shek, Chairman of
the Military Affairs Commission, announced that every effort
was to be made towards ensuring peace if there was a
possibility of bringing peace about. Now that there is
still a ray of hope for peace, it is time for the
Government to offer their final and best endeavours as well
as for the people to unite and to support the Government.
We can definitely say that the Chinese Government and its
people will pay great attention to this ray of hope for
peace, and use their best endeavours to succeed.

1935年12月20日。
下午译文。

日本的命令。除非我们完全无视中国主权和领土的完整，否则绝不应允许这样的新政权在北方存在。
代表所有爱国群众，我们在此向政府提出以下要求：-
1) 反对在北方建立实质上是自治组织的新政权。
2) 恢复人民运动的所有自由。
3) 致力于救国。

周刊《上海党声》(Shanghai Party Voice)，12月14日刊：

华北的中日关系。

继九一八事变之后，日本夺取了中国东北四省，但仍不满足。《淞沪停战协定》和《塘沽协定》相继签订，但日本仍认为中国尚未受到极致的羞辱。因此，它煽动制造了所谓的“华北自治运动”。
以前，日本认为如果不获得满洲，就无法生存；现在它声称，如果不 securing 华北，满洲的安全就无法得到保障。但是，即使日本拥有华北，它会保持冷静和满足吗？我们预计会听到这样的话：“如果日本不能控制长江流域，华北的安全就不可能实现”，最后我们会被告知：“如果日本不能获得整个中国，大日本帝国的存在就不安全。”日本能否以这种方式赢得中国人民的心，或者让政府忍受侮辱？这些措施不是“中日亲善”或“和解”的迹象，而是旨在摧毁中国并使其成为第二个琉球 (Liu Jeu)、台湾或朝鲜的步骤。
华北是中国文化的中心，也是我们中华民族的发源地。我们坚信，只要政府采取任何措施保护华北，四亿中国人民将倾其所有协助政府。政府有权命令人民在华北问题上保持耐心，或号召人民因华北问题而牺牲，悉听尊便。
不久前，军事委员会委员长蒋介石宣布，如果有实现和平的可能性，将尽一切努力确保和平。既然和平仍有一线希望，现在是政府做出最终和最大努力以及人民团结支持政府的时候了。我们可以肯定地说，中国政府和人民将高度重视这一线和平希望，并尽最大努力取得成功。
