December 20, 1935. Morning Translation.

Sin Wen Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

Futan University Students Make Appeal To The City Government.

At 2 p.m. yesterday, about 200 to 300 students of the Futan University marched in a body to the local City Government to submit an appeal. The procession was orderly. On the way the students shouted slogans: "Support the National Government", "Oppose the bogus autonomy in North China", etc. On arrival at the City Government, they stood in front of the building. They were received by Mayor Wu Teh Chen in person, to whom the students' representatives submitted an appeal in writing containing the following five requests :-
(1) That a telegram be sent asking the Peiping Authorities to release the arrested students and to issue compensation to wounded students.
(2) That protection be accorded to the students' patriotic movement.
(3) That severe punishment be meted out to military and police officers for having oppressed the movement conducted by the Peiping students.
(4) That the new organization in the disguise of autonomy in North China be opposed.
(5) That the National Government start a campaign against the rebels.

Mayor Wu replied to the five requests and also directed the students to strictly observe order and not to neglect their studies. The students were satisfied with Mayor Wu's reply and also took his advice, whereupon they left and returned to their school.

On their way back to their school, the students shouted the following slogans :-
(1) Support the National Government.
(2) Support the Chinese Kuomintang Party.
(3) Down with the bogus autonomy in North China.
(4) Assist our fellow students in Peiping.
(5) Demand protection for the students' patriotic movement.
(6) Demand the punishment of the military and police officers in Peiping for having caused the incident.
(7) Long live the Chinese Kuomintang Party.
(8) Long live the Chinese Republic.

Telegram Sent By Mayor Wu To The Peiping City Government.

Yesterday Mayor Wu sent the following telegram to the Peiping City Government :-
"To-day the students of the Futan University in Shanghai make an appeal to this Government and demand that a telegram be sent asking you to release the arrested students and to accord medical treatment to those wounded students. You are therefore requested to release the arrested students, if any, and to accord medical treatment to wounded students, in order to comply with the wishes of the people."

（批：L.7108）

1935年12月20日。晨间译件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

反对华北自治运动之 agitation。

复旦大学学生向市政府请愿。

昨日下午2时，复旦大学学生约二三百人结队前往本市市政府提交请愿书。游行队伍秩序井然。途中学生高呼口号：“拥护国民政府”、“反对华北伪自治”等。抵达市政府后，他们在大楼前伫立。吴铁城市长亲自接见，学生代表向其递交书面请愿书，内含以下五项请求：-
(1) 致电北平当局，要求释放被捕学生，并对受伤学生给予赔偿。
(2) 保护学生的爱国运动。
(3) 严惩镇压北平学生运动的军警官员。
(4) 反对假借自治之名在华北成立的新组织。
(5) 国民政府发起讨伐叛逆之战役。

吴市长对五项请求作了答复，并指示学生严格遵守秩序，不可荒废学业。学生对吴市长的答复表示满意，并听从其建议，随即离开返回学校。

在返校途中，学生高呼以下口号：-
(1) 拥护国民政府。
(2) 拥护中国国民党。
(3) 打倒华北伪自治。
(4) 援助北平同学。
(5) 要求保护学生爱国运动。
(6) 要求惩办酿成此事的北平军警官员。
(7) 中国国民党万岁。
(8) 中华民国万岁。

吴市长致北平市政府之电报。

昨日吴市长向北平市政府发出如下电报：-
“今日上海复旦大学学生向本政府请愿，并要求致电贵方，请求释放被捕学生，并对受伤学生给予医疗救治。因此，请贵方释放任何被捕学生，并对受伤学生给予医疗救治，以顺从民意。”

（批：L.7108）

December 20, 1935. Morning Translation.

Students Of Other Universities To Express Their Views To-Day.

It is reported that students of the Chi Tsz University(持志大学), the Law College(法学院), the Chinan University(暨南大学), the Great China University(大夏大学), the Kwang Hwa University(光華大学), the Chiaotung University (交通大學), the Soochow University(東吳大學) and other universities will also express their views to-day.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram) :-

Ministry Of Education Instructs Education Bureaux To Advise Students Not To Suspend Studies, Not to Stage Processions And Not To Make Appeals.

On December 19, the Ministry of Education again sent telegrams to the Education Bureaux in Peiping, Tientsin, Nanking and Shanghai, instructing them to advise the students not to suspend their studies, not to stage processions and not to make appeals, but to offer their opinions in writing to their competent authorities, if they have any such regarding political and current affairs.

Communists Alleged To Be Instigating The Student Risings In The North.

Commenting on the students' movement in Peiping, the Sin Wan Pao (Evening Edition) states :-
According to statements made by the Peiping Authorities as published in the newspapers, the Communists are accused of being at the back of the patriotic movement started by the students. We are at a loss to understand on what ground this observation is based. In the defunct Ching Dynasty and in the past militarists' regime, any assembly or appeal made by the people was instantly branded as having been instigated by the Communists, and thus more misunderstandings arose and more disputes followed. We hope that the district authorities of to-day will analyse the facts of the case clearly and calmly and will accord adequate protection to these patriotic youths.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

$4,000 REWARD.

With reference to the $1,000 reward recently offered by the Public Safety Bureau for the arrest of person or persons responsible for the murder of Hideo Nakayama, a member of the Japanese Naval Landing Party, on Darroch Road on November 9, General Tsai Chin Chun, Chief of the Public Safety Bureau, on December 19 issued a further circular notice stating that $4,000 reward, an increase of $3,000, would be offered to any person giving information leading to the arrest of the murderer.

The "Sin Wan Pao" and other local newspapers to-day reproduce a notice issued on December 18 by the S.M.P. which states that a reward of $4,000 will be paid for information given to the Municipal Police.

其他大学学生将于今日发表意见。

《申报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：-

教育部指令教育局劝告学生不要停课、不要游行及不要请愿。

12月19日，教育部再次向北平、天津、南京和上海的教育局发出电报，指令他们劝告学生不要停课，不要举行游行，不要进行请愿；如果学生对政治和时事有任何意见，应以书面形式向主管当局提出。

指称共产党煽动北方学生暴动。

《新闻晚报》就北平学生运动评论道：-
根据报纸刊登的北平当局的声明，共产党被指控为学生发起的爱国运动背后的主使者。我们不知此观察基于何种理由。在已灭亡的清朝及过去的军阀统治时期，人民的任何集会或请愿立刻被贴上由共产党煽动的标签，从而导致更多的误解和纠纷。我们希望今天的地区当局能清晰冷静地分析案情事实，并给予这些爱国青年充分的保护。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

$4,000 赏金。

关于公共安全局近期为逮捕11月9日在达罗克路谋杀日本海军陆战队队员中山秀雄（Hideo Nakayama）的责任人所提供的$1,000赏金一事，公共安全局局长蔡劲军将军于12月19日发布进一步通函通知，称将向提供任何导致逮捕凶手线索的人提供$4,000赏金，即增加$3,000。

《新闻晚报》及其他本地报纸今日转载了工部局警务处于12月18日发布的一则通告，其中声明将向向市政警察提供线索者支付$4,000赏金。

December 18, 1935.
Morning Translation.
(CRIME BRANCH)

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

Meeting of Kwang Hwa University Students' National
Salvation Association.

On the night of December 17, the Kwang Hwa
University Students' National Salvation Association held
a meeting at which the following resolutions were passed:-
(1) That prominent newspapermen be invited to give lectures
on the North China problem.
(2) That a second telegram be sent to the National Government
requesting it to protect the national salvation movement,
to release the arrested students and to severely punish
guilty military and police officers.
(3) That a second telegram be sent to General Sung Cheh Yuan
asking him not to suppress the students' movement, to
release the arrested students, to punish the culprits
and to defray medical expenses incurred by wounded
students.
(4) That a second telegram be sent to fellow students of
various universities in Peiping urging them to carry
on the national salvation spirit to the end.
(5) That a national salvation wall paper be published.
(6) That a ten-day periodical to be known as "National
Crisis" be published.

Meeting of Students of the Secondary School of Great China
University.

On December 17, the Union of Students of the
Secondary School of the Great China University held an
inaugural meeting at which it was resolved (1) to send a
circular telegram to the Peiping Students' National Salvation
Federation voicing its strong opposition to the North China
Autonomy, and (2) to appoint 15 persons to serve on the
Executive Committee of the Union.

Circular telegrams issued by various local schools.

Yesterday students of the Tsing Foong College
(正風文學院), the Secondary School of Futan University
(復旦實中), the Sing Yei Vocational School (新寰職業學校)
and the Shanghai Middle School (上海中學) sent out circular
telegrams opposing the autonomous movement in North China
and requesting the National Government to take immediate
steps to suppress such rebellious activities.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking telegram) :-

Nanking Students Appeal To The Executive Yuan.

On the morning of December 18, students of
various universities and middle schools in Nanking held a
general meeting in the premises of the Chung San University
when they decided to make an appeal to the Executive Yuan in
the afternoon to demand (1) the release of the students
arrested in Peiping and the defrayment of medical expenses
incurred by wounded students, and (2) the protection of
students' patriotic movement.

反对华北自治运动之 agitation。

(1) 邀请著名报界人士就华北问题发表演讲。
(2) 再次致电国民政府，请求其保护救国运动，释放被捕学生，并严惩有责的军警官员。

昨日，正風文學院、復旦實中、新寰職業學校和上海中學的学生发出通电，反对华北自治运动，并请求国民政府立即采取措施镇压此类叛逆活动。

December 19, 1935. Morning Translation.

At 4 p.m. about 5,000 students marched to the Executive Yuan. They elected 50 representatives who were received by Ong Wen Hao (翁文灝), Chief Secretary of the Executive Yuan. The representatives explained the object of their appeal, whereupon Mr. Ong replied (1) that the Executive Yuan had already instructed the Mayor of Peiping to release the arrested students and (2) that adequate protection would be accorded to the students' patriotic movement if it was conducted within legal bounds.
Mr. Ong's reply was conveyed to the entire body of students who, satisfied with the reply, dispersed and returned to their schools.

Shanghai Bureau of Education Ordered To Adopt Precautionary Measures Regarding Student Movements in Shanghai.

On December 18, the Ministry of Education sent a telegram to the Shanghai Bureau of Education informing it of the appeal made by the students in Nanking and instructing it to endeavour to stop the students in Shanghai from taking similar movements.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (Tientsin telegram) :-

Tientsin Students Appeal To Tientsin City Government.

At about 8.30 a.m. December 18 several thousand students of various schools in Tientsin assembled at the Hopei Public Recreation Ground. At 9 a.m. they marched to the City Government and submitted a petition demanding that the Peiping authorities be asked to release the arrested students.
They marched through various streets until they reached the recreation ground of the Nan Kai Middle School.
At 1 p.m. they held a meeting at which the following resolutions were passed :-
(1) That a manifesto be issued.
(2) That freedom of speech, press and assembly be demanded.
(3) That an appeal be made to the National Government.

Chen Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE RENT REDUCTION MOVEMENT.

Led by representatives of the Rent Reduction Movement Committee, about 60 persons, including Tsah Ts Zung (祝孝純) and Leu Ching Kwan (樓景觀), representing the sub-committees on Tongshan Road, Yunnan Road, Robison Road, etc. made an appeal yesterday morning to the Shanghai City Government requesting it to issue an order for a reduction in house rent, with a view to alleviating the hardships of the merchants. Upon arrival at the Shanghai City Government, they were intervened by officers of the Branch Bureau of Public Safety there, who ordered them to elect four representatives from amongst them to make the appeal.
Lee Ngao Kwei (李敖奎) and 3 others were then appointed head representatives and the rest remained outside in front of the government building.
The four callers were received by an official of the Second Section, who promised to refer the matter to the Mayor for consideration.

天津学生向天津市政府请愿。

12月18日上午8时30分左右，天津各校数千名学生聚集在河北公园。上午9时，他们游行至市政府，提交请愿书，要求请求北平当局释放被捕学生。

(3) 向国民政府请愿。

《晨报》及其他本地报纸：-

减租运动。

在减租运动委员会代表的带领下，包括祝孝純和樓景觀在内的约60人，代表同山路、云南路、罗便臣路等分委员会，于昨日上午向上海市政府请愿，请求其发布命令降低房租，以缓解商人的困境。抵达上海市政府后，他们受到当地公共安全局分局官员的干预，官员命令他们从中选出四名代表进行请愿。
李敖奎及其他3人被指定为主要代表，其余人留在政府大楼外。
四位来访者由第二科的一名官员接见，该官员承诺将此事项转呈市长考虑。

December 18, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

Central China Daily News (Editorial):

NATIONAL SALVATION MOVEMENT

The national salvation movement originated
years and years ago. When a nation's existence is
at stake, her people will not remain silent or inconsiderate,
this being the natural sign to a nation of the development
of her people's rights.
Both China and her people were greatly
affected by the September 18 Incident and the January 28
War, and during the past four years, many hardships
have been encountered, but were eventually tided over.
During the past month, North China has been
in a state of crisis, and both the nation and her people
are facing a much more serious blow this time, when
they are actually striving for their existence. The
national salvation movement by students was preceded
by a manifesto issued by professors of the various
universities at Peiping and was followed by the demons-
trations staged by students of various schools of the
same city. Subsequently, the movement was responded
to in every part of the country. All these indicate
the national spirit as well as the fact that the
national situation is in danger.
In view of the foregoing, the following
points strike us very forcibly:-
(1) In the past people paid much attention
to appeals regarding the national salvation movement; but
they overlooked practical efforts. Although the
shouting of slogans and the holding and staging of
processions and demonstrations can be really regarded
as signs of national spirit, yet they will not result
in any effective strength and will only give trouble-
makers an opportunity, unless such propaganda is
carried out along set principles and worked systematically.
At present the participants in the national
salvation movement are brilliant youths of the
educational circles. They ought certainly to be
ready to take strict precautions against those trouble-
makers and reactionary elements, because unless they
are very careful, there will be serious results.
We cannot forget the national situation of to-day, which
cannot be relieved by words only, but by hard efforts
effected by whole hearted action. The spirit and
strength of the people must be invoked in the salvation
of the nation and a long struggle is also necessitated,
so that the ridiculous "5-minute enthusiasm" will be
done away with.
(2) The Government should direct these
national salvation people carefully, who in turn should
observe good order and so save the national crisis
under the actual guidance of the Government. As the
participants in the national salvation movement are
students who are educated, they can be persuaded and
easily taught. In this way no illegal activities
by students will happen. Furthermore, they can be
easily directed how to support the Government.
pages.zh:
1935年12月18日。
下午译文。

《华中日报》（社论）：

救国运动

救国运动起源于多年以前。当一个国家的生存受到威胁时，其人民不会保持沉默或漠不关心，这是该国人民权利发展的自然标志。
中国和中国人民深受九一八事变和一二八战争的影响，在过去四年中遭遇了许多艰难困苦，但最终都渡过了难关。
在过去的一个月里，华北一直处于危机状态，国家和人民这次面临着更为严重的打击，实际上是在为生存而奋斗。学生的救国运动之前有北平各大学教授发表的宣言，随后是该市各学校学生举行的示威游行。此后，全国各地纷纷响应。所有这些既表明了民族精神，也表明国家局势处于危险之中。
鉴于上述情况，以下几点给我们留下了深刻印象：-
(1) 过去人们非常关注关于救国运动的呼吁；但忽视了实际努力。虽然高呼口号以及举行和 staged 游行示威确实可以被视为民族精神的标志，但如果这种宣传不按照既定原则进行并系统地开展工作，就不会产生任何有效的力量，只会给捣乱分子提供机会。
目前参加救国运动的是教育界的优秀青年。他们当然应该准备好严防那些捣乱分子和反动元素，因为如果不非常小心，将会产生严重后果。我们不能忘记今天的国家局势，这不能仅靠言语来缓解，而要靠全心全意的行动所付出的艰苦努力。在拯救国家时必须唤起人民的精神和力量，也需要长期的斗争，以便消除可笑的“五分钟热情”。
(2) 政府应仔细引导这些救国人士，而他们则应遵守良好秩序，从而在政府的实际指导下挽救国家危机。由于参加救国运动的是受过教育的学生，他们可以受劝导且易于教导。这样就不会发生学生的非法活动。此外，可以轻易地指导他们如何支持政府。

pages.en:
December 18, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

(3) In the past national salvation movements
always aroused a misunderstanding among friendly nations.
In minor cases, the movements are regarded as
disturbances, but in major cases, as anti-foreign
activities. We are surprised to see such a misunder-
standing since the love and salvation of one's country
is the same in all other countries. Do the people
of other friendly nations not know that their respective
countries should be loved and that the national crisis
of their respective countries should be relieved? The
salvation of one's country is the obligation of the
people. Why should the people of China be an
exception? The Chinese people at heart have no
anti-foreign idea, and they have never rejected foreign
culture. We have no time to lose in welcoming
people of friendly nations who are rendering us mutual
benefits, but yet we have no anti-foreign ideas. The
Chinese people like peace and if friendly nations
can understand China, the reason for China's national
salvation movement will be clear to them.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

ANTI-OPIUM MOVEMENT

With a view to accelerating the anti-opium
movement, the First Special District Citizens' Federation,
at a meeting held the other day, resolved to form a
"First Special District Anti-Opium Movement Committee."
Wong Shiao Lai (黄晓赖) has been invited to be
Chairman of the Committee with seven standing members,
including Chang Tsing Yuin (张清云) and Chen Chi Chen
(陈济成). The anti-opium propaganda meeting
of the Committee, which has been scheduled for to-day,
will be held on the afternoon of December 24. The
meeting will issue a circular addressed to the people,
on the anti-opium movement and in the meantime, handbills
containing slogans in favour of the movement will be
posted in the streets.

Opium Smokers Warned to Register.

The Bureau of Public Safety continued the
drive to discover opium smokers yesterday.
The Bureau of Public Safety commenced the
registration of opium smokers in July this year. Up
to last week, 30,239 opium smokers were registered,
amongst whom 26,230 smokers secured registration
licences and 4,000 smokers wanted to undergo a cure.
Amongst the 4,000 smokers, 2,677 have been
sent to anti-opium hospitals.
The compulsory registration of opium smokers
will be closed at the end of the year, after which
unlicensed smokers, if found, will be sent to a
military court and sentenced to a term of more than six
months but less than 2 years' imprisonment. Furthermore
they will be fined a sum under $300.
On December 17 the Bureau of Public Safety issued
a final notice addressed to unregistered smokers strongly
advising them to apply for registration this year in
order to avoid punishment.

(3) 过去的救国运动总是在友好国家中引起误解。在轻微情况下，这些运动被视为骚乱，但在严重情况下，则被视为排外活动。我们看到这种误解感到惊讶，因为热爱和拯救自己的国家在所有其他国家都是一样的。其他友好国家的人民难道不知道应该热爱各自的国家并缓解各自国家的危机吗？拯救自己的国家是人民的义务。为什么中国人民要成为例外？中国人民内心没有排外思想，也从未拒绝外国文化。我们欢迎给予我们互利帮助的友好国家人士，没有时间可浪费，但我们并没有排外思想。中国人民喜欢和平，如果友好国家能够理解中国，他们就会清楚中国救国运动的原因。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

禁烟运动

为了加速禁烟运动，第一特别区市民联合会在日前举行的会议上决议成立“第一特别区禁烟运动委员会”。已邀请黄晓赖 (Wong Shiao Lai) 担任委员会主席，另有七名常务委员，包括张清云 (Chang Tsing Yuin) 和陈济成 (Chen Chi Chen)。委员会原定于今天举行的禁烟宣传会议，将改于12月24日下午举行。会议将向民众发布关于禁烟运动的通告，同时将在街道上张贴含有支持该运动标语的传单。

警告鸦片吸食者登记。

公安局昨日继续开展查获鸦片吸食者的行动。
公安局于今年七月开始对鸦片吸食者进行登记。截至上周，共有30,239名鸦片吸食者登记，其中26,230名吸食者获得了登记执照，4,000名吸食者希望接受戒毒治疗。
在这4,000名吸食者中，已有2,677人被送往禁烟医院。
鸦片吸食者的强制登记将于年底截止，此后如发现无执照吸食者，将被送交军事法庭，判处六个月以上两年以下有期徒刑。此外，还将处以300元以下的罚款。
12月17日，公安局向未登记的吸食者发出最后通知，强烈建议他们在今年申请登记，以避免受罚。

December 18, 1935.    4    Morning Translation.

Canton Telegram:

Students' Patriotic Movement Not to be Interfered with.

At a meeting of the Kwangtung Provincial
Political Affairs Council held on December 17 and
attended by General Chen Chi Tang, Ling Yung Yih,
Chairman of the Kwangtung Provincial Government, Liu
Chi Wen, Mayor of Canton, and others, the following
decisions relating to the students' patriotic movement
were passed:-
1) That a telegram of encouragement be sent to various
universities and schools in Shanghai and Peiping.
2) That the Kwangtung Provincial Government take no
action against the National Salvation Associations
formed by students of the Chung San ( 中山 )
University, Canton University and other schools
if their activities are confined within legal bounds
and that Party and political organs be instructed
to guide the movement.

As a protest against the autonomous movement
in North China and in support of the patriotic
activities of students at Peiping, the First Special
District Citizens' Federation yesterday issued two
telegrams: one to General Sung Cheh Yuan requesting
him to protect the patriotic movement and the other
to the entire body of students of various colleges
and universities, conveying the Federation's sympathy.

93 Local Trade Associations Issue Manifesto.

The 93 local trade associations, including
the Paper Shop-Owners' Association, the Rice Shop-Owners'
Association and the Silk Filature-Owners' Association,
yesterday issued a joint manifesto in which it is
expected that the Government would come to a final
decision immediately for the protection of China's
territorial integrity. The manifesto concludes by
assuring their support to the Government.

广州电报：

学生爱国运动不受干涉。

在12月17日举行的广东省政务委员会会议上，陈济棠将军、广东省政府主席林云陔、广州市长刘纪文等出席，通过了以下关于学生爱国运动的决定：-
1) 向上海和北平的各大学和学校发送鼓励电报。
2) 如果中山大学、广东大学及其他学校学生组织的救国会的活动限制在法律范围内，广东省政府不对其采取行动，并指示党和政治机关引导该运动。

为抗议华北自治运动并支持北平学生的爱国活动，第一特别区市民联合会昨日发出两封电报：一封致宋哲元将军，请求他保护爱国运动；另一封致各大专院校全体学生，表达联合会的同情。

93个本地同业公会发表宣言。

包括纸号业公会、米号业公会和丝厂业公会在内的93个本地同业公会，昨日发表联合宣言，期望政府立即做出最终决定，以保护中国领土完整。宣言结尾保证支持政府。

December 18, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Jan Pao and other local newspapers :-

NORTH CHINA PROBLEM

In an interview with a reporter of the Sin
Sun News Agency, Mr. Lee Tseh Ih(李擇一), Adviser to
the Fukien Provincial Government, who arrived in Shanghai
from Nanking by train at 7.15 a.m. yesterday, made the
following statement :-
"The negotiations between China and Japan
on the North China problem is being successfully conducted.
The Hopei-Chahar Political Council will be inaugurated
shortly, with General Sung Cheh Yuan as the President.
This Council is of a temporary nature, placed under the
control of the National Government. This Council will
naturally endeavour to suppress the rebellion of Yin Zu
Keng at the district - East Hopei - where the rebellion is
taking place, comes within the jurisdiction of the Council.
The North China dispute is merely a portion of the Sino-
Japanese controversy, a solution of which is being attempted.
It is not true that I shall be appointed Chinese Ambassador
to Japan."

Tang Song 党声 (Party Voice, Volume 1, Issue 45, official organ
of local Kuomintang, published the following article :-

"COMPROMISE OR SACRIFICE?"

Although the manifesto issued by the cultural
and educational circles in Peiping to the effect that "they
are strongly opposed to any underhand intrigue for the
establishment of a peculiar political organization free
from the control of the Central Authorities, and that the
National Government be requested to use all its national
force to preserve the integral rights and the political
administration of this country", does not contain many
words, it however displays the national spirit of the
Chinese conspicuously.
The conditions in North China are at present
in a very grave situation, and resemble in every way
the status prior to the outbreak of the September 18th
Incident. If the entire Chinese nation really intend
to preserve their existence, it is most essential for
them to strive for the maintenance of their territorial
sovereignty and integral rights.
Fellow countrymen, this is the very time for
us all to rise up and determine to make a final sacrifice
with a view to preserving our territorial and sovereign
rights.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

华北问题

福建省政府顾问李择一先生昨日早晨7时15分乘火车从南京抵达上海，在接受《申新通讯社》记者采访时发表如下声明：-
“中日之间关于华北问题的谈判正在顺利进行。冀察政务委员会即将成立，由宋哲元将军任委员长。该委员会属临时性质，受国民政府管辖。该委员会自然会努力镇压殷汝耕在辖区——冀东——的叛乱，该地区正处于叛乱之中，且属于该委员会管辖范围。华北争端仅是中日争议的一部分，目前正试图解决此争议。所谓我将被任命为中国驻日本大使一事，并非事实。”

党声（国民党地方党部机关刊物，第一卷第四十五期）刊登了以下文章：-

“妥协还是牺牲？”

虽然北平文化教育界发表的宣言措辞不多，称“坚决反对任何旨在建立脱离中央当局控制的特殊政治组织的幕后阴谋，并请求国民政府动用全国力量以维护本国的完整权利和政治行政”，但它显著地展现了中国人的民族精神。
目前华北局势非常严峻，各方面都与九一八事变爆发前的状况相似。如果整个中华民族真的打算生存下去，那么争取维护领土主权和完整权利就至关重要。
同胞们，现在正是我们所有人奋起并决心做出最终牺牲的时候，以维护我们的领土和主权权利。

December 18, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

NIPPO, JAIMICHI & NICHI-NICHI

BURGLARY AT THE RESIDENCE OF A JAPANESE DANCING PARTNER

At about 3 a.m. December 16, a burglary was committed at No. 3 Yang Cha Road, the residence of Miss Keiko Kawanishi, aged 24, a Japanese dancing partner, by some person who effected an entry by using the following methods:- After opening the door on the veranda a large quantity of gum was pasted on the window pane which was then covered with paper in order to avoid making a noise when breaking it. An overcoat and a Chinese dress were stolen.

NIPPO

BRITISH SUBJECT AND KOREAN DANCING PARTNER

A charge of fraud was brought against a Korean dancing partner named Kim Kum Nu of the Moon Palace before the local Japanese Consular Court by Mr. Yeto, a Japanese lawyer, on behalf of the complainant named Joo Da, aged 30, a British subject of Chinese extraction, residing at the New Asia Hotel, Tiendong Road.
The hearing of the case was held on December 17 before Mr. Okumura, Chief of the Judicial Section of the Consular Police.

STUDENTS FORCED TO SIGN ANTI-JAPANESE RESOLUTION

Anti-Japanese demonstrations by student bodies in Shanghai in connection with the North China problem and the oppression of the authorities are gradually on the increase.
On the night of December 16, anti-Japanese pamphlets were disseminated at the Shanghai University and moreover a number of leaders asked the students on their way to the institution to sign their names on a resolution urging the Nanking Government to adopt a firm policy towards Japan. Mr. T. Yasuike, the only Japanese student of the University, was also asked to sign his name but the request was rejected.

MR. SUGIMOTO TO RESIGN

Mr. H. Sugimoto, who worked as Acting President of the Japanese Residents' Corporation since the resignation of Mr. G. Yasui is expected to resign after he has handed over the office to Mr. M. Amano who was appointed President of the Corporation.
Mr. Sugimoto will be reengaged by his former employers the Shanghai Transportation Co.
An order was issued on December 17 by the Japanese Consular Authorities to Mr. Sugimoto, relieving him of his post as Acting President.

1935年12月18日。下午译件。

《日日新闻》、《每日新闻》及《朝日新闻》

日本舞伴住宅遭窃案

12月16日凌晨3时许，位于杨叉路3号的24岁日本舞伴川西惠子（Keiko Kawanishi）小姐的住宅发生入室盗窃案。作案人采用以下方法进入：打开阳台门后，在窗玻璃上粘贴大量口香糖，然后贴上纸张，以避免打破玻璃时发出声响。一件大衣和一件中式服装被盗。

《日日新闻》

英国侨民与朝鲜舞伴

日本律师Yeto先生代表投诉人朱达（Joo Da，音译），一名30岁的华裔英籍人士，居住于天潼路新亚酒店，向当地日本领事法庭指控名为金琴奴（Kim Kum Nu，音译）的朝鲜舞伴犯有欺诈罪，该舞伴在月宫（Moon Palace）工作。
案件于12月17日由领事警察司法科科长奥村（Okumura）先生主持审理。

学生被迫签署反日决议

上海学生团体因华北问题及当局压迫而举行的反日示威活动逐渐增加。
12月16日晚，上海大学散发了反日传单，此外，一些领导人在学生前往学校途中要求他们在一份决议上签名，敦促南京政府对日采取强硬政策。该校唯一的日本学生安井（T. Yasuike，音译）也被要求签名，但遭到拒绝。

杉本先生将辞职

自安井（G. Yasui，音译）先生辞职以来一直担任日本居留民团代理团长的杉本（H. Sugimoto，音译）先生，预计在将职务移交给被任命为团长的天野（M. Amano，音译）先生后辞职。
杉本先生将被其前雇主上海运输公司重新聘用。
12月17日，日本领事当局向杉本先生发布命令，免除其代理团长职务。

December 18, 1935. Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers:

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

At a meeting held at 3 p.m. yesterday by the students of the Chien Kuo (建國) Middle School, Shanghai, Woo Yuan Lieng (吳元良) and four others were elected members to the Standing Committee. A telegram will be despatched to console and encourage the students of the various middle schools and universities at Peiping.

The Students' Association of the Huang Hwa Kong (黃花崗) Middle School yesterday issued a circular telegram advocating (1) that the people throughout China unite in protesting against the autonomous movement in North China, (2) that support be rendered to the students at Peiping in opposing the autonomous movement in North China, (3) that Chinese traitors be severely dealt with, and (4) that the territorial integrity of China be protected.

(中國) On December 16 the students of the Chung Kuo Middle School held a meeting at which the following resolutions were passed:-
1) That a "Chung Kuo Middle School Students' National Salvation Association" be formed.
2) That a telegram be despatched to condole with the students at Peiping.
3) That a circular be issued to the various circles throughout China to rise up unanimously for the salvation of the crisis and the existence of the nation.

On December 16 the entire body of students of the Tseng Foong (正風) College held a meeting at which Yin Tseng (尹澄), Zee Zeu Han (徐善候) and twenty-three others were elected members of the Executive Committee, with a view to facilitating their national salvation movement unanimously with those of students of various local universities.

The students of the Shanghai Law College have despatched a telegram to the educational circles through Chiang Meng Ling (蔣夢麟), Principal of the Peiping University, urging them to rise up and struggle unanimously for the salvation of the nation which is now at stake.

"Federation of Teachers & Staffs of Various Universities in Shanghai" to Hold Meeting on December 22.

The Executive and Supervisory Committees of the "Federation of Teachers & Staffs of Various Universities in Shanghai" will hold a joint meeting at 1 p.m. December 22 at the meeting-room of the China Cultural Reconstruction Corporation (中國文化建設協會), Rue Lafayette, when the North China affair will be discussed.

反对华北自治运动的风潮。

昨天下午3时，上海建国中学学生举行会议，选举吴元良等五人为常务委员会委员。将发电报慰问和鼓励北平各中学和大学的学生。

黄花岗中学学生会昨天发出通电，主张：(1) 全国人民团结起来抗议华北自治运动；(2) 支持北平学生反对华北自治运动；(3) 严惩汉奸；(4) 保护中国领土完整。

(中国) 12月16日，中国中学学生举行会议，通过以下决议：-
1) 成立“中国中学学生救国会”。
2) 发电报慰问北平学生。
3) 向全国各界发出通告，一致奋起挽救国家危机和存亡。

12月16日，正风学院全体学生举行会议，选举尹澄、徐善候等二十四人为执行委员会委员，以便与当地各大学学生一致开展救国运动。

上海法政学院学生已通过北京大学校长蒋梦麟向教育界发出电报，敦促他们奋起并为挽救此刻危在旦夕的国家而一致斗争。

“上海各大学教职员联合会”将于12月22日举行会议。

“上海各大学教职员联合会”的执行委员会和监察委员会将于12月22日下午1时在霞飞路中国文化建设协会会议室举行联席会议，讨论华北事件。

December 17, 1935. Morning Translation

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

At 3 p.m. yesterday the representatives of the various University Students Federations and National Salvation Committees held a joint meeting in the premise of the Chiaotung University for the purpose of discussing future activities for national salvation.
The following resolutions were discussed and passed :-
(1) That the following measures be adopted to accelerate the future activities for national salvation :-
(a) To centralize the control of the various Students Unions of local universities for national salvation.
(b) To carry out a practical and permanent movement for national salvation.
(2) It was published in newspapers during the past few days that a federation known as the Federation of Local University Students For National Salvation had been inaugurated in Shanghai. The various local universities knew nothing about its establishment beforehand nor had they delegated any representatives to participate in the meetings held by this Federation. Moreover the Federation had failed to mention the place where the meetings were held and the names of the representatives who attended. It is evidently an illegal organization established under certain pretexts. It is therefore only reasonable that this Federation should not be recognised. It was decided:
(a) That a letter be sent to the local newspapers and news agencies denouncing the establishment of this Federation.
(b) That the local Tangpu and other political organs be requested to conduct investigations and to adopt strict measures to deal with such organizations.
(c) That the various Students Self-Control Unions and National Salvation Committees of the local Universities be instructed not to recognize such organizations.
(3) That the delegates of the various universities present write to the Secretary of the local University Students Federation asking him to convene a meeting of the representatives of the various local universities at the earliest date possible for the purpose of discussing measures for the unification of the local university students, so as to facilitate the adoption of a concentrated movement for national salvation.

Conditions of the local universities

Information obtained yesterday by a reporter of this newspaper from the various local university authorities reveals that everything is going on smoothly within the university premises. They, however, are all very indignant over the question of the North China affairs. As the organization for national salvation has not as yet been officially established, they have, therefore, not delegated any representatives to attend the meetings held by the so-called Federation of the

1935年12月17日。晨间译件

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

反对华北自治运动之 agitation（煽动/鼓动）。

昨日下午3时，各大学学生联合会及救国会代表在交通大学校舍举行联席会议，旨在讨论今后救国活动事宜。
会议讨论并通过下列决议：
(1) 采取以下措施以加速今后的救国活动：
(a) 集中统辖本地各大学学生会之救国工作。
(b) 开展切实且持久的救国运动。
(2) 近几日报纸刊登消息称，一个名为“上海各大学学生救国联合会”的组织已在上海成立。本地各大学事先对该组织的成立一无所知，亦未委派任何代表参加该联合会举行的会议。此外，该联合会未提及会议地点及与会代表姓名。这显然是一个借某种借口成立的非法组织。因此，不承认该联合会是合乎情理的。决定：
(a) 致函本地报纸及通讯社，谴责该联合会的成立。
(b) 请求本地党部及其他政治机关进行调查，并对此类组织采取严厉措施。
(c) 指示本地各大学的学生自律会及救国会不承认此类组织。
(3) 与会的各大学代表致函本地大学学生联合会秘书，请其尽早召集本地各大学代表开会，讨论统一本地大学生之措施，以便采取集中的救国运动。

December 17, 1935. Morning Translation.

The Shanghai Postal Workers' Union yesterday issued three telegrams on the North China Question: one to the students of middle schools and universities at Peiping, one to General Sung Chah Yuan, and the other to the various Tangpus, political organs and public bodies throughout China. The Government is to be requested to issue orders immediately for the mobilization of troops for the suppression of rebels.

Bureau of Education Advises Students to Refrain from Direct Action in their National Salvation Movements.

The Education Bureau yesterday sent the following letter to the Chinan ( 暨南 ), the Futan ( 復旦 ) and other universities and middle schools:-
"Although the situation in the North is tense, yet the foreign policy of our Government has already been ascertained. The Government will never inconsiderately allow, in any way, the losing of China's sovereign rights or the attempt to partitioning China's territory. The enthusiastic patriotism of the students of various schools and universities is worthy of respect; but at this time of national crisis, the holding and staging of processions and demonstrations will only result, in minor cases, in constituting an obstruction to the peace and order in the community and in major cases, in the creation of international trouble. It will of no benefit to either the nation or the people when our Government becomes definitely unable to deal with external affairs. All the opinions of teachers and students of various schools and universities may be written and offered to the Government for adoption, instead of their carrying out unworthy activities on account of intense indignation. We hereby hope that you will persuade the students to observe these instructions."
Enquiries made yesterday by a reporter of the Sin Sun ( 新聲 ) News Agency at the various schools and universities show that the students have resumed study and that good order is being preserved.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

VARIOUS PUBLIC BODIES MEET TO DISCUSS MEASURES AGAINST INCREASE IN TELEPHONE RATE.

In connection with the opposition to the increase in telephone rate in the Special District, the various public bodies held a meeting at 2 p.m. yesterday in the Chamber of Commerce.
The following resolutions were discussed and passed:-
1) That brief regulations governing the Shanghai Special District Telephone Questions Committee be passed.
2) That an executive and an advisory committee be elected.
3) That letters be sent to various public bodies requesting them to support unanimously the suppression of improper concerns like cabarets, Hai Alei Auditorium, etc.

教育局劝告学生在救国运动中避免直接行动。

教育局昨日致函暨南大学、复旦大学及其他大中学，内容如下：
“虽然北方局势紧张，但我国政府的外交政策已经确定。政府绝不会轻率地允许以任何方式丧失中国主权或企图分割中国领土。各校学生的爱国热情值得尊重；但在国家危机时刻，举行游行示威，轻则妨碍社区和平秩序，重则引发国际纠纷。当我国政府确实无法处理外交事务时，这对国家和人民均无益处。各校师生的所有意见可以书面形式提交政府采纳，而不必因极度愤慨而进行不当之举动。特此希望你们劝告学生遵守这些指示。”
《新声》通讯社记者昨日向各学校查询的情况显示，学生已恢复上课，秩序良好。

3) 致函各公共团体，请求他们一致支持取缔舞厅、海利大戏院（Hai Alei Auditorium）等不当场所。

12月16日下午4时40分，上海中学一百五十名学生在位于南市中华路866号的校内举行会议，讨论进一步反对华北自治运动的方法与手段。会议讨论并通过了以下决议：
1) 安排成立上海中学学生救国会。

December 16, 1935.    /    Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers .-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA

    Since the establishment of the Federation
of the local University Students for National Salvation,
the Federation has been very busy engaging in its various
activities. The Board of Management of this Federation
called a meeting at 4 p.m. yesterday at which the following
resolutions were discussed and passed:-
    (1) That a telegram be sent to the
National Government urging it to restore East Hopei to
its original political status immediately.
    (2) That a telegram be sent to the Defence
Forces of Charhar Province urging them to preserve the
Chinese territorial rights with determination.
    (3) That preparations be made for the
inauguration of a federation to be known as the National
Salvation Federation of the Various Public Bodies in
Shanghai.
    (4) That preparations be made for the
publication of a newspaper to be known as the National
Salvation Daily News.
    (5) That views for national salvation
be openly solicited from the various nations of the world
for submission to the National Government.
    (6) That reputable members and educa-
tionists of the local community be invited to direct
the activities of this Federation.
    (7) That a report be submitted to the local
Tangpu and other political organs on the establishment of
this Federation.
    (8) That officials be delegated to propagate
the principles of national salvation to the residents of
the various districts of Shanghai.
    The assembly terminated at 7 p.m.

Chih Tse University Students to hold meeting

    The entire body of the students of the
Chih Tse University held a meeting at the auditorium of
the university on the afternoon of December 14 when several
hundred students were present. The meeting decided that
a Students National Salvation Federation composed of 35
members be organized and that a circular telegram be
despatched in the name of this Federation announcing their
warm support to the patriotic movement of the students in
Peiping and urging the National Government to enforce a
policy of revolutionary spirit.

Kwanghwa University Students to hold meeting

    The Kwanghwa University Students National
Salvation Federation held the first meeting of the members
of its Executive Committee last night when 15 persons were
present. The meeting discussed and passed the following
resolutions:-
    (1) That a telegram expressing their warm
sympathy be sent to the students in Peiping.

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

反对华北自治运动之 agitation

    自本地大学生救国联合会成立以来，该会一直忙于开展各项活动。该联合会管理委员会于昨日下午4时召开会议，讨论并通过以下决议：
    (1) 致电国民政府，促请立即恢复冀东原政治地位。
    (2) 致电察哈尔省守军，促其坚决维护中国领土权利。
    (3) 筹备成立名为“上海各界救国联合会”的组织。
    (4) 筹备出版名为《救国日报》的报纸。
    (5) 公开征求世界各国关于救国的意见，并提交国民政府。
    (6) 邀请本地社会知名人士和教育家指导本联合会的活动。
    (7) 就本联合会的成立向本地党部及其他政治机关提交报告。
    (8) 委派人员向上海各区居民宣传救国宗旨。
    会议于下午7时结束。

持志大学学生将举行会议

    12月14日下午，持志大学全体学生在校礼堂举行会议，数百名学生出席。会议决定组织一个由35人组成的学生救国联合会，并以该联合会名义发出通电，宣布热烈支持北平学生的爱国运动，并敦促国民政府实行具有革命精神的政策。

光华大学学生将举行会议

    光华大学学生救国联合会昨晚召开执行委员会第一次会议，15人出席。会议讨论并通过以下决议：
    (1) 致电北平学生，表达热烈同情。

(2) That a telegram be sent to the Central Authorities requesting them to preserve the sovereign rights and administrative power of China and voicing their protest against the autonomous movement in North China.
(3) That a telegram be sent to General Sung Cheh Yuan, Chairman of the Hopei-Chahar Political Council, protesting against the so-called autonomous movement in North China.
(4) That efforts be made to combine with the students of the various universities in Shanghai so as to facilitate the adoption of a concentrated campaign.
(5) That efforts be made to unite with the Federation of the Teachers and Staffs of the Various Universities of Shanghai so as to facilitate the unification of all in the common cause.

Chinan University Students to Form "Committee to Oppose the Autonomous Movement in North China"

In view of the recent establishment of a new organization in North China, the students of the Chinan University, Chenju, held a meeting a few days ago when measures to protest against the autonomous movement in North China were discussed and a "Committee to Oppose the Autonomous Movement In North China" was formed. Representatives were detailed to spread propaganda among students of various schools and to ask them to act in various concerts.
Interviewed yesterday by our reporter, a responsible member of the committee stated that as they could no longer remain silent and disinterested, they had formed a "Committee to Oppose the Autonomous Movement in North China," and that they would call upon the students of all the middle schools and universities in Shanghai to support our Government for the sake of preserving China's sovereign rights.
It is understood that the Committee will organize propaganda corps to carry out the propaganda among the people in villages and country districts.

Hongkong Telegram:

After a meeting of teachers and students of the Chun San (中山) University which is to be held on December 16, the entire body of students of the university will be mobilized to carry out the task of propaganda.
On the afternoon of December 15 representatives of students of various schools held a meeting at the auditorium of the Kwangtung Provincial Assembly at which the problems relating to the work of national salvation were discussed.

The entire body of teachers and students of the Dah Kung (大公) Vocational School yesterday despatched a telegram to the Central Kuomintang Headquarters and the National Government requesting them to preserve the integrity and sovereign rights of China and to protect the genuine national salvation movement and critics. Another telegram tendering their support was sent to the teachers and professors of various middle schools and universities at Peiping.

暨南大学学生组建“反对华北自治运动委员会”

鉴于华北最近成立一新组织，镇江暨南大学学生数日前举行会议，讨论抗议华北自治运动的措施，并成立了“反对华北自治运动委员会”。已指派代表在各校学生中进行宣传，并要求他们采取一致行动。
该委员会一名负责人昨日接受本报记者采访时称，由于他们不能再保持沉默和漠不关心，故成立了“反对华北自治运动委员会”，并将呼吁上海所有中学和大学的学生为维护中国主权而支持我国政府。
据悉，该委员会将组织宣传队，在乡村和农村地区民众中开展宣传工作。

香港电讯：

中山大学师生将于12月16日举行会议后，动员全校学生开展宣传任务。
12月15日下午，各校学生代表在广东省议会礼堂举行会议，讨论有关救国工作的问题。

大公职业学校全体师生昨日致电国民党中央执行委员会总部及国民政府，请求维护中国完整及主权，保护真正的救国运动及批评者。另有一封表示支持的电报发往北平各中学及大学的教师和教授。

December 10, 1935.    Morning Translation.

Manifesto of the Middle School Teachers' Federation

On December 15, the Middle School Teachers'
Federation and 36 middle schools in this locality issued
the following manifesto regarding the North China problem:-
"We have to realize our duties during the
present national crisis and have to do our share in the
national salvation by studying. We hope, in the meantime,
that our Government will make every effort to pull through.
Unless measures are adopted to stop the secession movement
in North China, which movement incidentally has certain
ulterior motives, the 'clutching hand' that keeps
interferring in the civil administration of this country
will deprive China of her Sovereign Rights in the North,
and then proceed to colonize that area as quickly as
possible, to form a base from which it can start its
conquest of China. In consequence of this, the North
China problem is one effecting the whole of China and the
existence or fall of the North will decide the fate of
China. What we are now expecting our Government to do
is to exterminate the secession movement in North China
in a most determined and effective manner. We are
opposing unlimited concessions. We strongly believe
that every one of us is prepared to give our Government
our unlimited support should it be necessary to sacrifice
all for the sake of maintaining the integrity of our
territory and our Sovereign Rights.
"We are now studying 'the last lesson' and
will rush to the front, prepared to pay the supreme
sacrifice should ever our Government require us to resist
insult".

The Chekiang Students' Association in Shanghai
dispatched a telegram yesterday to students of universities
and middle schools in Peiping expressing sympathy with the
patriotic movement launched by them.
The Association has also issued a circular
telegram to the Central Kuomintang Headquarters, the
National Government, the various Yuans, the various official
and public bodies and the newspapers in the country,
opposing the autonomy in North China. The telegram requests
the Government to protect all proper patriotic movements,
to maintain the integrity of China's territory and
Sovereign Rights and to reject all unreasonable demands
that will lead to China being insulted.

Meeting of Students of Institut Technique Franco-Chinois

The Students' Association of the Institut
Technique Franco-Chinois yesterday held a meeting at
which it was resolved that a manifesto be issued immediately
and a circular telegram dispatched to urge the people
throughout China to oppose the autonomous movement in
North China. Another telegram to express their sympathy
with the protest against the movement of the students'
associations in Peiping and Tientsin will also be issued.

中学教师联合会宣言

12月15日，本地中学教师联合会及36所中学就华北问题发表如下宣言：
“我们必须认识到在当前国家危机中的责任，并通过学习为救国尽一份力。同时，我们希望政府竭尽全力渡过难关。除非采取措施制止华北的分裂运动——该运动顺便提一下带有某些 ulterior motives（险恶用心）——那只不断干涉本国内政的‘黑手’将剥夺中国在华北的主权，进而尽快将该地区殖民化，以此作为征服中国的基地。因此，华北问题关乎全中国，华北的存亡将决定中国的命运。我们现在期望政府做的是以最坚决、最有效的方式消灭华北的分裂运动。我们反对无限制的让步。我们坚信，如果需要为维护领土完整和主权而牺牲一切，我们每个人都准备给予政府无限的支持。
“我们现在正在学习‘最后一课’，并将奔赴前线，一旦政府要求我们抵抗侮辱，我们准备做出最高牺牲。”

浙江旅沪学生会昨日致电北平各大学及中学学生，对他们发起的爱国运动表示同情。
该会还向国民党中央执行委员会总部、国民政府、各院、各官方及公共机构以及全国各报社发出通电，反对华北自治。电文请求政府保护所有正当的爱国运动，维护中国领土完整和主权，并拒绝所有会导致中国受辱的不合理要求。

中法工学院学生会议

中法工学院学生会昨日举行会议，决议立即发表宣言并发出通电，敦促全国人民反对华北自治运动。还将发出另一封电报，对北平和天津学生协会抗议该运动的行动表示同情。

December 16, 1935. Morning Translation.

Nanking telegram :-

Long Ping Siu (龍炳修) and other
representatives of students of various universities at
Peiping have arrived at Nanking and will call upon
various authorities concerned tomorrow morning.
In an interview with a reporter, the representatives
stated that the educational circles at Peiping would
always oppose the autonomous movement in North China and
that their object in coming to the South was to submit
an appeal to the National Government and to combine
with the educational circles at Nanking and Shanghai
to put up a protest against the movement.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

TELEPHONE QUESTION

The various local public bodies will call a
joint meeting at 2 p.m. to-day, December 16, 1935, in
the Shanghai Chinese Chamber of Commerce, North Soochow
Road, for the purpose of discussing measures to oppose
the collection of telephone charges according to the
number of calls.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

OPIUM SUPPRESSION MOVEMENT

As the period for the compulsory registration
of opium addicts will expire within 2 weeks, the local
Public Safety Bureau in connection with the Opium
Suppression Committee will detail propaganda groups to
proceed to various districts to give open air lectures
as from to-day, December 16, 1935. The final
inspection of opium addicts will be held soon.

LOCAL REPERCUSSIONS AGAINST AUTONOMY MOVEMENT
IN NORTH CHINA

- Local Educationalists call on Mayor Wu to protest
against Autonomy Movement

At 11 a.m. December 14, the principals of local
Chinese universities and colleges called in a body on Mayor
Wu Tich-chen at the Civic Centre and informed him that
students and others connected with educational circles in
the
Shanghai wished to know the truth about/Northern situation.
They also informed the Mayor that the students and
educationalists of Shanghai desired the Government to
protect the territorial integrity and to find means to
re-unify the country. Mayor Wu promised to convey the
wishes to the National Government and advised the callers
to take special precautions to prevent unruly students from
taking any action which might lead to disorder.

- General Labour Union supports local Students Bodies
in opposing Autonomy Movement

On December 14, the Shanghai General Labour Union
sent a lengthy message to Nanking through the medium of the
Chinese press, urging the Government to despatch an
Expeditionary Force to the North to suppress the autonomy
movement and to punish Ying Ju-keng.

A report has been received that the General Labour
Union is secretly planning to support the movement of local
student bodies to oppose the creation of an autonomous state
in North China. The General Labour Union is planning to
instructions
issue/to all labour unions in Shanghai to adopt a similar
policy.

12月14日上午11时，本地各中国大学及学院的校长集体前往市中心（Civic Centre）拜会吴铁城市长，告知他上海学生及教育界人士希望了解华北局势的真相。他们还向市长表示，上海的学生和教育家希望政府保护领土完整，并寻求重新统一国家的方法。吴市长承诺将这些愿望转达给国民政府，并建议来访者采取特别预防措施，防止不守规矩的学生采取任何可能导致混乱的行动。

据收到的报告称，总工会正秘密计划支持本地学生团体反对在华北建立自治国家的运动。总工会正计划向上海所有工会发布指示，采取类似的政策。

"Oppose decisively any organization which interferes
with the territorial integrity of the nation !"

At 10 a.m. December 15, some fifty students of the
University of Utopia held a meeting on the university
premises, South Station Road, Nantao, and decided to appoint
seven students to organize a National Salvation Association
of the students of the University of Utopia ( ).

Representatives of students of the following four
universities have formed a "Shanghai Universities Students'
National Salvation Federation" ( )
for the purpose of unifying the students in Shanghai who are
participating in the movement against the establishment of
an autonomous state in North China :-
Fuh Tan University, Kiangwan.
Kiaotung University, Avenue Haig, O.O.L.
Kwang Hwa University, Great Western Road, C.U.L.
Dong Chi University, Woosung.

Some sixty students of the Comparative Law School
of China, 146 Quinsan Road, held a meeting in the school at
9.15 p.m. December 14 and decided to issue a statement
opposing the autonomy movement in the North.

December 16, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

China Evening News (comment):

PATRIOTIC MOVEMENT

Since the May 4th movement, cases have rarely occurred wherein young students participated in the patriotic movement.
Subsequent to the outbreak of the North China affair, students at Peiping, moved by indignation, launched a patriotic movement.
On December 14, students in Shanghai, having been inspired by educationists at Peiping, started a similar movement. We may lay aside the question as to whether or not such a patriotic movement is useful, but it will show that local students do not forget their national territory in the North.
Of course, it is not absolutely necessary for young students to declare a strike or hold processions in carrying out their movement for the salvation of the nation. Although students must observe proper rules in their salvation movement, they should not be bound too tightly by such rules. We are of the opinion that young students should unite among themselves, enlarge their movement and supervise and accelerate our Government by adequate means.

铁报
Iron News (11/12):

SHOPS WARNED BY POLICE AGAINST FOREIGN THIEVES

There are all kinds of thieves in Shanghai, including foreigners.
According to secret information received by the various Police authorities in Shanghai, a large number of White Russians are frequenting the large stores in groups of three's and five's to prey upon the people. They are well dressed and have the appearance of well-to-do foreign merchants, and they are welcomed by the shop assistants.
We understand that the Police have warned the various stores in their districts to pay special attention to such people.

China Times and other local newspapers (12/12):

GLASS-WORKS SUSPEND BUSINESS

Owing to trade depression and lack of funds, the Chung Kuo Glass-Works on Ferry Road, which had a capital of more than $100,000, suspended business yesterday.
Lawyer Cheng Ngo Ming is undertaking the liquidation.
pages.zh:
1935年12月16日。
下午译文。

《China Evening News》（评论）：

爱国运动

自五四运动以来，青年学生参与爱国运动的情况鲜有发生。
华北事变爆发后，北平学生出于义愤，发起了爱国运动。
12月14日，上海学生受北平教育界人士的鼓舞，也开始了类似的运动。我们可以暂且不论这种爱国运动是否有益，但它表明本地学生并未忘记他们在北方的国土。
当然，青年学生在开展救国运动时，并非绝对需要宣布罢工或举行游行。虽然学生在救国运动中必须遵守适当的规则，但不应被这些规则束缚得太紧。我们认为，青年学生应当团结起来，扩大运动规模，并通过适当的手段监督和推动我们的政府。

《铁报》
Iron News (12月11日)：

警方警告商店防范外籍窃贼

上海有各种各样的窃贼，包括外国人。
根据上海各警察当局收到的秘密情报，大量白俄正三五成群地光顾大型商店，伺机侵害民众。他们衣着光鲜，外表看似富裕的外国商人，因此受到店员的欢迎。
据悉，警方已警告其辖区内的各家商店对此类人员予以特别注意。

《China Times》及其他本地报纸 (12月12日)：

玻璃厂停业

由于贸易萧条和资金短缺，位于渡船路、资本超过10万美元的中国玻璃厂于昨日停业。
律师郑鄂明 (音译) 正在负责清算事宜。

December 15, 1935. Morning Translation

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers.

LOCAL EDUCATIONALISTS APPROACH MAYOR WU TE CHEN
STRIKES AND DEMONSTRATIONS FORBIDDEN.

At 11 a.m. December 14 Dr. T. H. Lee, Principal
of the Futan University, Dr. Liu Chen En, Principal of
the University of Shanghai, and over ten principals of
other local universities called upon Mayor Wu Te Chen
to whom they conveyed the following suggestions from the
local educationalists:-
1) To preserve the authority of administration
throughout the country.
2) To maintain territorial integrity.
3) To grant freedom to the press.
4) Diplomatic affairs to be dealt with in public
manner
Mayor Wu agreed to transmit the aforesaid suggestions
to the National Government.
After exchanging views, which lasted two hours,
it was mutually resolved that the Shanghai City Government,
the Shanghai Special District Kuomintang and the local
school authorities should jointly adopt precautionary
measures to prevent irresponsible persons from instigating
students who should neither suspend studies nor make
demonstrations.

Meetings Held by the local Students.

Over 500 students of the Kwang Hwa University
held a meeting at 10 a.m. December 14 at which the following
decisions were reached:-
1) That a telegram be sent to General Sun Cheh Yuen,
the newly appointed Chairman of the Hopei Provincial
Government, protesting against the so-called autonomous
movement.
2) That a telegram be sent to Peiping to appease
the students there.
3) That a telegram be sent to the Central Executive
Committee of the Kuomintang and the National Government
requesting them to preserve the territorial integrity and
opposing the so-called autonomous movement in North-China.
4) That the students of the Kwang Hwa University
should form a National Salvation Union with an executive
committee consisting of 15 members.

A meeting of a similar nature was held last night
by the students of the Tung Woo Law College.

The Students Union of the Chiao Tung University
yesterday sent a telegram to the educationalists in Peiping
offering their support for the preservation of the
territorial integrity.

《Sin Wan Pao》及其他本地报纸。

本地教育界人士拜会吴铁城市长
禁止罢工和示威。

12月14日上午11时，复旦大学校长李登辉博士、沪江大学校长刘湛恩博士以及本地其他十余所大学的校长拜会了吴铁城市长，向他转达了本地教育界人士的以下建议：
1) 维护全国行政权威。
2) 维持领土完整。
3) 给予新闻自由。
4) 外交事务应以公开方式处理
吴市长同意将上述建议转达给国民政府。
经过长达两小时的意见交换，双方共同决议，上海市政府、上海特别区国民党部和本地学校当局应联合采取预防措施，防止不负责任的人煽动学生，学生既不应停课，也不应进行示威。

本地学生举行的会议。

12月14日上午10时，光华大学500多名学生举行会议，达成以下决定：
1) 向新任河北省政府主席孙哲元将军发电，抗议所谓的自治运动。
2) 向北平发电，安抚当地学生。
3) 向国民党中央执行委员会和国民政府发电，请求他们维护领土完整，并反对华北所谓的自治运动。
4) 光华大学学生应成立救国联合会，执行委员会由15名成员组成。

昨晚，东吴法学院的学生也举行了类似性质的会议。

交通大学学生会昨日向北平的教育界人士发出电报，表示支持维护领土完整。

December 14, 1935.
Morning Translation.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

Yesterday the students of the Medical and Industrial Departments of the Tungchi University sent out the following two circular telegrams :-
(1) To General Ho Ying Ching, Minister of War, requesting him to release the students who had been arrested for participation in the patriotic movement.
(2) To the Peiping University Students Federation, expressing their warm sympathy and full support in order to accomplish the task of saving China from ruin.

Yesterday the Students Self-Control Union of the Great China University sent out the following two circular telegrams :-
(1) To various public offices, newspapers, schools and public bodies throughout the country, voicing their strong opposition to the autonomous movement in North China and requesting the National Government to take immediate steps to suppress it.
(2) To the Peiping University and Middle School Students Federation, expressing their warm sympathy with the patriotic movement started by the Federation and exhorting the Federation to struggle to the end in order to win the final victory.

Yesterday the entire body of students of the Ta Dong University(大同大学) sent out a circular telegram to the National Government, the various Ministries, public offices, schools and newspapers, protesting against the dismemberment of China's territorial sovereignty and administrative integrity by any party or in any form. The telegram requests the National Government to adopt drastic measures to deal with the so-called autonomous movement in East Hopei.

Yesterday the "Shanghai Twenty-Two Movement Acceleration Association"(上海二十二運動會) sent out a circular telegram to the people throughout the country, stating that the Association would stand by the Government in the grave national crisis now befalling North China.

Shun Pao publishes the following telegram from Nanking :-

Ministry of Education Advises Local Students To Refrain From Staging Demonstrations.

There is a tendency among students in various places to rally to the support of the patriotic movement recently started by their fellow students of the universities and middle schools in Peiping.
It is now learned that a similar movement is being contemplated by students of local universities and that the Ministry of Education has sent a wire to the Shanghai Bureau of Education instructing it to adopt precautionary measures and to advise the students to refrain from such activities.

1935年12月14日。
晨间译件。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

反对华北自治运动。

昨日，同济大学医科和工科学生发出以下两份通电：
(1) 致军政部长何应钦将军，请求释放因参与爱国运动而被捕的学生。
(2) 致北平学生联合会，表示热烈同情和全力支持，以完成救亡图存的任务。

昨日，大夏大学学生自律会发出以下两份通电：
(1) 致全国各公署、报馆、学校及公共团体，强烈反对华北自治运动，并请求国民政府立即采取措施予以镇压。
(2) 致北平大中学校学生联合会，对该联合会发起的爱国运动表示热烈同情，并劝勉该联合会斗争到底，以赢得最后胜利。

昨日，大同大学全体学生向国民政府、各部、公署、学校及报馆发出通电，抗议任何一方以任何形式分裂中国领土主权和行政完整。该电文请求国民政府采取严厉措施，对付所谓冀东自治运动。

昨日，“上海二十二运动会”向全国人民发出通电，称在该会将在目前降临华北的严重民族危机中支持政府。

《申报》刊登如下来自南京的电报：

教育部劝告本地学生勿举行示威游行。

各地学生有集结支持北平大中学校学生最近发起的爱国运动的倾向。
现获悉，本地大学学生也在酝酿类似运动，教育部已致电上海教育局，指示其采取预防措施，并劝告学生不要进行此类活动。

December 14, 1935.                          Morning Translation.

Shanghai Morning Post publishes the following telegram from
Taiyuan :-

        The students of various middle schools in
Taiyuan, Shensi Province, have formed a "Rebel Suppression
and National Salvation Federation."
        On the afternoon of December 13, the Preparatory
Committee of the Federation held a meeting at which it was
resolved to issue a circular telegram protesting against the
autonomous movement in North China.
        The Committee will meet again to-day.

Chen Pao (Shanghai Morning Post, an official organ of
General Chiang Kai Shek) publishes the following editorial:-

    Advice to the Authorities Regarding the Appeals Made by
                Students at Peiping

        On December 9, students at Peiping submitted
an appeal to the authorities protesting against the bogus
autonomous organization and defending the salvation of
the nation.    It was very cold on that day.    The Peiping
Military and Police Authorities, however, opened up the
hydrants and swept away the students, many of whom were
arrested.    According to a manifesto issued by educationists
at Peiping, it seems that the students have been released.
But the Peiping Authorities have in the meantime made a
statement to the effect that strict measures would be
adopted to deal with any movement that has certain ulterior
motives although under the name of patriotism.    We can see
from this that the Peiping Authorities are still hostile
towards the students.
        We regret the drenching with water and the
arrest of the students on the part of the Peiping Military
and Police Authorities.    The students were only holding
processions, and had submitted appeals against the
autonomous organization.    These were actions inspired by
patriotism.    The Peiping Authorities should have adopted
peaceful measures to stop the activities of the students
if they wished to do so.    The authorities should not
have poured water on the students especially during the
very cold weather and then arrested many of them.    We
remember that some time ago, when the beggar and loafer
group employed by certain authorities submitted an appeal
to the Tientsin City Government, under the name of patriotism,
the Military and Police at Tientsin not only treated them
exceedingly well, but allowed the group to occupy the
offices of the authorities and to create uprisings.
The Peiping students did not resort to such actions nor
occupy the offices of the authorities nor did they
create uprisings, nor was the action of their appeal
instigated by certain authorities, yet the Peiping
Authorities adopted a very different attitude towards them.
        Why did not the Military and Police
Authorities use water to sweep away the autonomous show
performed by the puppets?    Nevertheless, they have poured
water on the students who are opposed to such an autonomous
movement.    This is why the public are annoyed.
        The affairs at Peiping and Tientsin have
now reached a temporary settlement.    We hope that the
authorities will, in future, give concrete proof that
they are not less patriotic than the students.

1935年12月14日。                          晨间译件。

《上海晨报》刊登如下来自太原的电报：

        陕西省太原市各中学学生成立了“剿匪救国联合会”。
        12月13日下午，该联合会筹备委员会召开会议，决议
发出通电，抗议华北自治运动。
        委员会将于今日再次开会。

《陈报》（即《上海晨报》，蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）刊登如下社论：

    就北平学生向当局请愿事进言当局

        12月9日，北平学生向当局提交请愿书，抗议伪自治
组织，捍卫国家救亡。当日天气非常寒冷。然而，北平军警
当局却打开消防水龙头冲散学生，其中许多人被捕。根据北平
教育界人士发表的宣言，学生似乎已被释放。但与此同时，北平
当局发表声明称，将对任何虽以爱国为名但别有用心
的运动采取严厉措施。由此可见，北平当局对学生仍持
敌对态度。
        我们对北平军警当局用水浇淋和逮捕学生
表示遗憾。学生只是举行游行，并提交请愿书反对
自治组织。这些都是出于爱国热情的行动。如果北平当局
希望制止学生的活动，本应采取和平措施。当局不应
在严寒天气下向学生泼水，随后又逮捕许多人。我们记得，
不久前，当某些当局雇佣的乞丐和无赖团伙以爱国为名
向天津市政府提交请愿书时，天津军警不仅对他们
优待有加，还允许该团伙占据当局办公室并制造骚乱。
北平学生并未采取此类行动，也未占据当局办公室或
制造骚乱，其请愿行动也非受某些当局煽动，然而北平
当局却对他们采取了截然不同的态度。
        军警当局为何不用水冲散傀儡们表演的自治
闹剧？相反，他们却向反对这种自治运动的学生泼水。
这就是公众感到愤怒的原因。
        北平和天津的事态目前已得到暂时平息。我们希望
当局今后能给出具体证明，表明他们的爱国之心不亚于
学生。

VARIOUS CHINESE SCHOOL STUDENTS TAKE ACTIVE

It is reported that the students
of the school for Mongolian and Tibetan students, Futren
University, Tung-Chi University, Great China University
and Duh-Dong University are taking an active part in
the anti-autonomy movement in the North.

JAPAN LODGES PROTEST WITH CANTON AUTHORITIES
AGAINST STUDENTS' DEMONSTRATION

A telegram from Canton dated
December 14 states that on December 13 Military Attache
Usui lodged a protest with Gen. Chen Chi Tang against
the students' demonstration held in Canton on December 12.
While expressing his regret at the
incident, General Chen Chi Tang promised that he, in

PEI ICHI (音译)

各华校学生积极参与反自治运动

据报道，蒙藏学校、复旦(Futren)大学、同济(Tung-Chi)大学、大夏(Great China)大学和杜东(Duh-Dong)大学的学生正积极参与北方的反自治运动。

日本就学生示威向广州当局提出抗议

12月14日来自广州的电报称，12月13日，武官臼井(Usui)就12月12日在广州举行的学生示威向陈济棠将军提出抗议。
陈济棠将军对事件表示遗憾的同时，承诺今后将镇压此类示威，并惩办责任人。

pages.en:
-2-

Danger of student demonstrations in Shanghai

There are reports in circulation that radical
elements among the students of Shanghai are starting a
movement to stage a demonstration here in the near future.
According to the scheme alleged to have been discussed,
a parade would be held in Nantao and Chapei and attempts
made to enter the International Settlement and French
Concession. The police have no confirmation of these
reports. Considerable tension, however, prevails in
educational circles, and the occurrence of student
activities resulting from decisions made with a minimum
amount of preliminary discussion and preparation are
within the bounds of possibility.

Student Demonstrations in Hangchow

It is reported that a large number of students staged
a demonstration near the West Lake at Hangchow on Wednesday,
December 11, to protest against the autonomy movement in
North China and support a demand that students arrested
in Peiping be released.

Seamen's organizations conduct registration of seamen
willing to undergo military training

By order of the Special Kuomintang Delegate for
Seamen's Affairs, a list is being made by various seamen's
unions of seamen who are willing to undergo military
training. As soon as the lists are completed, military
training classes will be formed by the unions and placed
under the direction of a special Kuomintang delegate.
pages.zh:

上海学生示威的危险

有传闻称，上海学生中的激进分子正在发动一场运动，拟于近期在此地举行示威。据称讨论的方案是，在南市和闸北举行游行，并试图进入国际租界和法租界。警方尚未证实这些报告。然而，教育界气氛相当紧张，学生因极少的事前讨论和准备而做出决定并引发活动的情况是有可能发生的。

杭州学生示威

据报道，12月11日星期三，大量学生在杭州西湖附近举行示威，抗议华北自治运动，并要求释放北平被捕学生。

海员组织登记愿意接受军事训练的海员

奉国民党海员事务特别代表之命，各海员工会正在编制愿意接受军事训练的海员名单。名单编制完成后，将由工会组建军事训练班，并在国民党特别代表的指导下进行。
