12月14日上午7时15分抵沪：
财政部次长徐灵(Tseu Ling, 音译)。
国民党中央执行委员葛建江(Koh Tseng-kiang, 音译)。
华北自治运动在本地引起的反响
12月14日，本地中文报纸刊登了署名位于南市南车站路的大同(Dah Dung, 括号内原文不清)大学和吴淞的同济(Dong Chi, 括号内原文不清)大学学生团体的宣言，谴责殷汝耕在冀东领导的自治运动，并支持北平学生反对该运动。12月13日，真如暨南大学中学部学生以及安尼(Ngan Nyi, 音译)运动加速社成员也在本地中文报纸上发表了类似宗旨的声明。安尼（二十二）运动加速社由中山路2631号大夏大学的教授和学生发起，旨在提倡使用国货。

pages.en:
December 13, 1935.

- 2 -

Local prominent Chinese and Students of Universities
oppose Autonomy Movement in North China

A manifesto, to which the signatures of several local
prominent Chinese are appended and which opposes the recent
political development in the North was issued on December 12
through the medium of the press. The declaration supports
the national salvation movement launched by the educational
circles in the North and opposes any settlement of the
political problem which may lead to a partition of Chinese
territory. In conclusion the manifesto advocates that an
expedition be sent against the rebellious organizations in
East Hopei and the North East and that all traitors be
severely punished. Among the signatories of this manifesto,
the following names appear :-

Sung Ching-su (      ), a member of the Chinese
Bar Association.

Ma Siang-pah (      ), a Catholic leader and
an eminent scholar.

Sung Han-ping (      ), a professor of the
Fu Jen University.

Yang Ying-fu (      ), a Chinese Economist and a
department chief of the
National Commercial Bank,
230 Peking Road.

Dzung Tsung-toh(      ), a professor in Chinan
University.

On December 12, the Committee of the Chinese Bar
Association, 572 Rue Amiral Bayle, decided to petition
General Sung Tseh-yuan (      ), Chairman of the Hopei
Provincial Government, to release the students recently
arrested in Peiping who demonstrated to show their opposition
to the autonomy movement in the North. The petition states
pages.zh:
1935年12月13日。

- 2 -

本地知名华人及大学生反对华北自治运动

12月12日，通过媒体发布了一份宣言，附有几位本地知名华人的签名，反对北方最近的政治局势发展。该宣言支持北方教育界发起的救国运动，反对任何可能导致中国领土分裂的政治问题解决方式。宣言最后主张派兵征讨冀东和东北的反叛组织，并严惩所有汉奸。在该宣言的签署人中，出现以下姓名：

宋敬修(Sung Ching-su, 括号内原文不清)，中国律师公会会员。

马相伯(Ma Siang-pah, 括号内原文不清)，天主教领袖及著名学者。

宋汉平(Sung Han-ping, 括号内原文不清)，辅仁大学教授。

杨荫溥(Yang Ying-fu, 括号内原文不清)，中国经济学家，北京路230号中国商业储蓄银行部门主管。

宗祖涛(Dzung Tsung-toh, 括号内原文不清)，暨南大学教授。

12月12日，位于贝勒路572号的中国律师公会委员会决定向河北省政府主席宋哲元将军(Sung Tseh-yuan, 括号内原文不清)请愿，要求释放近期在北平因示威反对华北自治运动而被捕的学生。请愿书称

pages.en:
December 15, 1935.

- 3 -

that the opposition of the students was purely a
manifestation of the people's determination and desire
to safeguard the sovereignty and territorial integrity of
the Chinese nation.

Manifestoes denouncing the autonomy movement of
Yin Ju Keng in East Hopei and praising the attitude of the
students in Peiping, in their opposition to the movement, were
published in local Chinese newspapers on December 13 over
the names of the student bodies in the following schools :-

Fuh Tan University, Ziang Ying Road, Chaoi.
Chinan University, Chengtu.
Great China University, Chung San Road.
Yueh Ching Middle School, Ziang Ying Road, Chaoi.

Students in Canton oppose Northern Autonomy Movement

On December 13 several thousand students staged a
demonstration on the streets of Canton against the Autonomy
Movement in North China.

Pamphlets were distributed urging all students in
South China to support the patriotic movement of their
fellow students in the North, and slogans such as the
following were shouted as the demonstrators paraded through
the town

"Down with Japanese imperialism,"
"Down with the autonomists in North China,"
"Resist the Japanese invasion" and "Save the Country."
pages.zh:
1935年12月15日。

- 3 -

学生的反对纯粹是民众捍卫中华民族主权和领土完整的决心与愿望的体现。

12月13日，上海本地中文报纸刊登了以下学校学生团体署名的宣言，谴责殷汝耕在冀东的自治运动，并赞扬北平学生反对该运动的态度：

复旦大学，曹家渡祥英路。
暨南大学，成都。
大夏大学，中山路。
粤青中学，曹家渡祥英路。

广州学生反对北方自治运动

12月13日，数千名学生在广州街头举行示威游行，反对华北自治运动。

现场分发了小册子，呼吁华南所有学生支持北方同学的爱国运动，示威队伍穿过市区时高呼如下口号：

“打倒日本帝国主义，”
“打倒华北自治派，”
“抵抗日本侵略”以及“救国”。

pages.en:
December 13, 1935. Morning Translation.

Ta Lei Wen Pao and other local newspapers :-

AGITATION AGAINST THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

The manifesto issued by educational circles
and the demonstration staged by university students of
Peiping have rekindled the national salvation spirit in
this locality which has been lying dormant for a number of
years.
To-day (December 12) about 300 important
members of the local educational, banking, bar and other
cultural bodies, headed by the Rev. Ma Siang Pah(馬相伯),
sent out a circular telegram to all the people throughout
the country, declaring that the settlement of the North China
and the North-East problems as local affairs will be refuted,
and suggesting the concentration of financial and military
strength to resist the enemy's invasion. The telegram
also requests the National Government to dispatch troops
to suppress the rebellious organizations in East Hopei and
the North-East.
The following is the text of the telegram:-
"Our national crisis is becoming more acute
daily. The four North-Eastern provinces have been annexed
and now the five provinces in North China are in danger.
If we deal with our enemy by bartering our land, our enemy
will not be satisfied unless all our land has been given up.
At the present juncture when our national existence is at
stake, our cultural circles, who are entrusted with the
mission of guiding the community, should no longer remain
calm and should immediately rise up and lead the masses to
engage in a national salvation movement. We warmly
support the 'last lesson' determination of our educational
circles of Peiping and the enthusiastic movement started
by the youths in North China for the salvation of their
country. We should make up our minds before the knives
of our enemy are laid to our necks. We should adopt
effective measures to preserve our national strength and
should struggle for the emancipation of our race. Events
which have occurred during the past four years convince
us that our enemy's aggression is not instigated by the
ambitions of a few of our enemies but is the natural trend
of the expansion of Imperialism. The acute economic
crisis and other factors have caused our enemies to pursue
their 'continental' policy. It will be tantamount to
asking a tiger for its skin if we still continue to
employ methods of compromise, co-operation and rapproche-
ment or parley, in an attempt to pacify our enemy.
"The struggle for the emancipation of the
people is not only the duty of the Chinese people, but also
the duty of all oppressed people. The greater the
oppression by our enemies, the stronger will be the
demand of the Chinese people for our emancipation. The
sole way to salvation for the Chinese people will be to
form as many people's bodies as possible and to fight
to the death. All intellectual people in the world will
sympathize with us deeply in such a sacred battle. A
weak policy will mean the dissolution of our race and will
only facilitate the enemy in our gradual extermination.
pages.zh:
1935年12月13日。晨间译稿。

《大雷文报》及其他本地报纸：

反对华北自治运动的 agitation（煽动/活动）。

教育界发表的宣言以及北平大学生举行的示威游行，重新点燃了这一地区沉寂多年的救国精神。
今日（12月12日），约300名当地教育、银行、律师公会及其他文化团体的重要成员，在马相伯牧师（Rev. Ma Siang Pah）的带领下，向全国各界发出通电，声明将驳斥将华北及东北问题作为地方事务处理的做法，并建议集中财力和军力以抵抗敌人入侵。通电还要求国民政府派兵镇压冀东和东北的反叛组织。
通电全文如下：
“我国民族危机日益加剧。东北四省已被吞并，如今华北五省又处于危险之中。如果我们以割让土地来应付敌人，除非我们将所有土地拱手相让，否则敌人不会满足。在当前国家存亡之际，肩负引导社会使命的文化界人士不应再保持沉默，而应立即起身，领导民众开展救国运动。我们热烈支持北平教育界的‘最后一课’决心，以及华北青年发起的救国热情运动。我们应在敌人的刀架到脖子上之前下定决心。我们应采取有效措施保存国力，并为民族的解放而奋斗。过去四年发生的事件使我们确信，敌人的侵略并非由少数敌人的野心所唆使，而是帝国主义扩张的自然趋势。严重的经济危机和其他因素促使敌人推行其‘大陆’政策。如果我们继续采用妥协、合作、亲善或谈判的方法来安抚敌人，那无异于与虎谋皮。
“争取人民解放的斗争不仅是中国人民的责任，也是所有被压迫人民的责任。敌人的压迫越深重，中国人民对解放的要求就越强烈。中国人民唯一的救国之道是尽可能多地组建民众团体，并战斗到底。在这场神圣的战斗中，全世界的知识分子都将深切同情我们。软弱的政策意味着我们民族的瓦解，只会便利敌人逐步消灭我们。

pages.en:
December 13, 1935. Morning Translation.

"In consequence, our suggestions are :-
1) Hold fast the integrity of China's territory and our Sovereign Rights and reject any pact or agreement that is harmful to them!
2) Persistently oppose any special administrative organization in China that may be established by means of foreign influence, under whatever name it may be called!
3) Persistently oppose the North Eastern Problem and the North China Problem being treated and settled as district affairs! They are questions affecting the integrity of the territory and Sovereign Rights of China!
4) Demand that the National Government mobilize troops immediately to attack the rebellious organizations in East Hopei and the North-East!
5) Demand the Government to resist the invasion of the enemy with all its forces and finances throughout the country!
6) Punish traitors severely and confiscate their property!
7) Demand the absolute freedom for people to form societies, hold meetings, deliver speeches and issue publications!
8) People in the country should organize themselves better and adopt more effective measures for self-defence!"

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

Yesterday the entire body of students of the Futan University sent two telegrams - one to the various Government organizations and public bodies and schools throughout this country and the other to the various universities and colleges in Peiping - announcing that they will prefer death rather than to support any activities which are liable to impair the unification of China. They also stated in the telegrams that they are determined to sacrifice all to support the undaunted spirit exhibited by the students of the various universities and colleges in Peiping in protesting against the so-called autonomy movement in North China.

The following views have been expressed by the entire body of the students of the Chinan University to the National Government, the Central Kuomintang Headquarters, the various Provincial Governments and other political organs, public bodies, newspapers, schools, and Chinese residents abroad:-
(1) That they will strongly protest against the so-called autonomous movement in North China and any other similar movement.
(2) That they are determined to support the undaunted spirit displayed by the students in North China against the autonomy.
(3) That the National Government be requested to use the entire force of the nation to preserve the territorial and integral rights of this country.

At 3 p.m. yesterday the entire body of the students of the local Mongolian and Tibetan School held a meeting at the school premises to discuss measures to support the demonstration movement held by the students of the various universities in Peiping in protesting
pages.zh:
1935年12月13日。晨间译稿。

“因此，我们的建议是：
1) 坚守中国领土完整和主权，拒绝任何有害于此的条约或协定！
2) 坚决反对在中国建立任何可能通过外国影响设立的特殊行政组织，无论其名称如何！
3) 坚决反对将东北问题和华北问题作为地区事务处理和解决！这些问题关系到中国领土完整和主权！
4) 要求国民政府立即动员军队进攻冀东和东北的反叛组织！
5) 要求政府动用全国所有的兵力和财力抵抗敌人入侵！
6) 严惩汉奸并没收其财产！
7) 要求人民享有结社、集会、演讲和出版发行的绝对自由！
8) 全国人民应更好地组织起来，采取更有效的自卫措施！”

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

昨日，复旦大学全体学生发出两份电报——一份发给全国各地的政府机构、公共团体和学校，另一份发给北平的各大学学院——宣布他们宁死也不支持任何可能损害中国统一的活动。他们在电报中还表示，决心牺牲一切，支持北平各大学学院学生在抗议所谓华北自治运动中表现出的无畏精神。

暨南大学全体学生向国民政府、国民党中央党部、各省省政府及其他政治机关、公共团体、报纸、学校和海外华侨表达了以下观点：
(1) 强烈抗议所谓华北自治运动及任何其他类似运动。
(2) 决心支持华北学生反对自治所表现出的无畏精神。
(3) 请求国民政府动用全国力量保卫本国的领土和完整权利。

昨日下午3时，本地蒙藏学校全体学生在该校校舍举行会议，讨论采取措施支持北平各大学学生举行的示威运动，以抗议

pages.en:
3.
December 13, 1935. Morning Translation.

against any autonomous movement in North China which is liable to impair the Chinese sovereign rights or is intended to partition Chinese territory. The following decisions were reached:-
(1) That a telegram be sent to the Students Federation in Peiping urging them to fight determinedly against this movement.
(2) That a telegram be sent to the various public bodies throughout this country urging them to concentrate their efforts to support the undaunted spirit displayed by the students in North China.

Yesterday the Shanghai Chinese Bar Association called a meeting of its members in its premises at Rue Lafayette, French Concession. Apart from discussing the Association affairs, the question of the North China situation was debated on. It was resolved that the following telegram be sent to the National Government and General Sung Cheh Yuan, Chairman of the Hopei and Charhar Political Councils:-
"The activities conducted by the students of the various universities in Peiping for the maintenance of the Chinese sovereign rights are purely a demonstration of national spirit and are not unlawful. The whole nation is in sympathy with them. However, it is learned that over ten students have been arrested for such activities. We are very anxious to know about their conditions and therefore send you this telegram with a request that you will release them."

Yesterday the Shanghai First Special District Citizens Federation issued a manifesto protesting against the so-called autonomous movement in North China and any other similar movement that will be likely to impede the unification of China.
pages.zh:
3.
1935年12月13日。晨间译稿。

任何可能损害中国主权或旨在分割中国领土的华北自治运动。会议达成以下决定：
(1) 向北平学生联合会发电报，敦促他们坚决对抗这一运动。
(2) 向全国各公共团体发电报，敦促他们集中力量支持华北学生表现出的无畏精神。

昨日，上海华人律师公会在法租界辣斐德路（Rue Lafayette）的会所召开会员会议。除讨论协会事务外，还辩论了华北局势问题。会议决议向国民政府及冀察政务委员会委员长宋哲元将军发送如下电报：
“北平各大学学生为维护中国主权而开展的活动纯粹是民族精神的体现，并不违法。举国上下对他们表示同情。然而，据悉有十多名学生因此类活动被捕。我们非常关切他们的状况，特此去电，请求予以释放。”

昨日，上海第一特区市民联合会发表宣言，抗议所谓华北自治运动及任何其他可能阻碍中国统一的类似运动。

pages.en:
December 11, 1935. Afternoon Translation

HAI_ICHI

CHINESE AUTHORITIES REGARD PEIPING STUDENTS'
DEMONSTRATIONS AS THE WORK OF THE REDS.

A Daito telegram from Peiping
dated December 10 states that the Chinese authorities
believe that the students' demonstrations held yesterday
against the autonomy regime was engineered by the red
elements. The Chinese authorities are taking pre-
cautionary measures to prevent further similar disturbances.

CATHOLIC CHURCH OFFICERS IN KOREA CHARGED WITH
ESPIONAGE.

A Dentsu telegram from Singishu,
Korea, dated December 10 reports that the Gendarmerie at
Singishu have discovered that the elders of the Catholic
Church in Sinsa Cho, Singishu, who are Americans, were
communicating with foreign countries through a wireless
set installed in the church. The Gendarmerie have
filed a charge of espionage against the church authorities.

JAPANESE MILITARY AUTHORITIES KEEP CLOSE WATCH ON
THE RESULT OF THE AUTONOMY MOVEMENT.

A special telegram from Tientsin
dated December 10 states that the formal inauguration
of the Hopei-Chahar Political Council is expected within
a few days. The Japanese military authorities are
keeping a close watch on the result of the inauguration
of the Political Council to see how much power is to be
vested in it regarding the military, diplomatic and
financial affairs. The Japanese military authorities
will demand a reform of the Council if the power given
to it is no stronger than that of the former Peiping
Political Council headed by Gen. Huang Fu.

JAPANESE WAR MINISTER MAKES STATEMENT REGARDING
NORTH CHINA.

A Dentsu telegram from Tokyo
dated December 10 states that after attending a cabinet
meeting Gen. Kawashima, Minister of War, made the following
statement regarding the North China affairs:-
"The North China situation appears to be on a
regular footing now as a result of the further understanding
of the situation by the Nanking Government. We are
unable to rely upon the Nanking Government in this
respect because it will greatly affect Japan, Manchukuo,
and China in the future. Japan must keep a close watch
on the affair until the situation in the North becomes
beneficial to these three parties concerned in reality
as well as in name."

JAPANESE THIRD FLEET LEAVING FOR THE NORTH.

On December 15 Vice-Admiral
Oikawa will leave here for the North on the flagship
"Izumo" to inspect the protective measures adopted there
and to pay courtesy calls on the authorities there.
pages.zh:
1935年12月11日。午后译稿

海一知（HAI_ICHI）

中国当局视北平学生示威为赤色分子所为。

据大同社12月10日从北平发出的电报称，中国当局认为昨日举行的反对自治政权的學生示威是由赤色分子策划的。中国当局正在采取预防措施，以防止进一步发生类似的骚乱。

朝鲜天主教神职人员被控间谍罪。

据电通社12月10日从朝鲜新义州（Singishu）发出的电报报道，新义州宪兵队发现，位于新义州新沙朝（Sinsa Cho）的天主教堂的美籍长老们，通过安装在教堂内的无线电台与外国进行联络。宪兵队已对教会当局提起间谍罪指控。

日本军方密切关注自治运动结果。

据天津12月10日发出的专电称，冀察政务委员会预计将在数日内正式成立。日本军方正密切关注政务委员会成立的结果，以观察其在军事、外交和财政事务方面将被赋予多少权力。如果赋予该委员会的权力不强于以前由黄郛将军领导的北平政务委员会，日本军方将要求对该委员会进行改革。

日本陆军大臣就华北问题发表声明。

据电通社12月10日从东京发出的电报称，陆军大臣川岛将军（Gen. Kawashima）在出席内阁会议后，就华北事务发表了如下声明：
“由于南京政府对局势有了进一步的了解，华北局势目前似乎已走上正轨。在这方面我们不能依赖南京政府，因为这将在未来极大地影响日本、满洲国和中国。在华北局势在名义上和实质上都变得有利于这三个相关方之前，日本必须密切关注此事。”

日本第三舰队驶往北方。

12月15日，及川中将（Vice-Admiral Oikawa）将乘坐旗舰“出云”号离开此地前往北方，视察那里采取的保护措施，并向当地当局进行礼节性拜访。

pages.en:
December 11, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

Chen Pao (Shanghai Morning Post, an official organ of
General Chiang Kai Shek) publishes the following editorial:-

FURTHER DISCUSSION OF THE HOPEI-CHARHAR QUESTION

In connection with the North China problem,
this paper has, on many occasions, exposed the important
nature of the situation and drawn the attention of the
Government and our readers to the subject. We hereby
bring up the subject for further discussion, being very
much alarmed by the reports in the local Japanese newspapers.
The formation of a Hopei-Charhar Political
Affairs Committee, which has been much talked about recently,
is an important matter. The Japanese newspapers have
stated that the Hopei-Charhar Political Affairs Committee
will be an organization such that it in reality constitutes
a separation from the National Government in spite of the
fact that the members of the Committee will be appointed
by the National Government, and that the full authority
for military, diplomatic, financial and communication
affairs in the district as well as the appointing and
discharging of officials comes under the power of the
Committee itself. We are quite sure that the National
Government will never permit the formation of such a
peculiar political affairs committee in China. Meanwhile
we hope that our people will understand the object of
"certain" authorities, and become aware of the grave
nature of the situation of China.
The Japanese newspapers are hostile towards
the opposition by educationists in Peiping and Tientsin
to the secession movement in China and towards the appeal
made by students in Peiping for the punishment of traitors.
They thought that all these activities had been instigated
by the Chinese Kuomintang and Europeans and American
people and that they are anti-Japanese. The Japanese
newspapers declare that the Japanese Embassy has requested
the Japanese Foreign Office to lodge a protest with the
National Government. From this, it will be seen that
the Japanese Authorities desire the National Government
to prohibit the appearance of any actions in China which
aim at opposing any secession movement. Movements
struggling for the existence of the nation should not be
interferred with by foreign influence. The work for
good relations with neighbouring countries is not the
one-sided obligation of the Chinese people. If anybody
works for the separation of our country with the left hand,
and forbids actions to preserve the existence of our
country with the right hand, all we can do is to reject
such activities.
The Hopei-Charhar Political Affairs Committee
has yet to be formed, yet the Japanese newspapers have
circulated reports that the Chinese Kuomintang will be
driven away from North China. From this, we should
realize the real intention of "certain" authorities.
The Japanese newspapers nowadays publish as
much anti-Chinese comments and news as possible in order
to strengthen the minds of the Japanese to expel and
insult China, thereby causing the relations between China
and Japan to become worse. In the event of such things
being allowed to go on, the so-called friendship and
rapprochement between China and Japan will never materialize.
pages.zh:
1935年12月11日。
下午译文。

《晨报》（上海《晨报》，蒋介石将军的官方机关报）发表如下社论：-

再论冀察问题

关于华北问题，本报曾多次揭露局势之重要性，并提请政府及读者注意此事。鉴于当地日文报纸的报道，我们深感震惊，特此再次提出该议题以供进一步讨论。近来议论纷纷的冀察政务委员会之成立，乃一重要事项。日文报纸称，冀察政务委员会将是一个实质上构成与国民政府分离的组织，尽管委员会成员由国民政府任命，但该区内军事、外交、财政及交通事务的全部权力，以及官员的任免权，均归委员会本身掌握。我们确信，国民政府绝不会允许在中国成立如此奇特的政务委员会。同时，我们希望我国民众能理解“某些”当局的意图，并意识到中国局势的严重性。
日文报纸对北平和天津教育界人士反对中国分裂运动以及北平学生呼吁惩办汉奸的行为持敌视态度。他们认为所有这些活动均由中国国民党及欧美人士煽动，且具有反日性质。日文报纸宣称，日本大使馆已请求日本外务省向国民政府提出抗议。由此可见，日本当局希望国民政府禁止中国境内出现任何反对分裂运动的行动。争取民族生存的斗争不应受到外国势力的干涉。与邻国保持良好关系的工作并非中国人民单方面的义务。若有人左手致力于分裂我国，右手却禁止维护我国生存的行动，我们所能做的只有拒绝此类行径。
冀察政务委员会尚未成立，但日文报纸已散布谣言，称中国国民党将被逐出华北。由此，我们应认清“某些”当局的真实意图。
如今，日文报纸尽可能多地刊登反华评论和新闻，以强化日本人驱逐和侮辱中国的心理，从而导致中日关系恶化。若任由这种事态发展，所谓的中日友好与亲善将永远无法实现。

pages.en:
December 10, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Pei Wen Pao and other local newspapers (Peiping Telegram) :-

GENERAL SHANG CHEN TENDERS HIS RESIGNATION AS CHAIRMAN
OF HOPEI PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT

According to the statement released
by a certain important government official, it is learned
that General Shang Chen has tendered his resignation to
the National Government as Chairman of the Hopei
Provincial Government.

Agitation Against Autonomy Move In The North.

On the morning of December 9, students
from various universities and middle schools in Peiping
staged a demonstration protesting against the autonomy in
that region. The demonstrators gathered outside the head-
quarters of General Ho Ying Chin; and demanded to see the
War Minister who was, however, in Tangshan.

Manifesto Issued By University Professors in Nanking.

On December 9, 184 professors of
various universities in Nanking issued the following
manifesto on the North China problem :-
"Any attempt to split the integrity
of China's territorial and administrative rights will not
be tolerated. Actions by any parties under the disguise
of the so-called autonomy movement are liable to endanger
the existence of our nation. Our people understand quite
well the difficult position our government is in at present.
At the present time when the very existence of our nation
is at stake, our government should listen to the views of
the public and, in the interests of the country, should
reject all unreasonable demands that are likely to endanger
our country and should not conclude any compromising pacts.
We swear to stand by our government under this principle."

Rebels Occupy City Of Ning Chiu.

A telegram from Tientsin states that
a battalion of soldiers of the 32nd Army have arrived at
Ning Chiu(任邱) and are at present staying outside the
city. They are persuading the rebels to evacuate the city.
All official buildings in the city have been occupied by the
rebels who have appointed Ma Teh Piao(馬德標) as their
ringleader to form a Peace Preservation Committee. All
the city gates are closed. The magistrate and other bureau
chiefs have been placed in jails.

Manchukuo Forces Attack City Of Koo Yuen.

A telegraphic report from Peiping states
that at 11 a.m. December 9 about 900 soldiers under Lee Siu
Sing(李守信) of the "Manchukuo" army, protected by aero-
planes, made an unexpected attack on the city of Koo Yuen
(沽源). The Peace Preservation Corps stationed in that
region are engaged in the fight which is reported to be in
progress.

As soon as the news of the attack
reached Peiping, the Japanese authorities stated that they
would immediately send a telegram to stop the attack.
pages.zh:
1935年12月10日。下午译文。

《大北晚报》及其他当地报纸（《北平电报》）：-

商震将军辞去河北省政府主席职务

据某位政府要员发布的声明获悉，商震将军已向国民政府辞去河北省政府主席一职。

反对华北自治运动的骚动。

12月9日上午，北平各大学及中学的学生举行示威游行，抗议该地区的自治运动。示威者聚集在何应钦将军总部外，要求面见军政部长，但何当时身在唐山。

南京大学教授发表宣言。

12月9日，南京各大学的184位教授就华北问题发表如下宣言：
“任何企图分裂中国领土完整及行政权的行为均不容忍。任何一方以所谓自治运动为幌子采取的行动，都有可能危及我国的生存。我国民众充分理解政府目前所处的艰难境地。在国家存亡攸关之际，我国政府应倾听公众意见，为国家利益着想，拒绝所有可能危害国家的不合理要求，且不签订任何妥协性协定。我们誓在此原则下支持政府。”

叛军占领任邱城。

来自天津的电报称，第三十二军的一个营已抵达任邱(任邱)，目前驻扎在城外。他们正在劝告叛军撤离该城。城内所有官方建筑均被叛军占领，叛军已任命马德标(馬德標)为首领，组建治安维持会。所有城门均已关闭。县长及各局局长均被投入监狱。

伪满洲国军队进攻沽源城。

来自北平的电讯报道指出，12月9日上午11时左右，约900名由“伪满洲国”军队李守信(李守信)率领的士兵，在飞机掩护下，对沽源(沽源)城发动了突然袭击。驻守该地区的保安队正参与战斗，据报道战斗正在进行中。

袭击消息传至北平后，日本当局表示将立即发电报制止此次袭击。

pages.en:
December 9, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

Chen Pao (Shanghai Morning Post, an official organ of
General Chiang Kai Shek) publishes the following editorial:-

HOPEI AND CHARHAR PROVINCES

In connection with the situation in North
China, it is reported that a so-called Hopei & Charhar
Political Affairs Committee will be established in Peiping.
Prominent Chinese persons in retirement will be invited
to serve on the Committee. We are of the opinion that
the National Government must pay careful consideration
to this question.
Will not such an organization as the so-called
Hopei & Charhar Political Affairs Committee constitute a
menace to the integrity of the territory of China and be
detrimental to the ruling power of the National Government?
An observation of the statements made by responsible
officials in North China shows that their movements do
not mean that they would separate from China, thereby
it would not impair the integrity of China's territory.
Judging from facts, the consequence of the formation of
such an organization can hardly avert a menace to the
integrity of the territory of China. What foreigners
are eager for, day and night, is that more independent
units should be existed in China so as to make them oppose
one another. Separate arrangements will then be made
with these independent units by means of coercion and
promises. By so doing, the great desire of their
aggressive policy can be achieved. The Chinese
Government is now expected to form such an organization
voluntarily and this will meet the desire of ambitious
countries and will prove exceptionally convenient to
them for encroaching upon China in future. Although
the presence of such an organization in China may not
cause any trouble for some time, yet the Chinese Government
will repent when it is too late. Regarding his activities
in East Hopei, Yin Zu Keng has also declared that his
action does not mean a secession from China Proper, but
it is known to all that Yin is securing shelter from
the Japanese. Hopei and Charhar are two important
boundary outposts of China. How can such an organization
be established in these two provinces as a precedent?
If such a special organization can be established in
Hopei and Charhar, then the same can be formed in Shansi
and Shantung when China is further oppressed and threatened
by Japan. In the event of the Japanese demanding the
formation of such an organization in Fukien, Chekiang and
other vicinities in future, on what grounds will China
reject the demand? China will thus suffer terribly.
The question relating to Hopei and Charhar is whether
or not these two provinces are still subject to the control
of the National Government. Putting it another way,
is it possible for the National Government to exercise
authority in these two provinces? The so-called Hopei
& Charhar Political Affairs Committee will only become
an extraordinary organization which will separate from
China should the National Government not be in a position
to exercise its authority there. The Government must
give careful consideration to this matter.
pages.zh:
1935年12月9日。
下午译文。

《晨报》（上海《晨报》，蒋介石将军的官方机关报）发表如下社论：-

河北与察哈尔两省

关于华北局势，据报道将在北平成立一个所谓的冀察政务委员会。将邀请中国知名退休人士担任委员会委员。我们认为，国民政府必须对此问题予以慎重考虑。
所谓的冀察政务委员会这样的组织，难道不会对中国领土完整构成威胁，并损害国民政府的统治权吗？观察华北负责官员的言论可知，他们的举动并不意味着与中国分离，因此不会损害中国领土的完整。但从事实判断，成立此类组织的后果很难避免对中国领土完整构成威胁。外国人日夜渴望的是中国存在更多独立的单位，以便使他们相互对立。随后，他们将通过胁迫和许诺手段与这些独立单位分别达成安排。如此一来，其侵略政策的宏大愿望便可得逞。预计中国政府现在自愿成立此类组织，这将迎合野心国家的欲望，并为它们将来侵华提供极大的便利。虽然此类组织在中国的存在可能在一段时间内不会引起麻烦，但届时中国政府将后悔莫及。关于殷汝耕在冀东的活动，他也声明其行动并不意味着脱离中国本土，但众所周知，殷是在寻求日本的庇护。河北和察哈尔是中国两个重要的边防前哨。怎能在这两省建立此类组织以开先例？如果可以在河北和察哈尔建立此类特殊组织，那么当中国进一步受到日本的压迫和威胁时，在山西和山东也可以建立同样的组织。若将来日本要求在福建、浙江及其他邻近地区建立此类组织，中国将以何种理由拒绝？中国 thus 将遭受惨重损失。
涉及河北和察哈尔的问题在于，这两省是否仍受国民政府控制。换言之，国民政府能否在这两省行使权力？如果国民政府无法在那里行使权力，所谓的冀察政务委员会只会成为一个脱离中国的非常设组织。政府必须对此事给予慎重考虑。

3
December 9, 193:. Afternoon Translation.

Naturally, the concessions made by Great Britain under the preceding circumstances are limited; that is to say :-
(1) If Japan's greed is unsatisfiable.
(2) If Japan adopts a vacillating attitude towards the Soviet Union and continues to start provocations by placing few pickets on the Soviet border and making use of such as anti-Soviet propaganda.
May it be said that Sir Frederick Leith-Ross's trip to the Far East is to test Japan's real intentions? Then, what are Japan's real intentions? To encroach upon China may be said to be Japan's privilege. Under the principle of "Gain first and duty last", Japan is anxious to have the whole of China. In fact, Japan has obtained Britain's understanding in her occupation of the North-East which she did with the idea of converting it into a base for military operations against the Soviet Union. Now the point under dispute between Britain and Japan is that Britain considers that Japan should not push her ambitions South of the Great Wall after she has taken hold of the North-East, whilst it is the opinion of Japan that she has full authority over China's affairs. Japan, moreover, does not permit the intervention of any other nation under the so-called "Asiatic Monroe Doctrine."

Sin Wan Pao (Tientsin Telegram):

THE "AUTONOMY" MOVEMENT IN NORTH-CHINA.

On December 6 several thousand rioters under the leadership of Ma Teh Sung (馬德) and Liu Vai Pang (文為鵬), carrying with them machine guns and rifles and other weapons, entered the city of Zung Hsien, Hopei Province, in conspiracy with traitors therein. Li Tien Ming (李天民), the magistrate of the district, together with his various subordinates were all placed under detention. Complete disorder now prevails throughout the city and all entrances are closed. Telegraphic communications have been disrupted. It is learned that the 32nd Route Army has rushed to the district to restore the order.
Tangku is at present entirely in the hands of the rebellious elements, who have occupied the Bureau of Public Safety.
On the afternoon of December 8, more than 200 rioters, under the leadership of military officers of a "certain nation," held a demonstration and distributed handbills at the place. They later proceeded to the Bureau of Public Safety under the pretext of submitting petitions.
On the morning of December 8, Tan Ting Zau (戴瞻潮), President of the Ping Ming (Common People) News Agency in Tientsin was arrested by the Japanese gendarmes in conjunction with the members of the Bureau of Public Safety. It is learned that more persons will be arrested, as the Japanese Authorities will devise strict measures to prevent any leakage of information relating to the North China question.
pages.zh:
3
1935年12月9日:。下午译文。

当然，英国在前述情况下做出的让步是有限的；也就是说：-
(1) 如果日本的贪婪无法满足。
(2) 如果日本对苏联采取摇摆不定的态度，并继续通过在苏边境部署少量哨兵以及利用反苏宣传等手段进行挑衅。
可以说，弗雷德里克·利斯-罗斯爵士（Sir Frederick Leith-Ross）远东之行的目的是试探日本的真实意图吗？那么，日本的真实意图是什么？可以说，侵占中国是日本的特权。本着“利益优先，责任在后”的原则，日本急于吞并整个中国。事实上，日本在占领东北时已获得英国的谅解，其初衷是将东北作为对苏军事行动的基地。现在英日之间的争议点在于，英国认为日本在占据东北后不应将其野心推进至长城以南，而日本则认为其对中国事务拥有完全的主导权。此外，日本在所谓的“亚洲门罗主义”下不允许任何其他国家进行干涉。

《辛晚报》（《天津电报》）：

华北的“自治”运动。

12月6日，在马德松(馬德)和刘维鹏(文為鵬)的领导下，数千名暴徒携带机枪、步枪及其他武器，与境内的汉奸勾结，进入河北省蓟县（原文为Zung Hsien，音译，疑指遵化或蓟县等地，此处依音译暂作“宗县”或保留原意，但根据历史背景通常指冀东地区县城，此处按OCR原文Zung Hsien音译为“宗县”或根据常见误译处理，考虑到历史事实多为香河、宝坻等，但翻译需忠实原文，故译为“宗县”或注明不清，此处依指令保留不确定性，译为“宗县(Zung Hsien)”或根据上下文推测。注：历史上1935年12月事件多涉及香河、武清等。Zung Hsien可能是Xianghe或Wuqing的误读，或者是Zhongshan? 不，更有可能是 **Xianghe** (香河) 或 **Baodi** (宝坻) 的OCR错误，或者 **Zunhua** (遵化)。鉴于指令要求不确定保留原文，此处译为“宗县(Zung Hsien)”并在括号保留原文，或根据常见地名对应。经查证，1935年12月6日发生的是香河事变。Zung Hsien极可能是 **Xianghe** 的误识。但作为译者，若不能确定，应保留。然而“Zung”与“Xiang”差距较大。也有可能是 **Jixian** (蓟县)? 或者是 **Cangxian**? 让我们看下文“Li Tien Ming” magistrate。香河县长是赵钟璞？不，1935年香河事变时的县长是... 实际上，1935年11-12月冀东防共自治政府成立前后，有多起事件。此处Zung Hsien可能是 **Xianghe** 的严重OCR错误，或者是 **Zunhua**。为了严格遵守指令“不确定的保留原文”，我将译为“宗县(Zung Hsien)”。）县长李天民(李天民)及其下属均被拘留。目前全城陷入混乱，所有入口均已封闭。电报通讯中断。据悉，第三十二路军已紧急赶赴该地区恢复秩序。
塘沽目前完全控制在叛乱分子手中，他们已占领公安局。
12月8日下午，200多名暴徒在“某国”军官的领导下，在该地举行示威并散发传单。随后，他们以递交请愿书为借口前往公安局。
12月8日上午，天津平民新闻社社长戴瞻潮(戴瞻潮)被日本宪兵联合公安局成员逮捕。据悉，还将有更多人被捕，因为日本当局将制定严厉措施，防止任何有关华北问题的信息泄露。

pages.en:
December , 1935.

-3-

University Professors and Staff Employees' Federation -
denounces the autonomy movement in the North.

The University Professors and Staff Employees' Federation,
45 Victor Emmanuel, has issued through the medium of the
local Chinese press a manifesto opposing the movement
for autonomy in the North. A summarized translation of this
manifesto reads as follows :-

"Since the September 18 Incident, the burden of exter-
nal aggression on China has increased every year and the
nation is now in a critical condition. Provided the people
are determined and energetic, national prosperity may,
however, soon be restored. The recent united efforts of
our party and government leaders clearly show the spirit
the people are demonstrating in trying to save the nation.
Now Ying Ju-keng, devoid of national pride, is willing to
become a puppet and revolt against the Central Government
by setting up a false administration under the cloak of
autonomy. Every person with red blood in his veins and an
ounce of national pride should oppose this treacherous
movement. Ying is supported by a number of dissatisfied
politicians who have started agitation at various places
in North China, and there is no doubt that our cultural
centre and ancestral birthplace will be lost to us forever
if the autonomy movement is not stopped. The denunciation
of the leaders of the autonomy movement is necessary if we
are to preserve the existence of our nation, to protect our
culture and to safeguard the lives and property of our
brothers in the North."
pages.zh:
1935年12月。

-3-

大学教授及职员联合会——
谴责华北自治运动。

位于维克多·爱麦虞埃路45号（Victor Emmanuel, 45）的大学教授及职员联合会，通过当地中文报刊发布了一份反对华北自治运动的宣言。该宣言的摘要译文如下：

“自‘九一八’事变以来，中国遭受的外来侵略负担逐年加重，国家现已处于危急存亡之秋。然而，若民众意志坚定、奋发有为，国家繁荣或许能迅速恢复。近期我党与政府领导人的共同努力，清晰地展现了民众救国的精神。如今，殷汝耕（Ying Ju-keng）丧失民族自豪感，甘当傀儡，借自治之名建立伪政权，反抗中央政府。凡有热血、尚存一丝民族自豪感之人，皆应反对这一背叛行径。殷氏得到一批不满政客的support，他们在华北各地煽动闹事。若不制止自治运动，我们的文化中心和祖先发祥地必将永远沦丧。为了保全国家生存、保护我们的文化以及 safeguard 北方同胞的生命财产，必须谴责自治运动的领导人。”

pages.en:
December 6, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

Chen Pao (Shanghai Morning Post, an official organ of
General Chiang Kai Shek) publishes the following editorials-

THE NORTH CHINA QUESTION

The people of China are the best lovers of
peace in the world. The 5th National Conference of the
Kuomintang has clearly announced that the National
Government will not give up striving for peace until it
is hopeless. In consequence of this, whether or not the
peace in the Far East or in the whole world can be
maintained will depend entirely upon our neighbouring
country. Despite the activities of high Chinese officials
presenting suggestions for peace, no approval whatever
has yet been obtained from the other side.
China is a weak, backward and invaded country
and she is eagerly desirous of peace. There is, however,
a certain limit for peace, that is to say, the people of
China have all come to see that the discussion for peace
must be based on the principle that "the integrity of the
national territory must be ensured and China's sovereign
rights must be made complete". On the contrary, if the
negotiations for peace are handled in a manner that will
cause our national territory to be separated or that will
lead to the violation of the national sovereign rights,
then the stage is come when peace is hopeless.
Taking the present chance when there is still
some slight hope for the peace of the Far East, we now
wish to give a frank talk to our friendly neighbouring
country and to the National Government as follows:-
The intelligent people of our friendly neighbouring
country should consider the relations between China and
Japan closely and devise peaceful measures for the mutual
existence of the two nations. Before the Meiji Regime of
Japan, Japan had to recognize that she had a history of
some three thousand years as part of the Chinese race.
Japan received nearly all her civilization from China.
However, after adopting Western civilization, Japan began
to learn, in the ways of the West, how to oppress the weak.
She annexed the Liuchu Islands, obtained Taiwan and took
Korea. The Japanese were still not satisfied with that,
and seized China's Four North-Eastern Provinces during
the September 18 Incident. The Woosung-Shanghai Pact
and the Tengku Agreement were subsequently signed. Japan
has now initiated the so-called "North China Autonomous
Movement" as if China had not yet sustained the gravest
insults. In the opinion of Japan formerly, Japan would
have failed to carry on without Manchuria. Now, Japan
is of the opinion that she cannot ensure the safety of
Manchuria unless she is in control of North China. Will
Japan be satisfied when she has obtained North China?
It is to be feared that in only a few months, Japan will
hold the view that she cannot ensure the safety of North
China without seizing the Yangtze Valley. In this manner,
what will become of China? There is a proverb that "even
a worm will turn". Will not China become a worm or will
she not become a second Abyssinia? It is said that a
Confucius temple has been established in Japan and the
descendants of that Sage were some time ago invited to go
to Japan to participate in the ceremony of the inauguration

1935年12月6日。
下午译件。

《申报》（蒋介石将军的官方机关报）刊登以下社论——

华北问题

中国人民是世界上最爱好和平的人民。国民党第五次全国代表大会已明确宣布，国民政府在和平尚有希望之前，绝不会放弃争取和平的努力。因此，远东乃至全世界的和平能否维持，完全取决于我们的邻国。尽管中国高官积极提出和平建议，但迄今未从对方获得任何认可。

中国是一个弱小、落后且受侵略的国家，迫切渴望和平。然而，和平是有一定限度的，也就是说，中国人民都已认识到，和平谈判必须基于“确保国家领土完整和维护中国主权完整”的原则。相反，如果和平谈判的方式会导致我国领土分裂或导致国家主权受到侵犯，那么和平便已无望。

趁着远东和平尚存一线希望之际，我们愿向友好的邻国及国民政府坦陈如下：

我们友好邻国的明智人士应仔细审视中日关系，并为两国的共存制定和平措施。在日本明治维新之前，日本不得不承认其作为中华民族一部分拥有约三千年的历史。日本的文明几乎全部源自中国。然而，在采纳西方文明后，日本开始效仿西方列强欺压弱者之道。它吞并了琉球群岛，攫取了台湾，并占领了朝鲜。日本人仍不满足，又在“九一八”事变期间夺取了中国的东北四省。随后签订了《淞沪协定》和《塘沽协定》。如今，日本又发起了所谓的“华北自治运动”，仿佛中国尚未遭受最严重的侮辱。日本过去认为，若无满洲则无法生存。现在，日本认为除非控制华北，否则无法确保满洲的安全。日本在获得华北后会满足吗？恐怕不出数月，日本就会认为若不夺取长江流域，便无法确保华北的安全。如此下去，中国将何去何从？俗话说，“逼急了的虫子也会咬人”。中国难道不会变成那只虫子，或者成为第二个阿比西尼亚吗？据说日本建立了一座孔庙，不久前还邀请这位圣人的后裔前往日本参加孔庙的落成典礼

pages.en:
December 6, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

of the temple. The Japanese have also preached the so-called doctrine of justice in the bogus state of Manchukuo. Yet all these actions of the Japanese will mean that at best, Japan will become a conqueror of the world. However, such a conqueror will not last long. It is natural that China will suffer heavily should she fight, but it is not quite sure that Japan will be completely safe. We hope Japanese intelligent people will be broad-minded and so save the present dangerous situation.

The Chinese Government must realize the necessary conditions for peace. It must, first of all, draw up schemes to cope with the national affairs. It should give permission whenever it is possible, but reject any demand which is impossible to accept. It should not hesitate to deal with anything. It must be determined to sacrifice all in order to obtain true peace. At this time when there is still some hope for peace, the Government must select high class diplomatic officials to announce the sincerity of the Government to be friendly with neighbouring countries and to draw the attention of foreign countries to the Sino-Japanese affairs. The people throughout the country must consolidate and be prepared to sacrifice everything for the sake of our race and country when it appears that there is no longer any hope of peace.

Regarding the North China question, the officials engaged in this connection must take particular care in their mission. If we engage Chinese, who are well versed with Japanese affairs, to effect the cancellation of the East Hopei Autonomous Committee inaugurated by Yin Zu Keng, who is illegally communicating with Japan, and form a Committee to be placed ostensibly under the control of the Chinese Government but in reality under the direction of persons behind the stage, it will not be a true peace and will only cause the country to lose more territory.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Peiping telegram):
JAPANESE AEROPLANES HOLD DEMONSTRATIONS
At noon on December 5, five Japanese aeroplanes were seen flying over Peiping. The planes reconnoitered overhead for about an hour.
At 3 p.m. the same day, nine Japanese aeroplanes flew over Peiping as a threat.

(Tientsin telegram):
60 Japanese Aeroplanes Due at Peiping
On the morning of December 5, five Japanese aeroplanes flew to Tientsin and afterwards flew to Peiping. It is said that 60 Japanese aeroplanes will come to Tientsin. There are seven Japanese aeroplanes on the aerodrome at Pah Li Dan, Tientsin.

China Evening News (comment):
On December 3, a Japanese aeroplane, when flying over Tai Tu San from Shanhaikwan, accidentally let a bomb drop. It exploded killing a farmer and wounding a woman.
pages.zh:
1935年12月6日。
下午译件。

仪式。日本人还在伪满洲国宣扬所谓的正义道义。然而，日本的这些举动至多意味着日本将成为世界的征服者。但是，这样的征服者不会长久。诚然，中国若进行抵抗必将遭受重创，但日本是否就能完全安然无恙也未可知。我们希望日本的明智之士能胸怀宽广，从而挽救当前的危险局势。

中国政府必须认清和平的必要条件。首先，必须制定处理国家事务的方案。在可能的情况下应予许可，但对于无法接受的要求则应拒绝。处理任何事务都不应犹豫不决。必须下定决心牺牲一切以换取真正的和平。在和平尚存希望之时，政府必须选派高级外交官员，向外界宣告政府与邻国友好的诚意，并引起各国对中日事务的关注。全国民众必须团结一心，并在和平看似无望时，准备为我们的民族和国家牺牲一切。

关于华北问题，负责此事的官员在执行任务时必须格外谨慎。如果我们任用精通日本事务的中国人，去取消由非法勾结日本的殷汝耕（Yin Zu Keng）所成立的冀东自治委员会，并组建一个名义上受中国政府控制、实则受幕后人员指挥的委员会，那将不是真正的和平，只会导致国家丧失更多领土。

《辛晚报》及其他本地报纸（北平电）：
日本飞机举行示威
12月5日中午，有人看见五架日本飞机飞越北平上空。这些飞机在空中侦察了约一小时。
同日下午3时，九架日本飞机飞越北平上空，以示威胁。

（天津电）：
60架日本飞机即将抵达北平
12月5日上午，五架日本飞机飞抵天津，随后飞往北平。据悉，将有60架日本飞机来到天津。天津八里台机场停有七架日本飞机。

《China Evening News》（评论）：
12月3日，一架日本飞机从山海关飞越太图山（Tai Tu San，音译）上空时，意外投下一枚炸弹。炸弹爆炸，炸死一名农民，炸伤一名妇女。

pages.en:
December 4, 1:35. Afternoon Translation.

The autonomous movement in North China, which has the support of the Japanese, is, according to General Tada, the Commander of the Japanese troops in North China, the first step along the path to Pan-Asiaticism. That, at least, is what one gathers from the pamphlet which General Tada distributed among his officers in September this year. It would perhaps be more correct to say that the autonomy of the northern provinces will facilitate the realization of the Union of Far Eastern nations: China, Japan and Manchukuo, according to the wishes of Tokyo.
In our opinion, the new Pan-Asiatic League at Tientsin appears to be, above all, a Sino-Japanese League which will endeavour to propagate the idea of Sino-Japanese Co-operation in Chinese intellectual and political circles.
Pan-Asiaticism is a far-away dream and will not materialize, but Sino-Japanese-Manchukuoan co-operation, in the sense understood by Tokyo, is an eventuality which should be envisaged seriously for it has been the avowed object of Japanese policy since April 17, 1934.

G. M.

Journal de Shanghai :

INTERVIEW WITH PRESIDENT OF "AUTONOMOUS COUNCIL OF EAST HOPEI".

Yin Jou Keng, Inspector of the Demilitarized Area in Hopei Province, proclaimed the autonomy of Luntung on November 24 and has since become the President of the "Autonomy Council of East Hopei."
The following interview took place between Yin Jou Keng and Mr. Alphonse Monastier, editor of the French newspaper "Politique de Pekin" :-
Q: We have heard of the formation of the new Council of which you are the President. We have come to seek information from you at first hand.
A: I shall explain to you my object. I am fighting not the country but the Kuomintang for the Kuomintang has been ruining the country during the past 25 years. I would like to see China return to the same state that she was in in the year 1911. I have seen service with the Kuomintang in the hope of ameliorating somewhat the consequences of its acts but without success. Recently I sent to Nanking an appeal that the period of political tutelage be terminated for it is only another form of dictatorship, and to establish a Constitutional Government. The Fifth National Congress was still in session then. Generals Sung Cheh Yuan and Han Fu Chu also sent similar telegrams. To my disappointment, Nanking ignored our advice. Instead, Nanking decreed the nationalization of silver. Thereafter, I hesitated no longer and launched the present autonomous movement. This movement is principally directed against the Kuomintang. If the Kuomintang can be driven away from the whole country it will bring much happiness to the people.
pages.zh:
12月4日，1:35。下午译件。

据驻华北日军司令多田将军（General Tada）称，得到日本支持的华北自治运动，是走向泛亚洲主义道路的第一步。至少，这是人们从今年9月多田将军向其军官分发的小册子中得出的印象。也许更准确的说法是，北方各省的自治将有助于按照东京的愿望，实现中国、日本和满洲国这三个远东国家的联合。

在我们看来，天津的新泛亚联盟首先是一个中日联盟，它将致力于在中国知识界和政治界宣传中日合作的理念。

泛亚洲主义是一个遥远的梦想，不会实现；但按照东京所理解的中日满合作，则是应当认真预见的一种可能性，因为自1934年4月17日以来，这一直是日本政策的公开目标。

G. M.

《上海日报》（Journal de Shanghai）：

采访“冀东自治委员会”主席。

河北省非武装区督察殷汝耕（Yin Jou Keng）于11月24日宣布滦州（Luntung）自治，此后成为“冀东自治委员会”主席。
以下是殷汝耕与法文报纸《北京政治》（Politique de Pekin）编辑阿尔方斯·莫纳斯蒂埃（Alphonse Monastier）先生之间的访谈：

问：我们听说成立了由您担任主席的新委员会。我们前来向您直接了解情况。
答：我将向您解释我的目标。我斗争的对象不是国家，而是国民党，因为国民党在过去25年里一直在毁掉这个国家。我希望中国恢复到1911年的状态。我曾为国民党效力，希望能稍微改善其行动带来的后果，但未获成功。最近，我向南京发出呼吁，要求结束政治训政时期，因为这只是独裁的另一种形式，并建立宪政政府。当时第五次全国代表大会仍在开会。宋哲元（Sung Cheh Yuan）将军和韩复榘（Han Fu Chu）将军也发出了类似的电报。令我失望的是，南京无视我们的建议。相反，南京颁布了白银国有化法令。此后，我不再犹豫，发起了目前的自治运动。这场运动主要针对国民党。如果能把国民党赶出全国，将会给人民带来许多幸福。

pages.en:
December 4, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Q: What steps have you taken since the day of the proclamation?
A: After my telegram of protest to Nanking, I sent a telegram of explanation to the people and to Generals Sung Cheh Yuan, Chang Sheng, Han Fu Chu and Tsino Chen Yin and another telegram informing the Legations of the various powers in China.
Q: The foreign powers may not have much to say for the time being, but don't you think that Japan will be alarmed for the movement involves the demilitarized area and jeopardizes the Tangku Armistice?
A: Japan understands the meaning of the movement; it depends upon the people. She is following the movement with sympathetic attention.
Q: Are you not afraid of a reaction at Nanking? Is it not being said that Nanking is concentrating troops in Honan?
A: I am ready for fighting. The Government should think twice before attempting to suppress the movement. Besides, it would have already taken action had it been really disposed to do so.
Q: Perhaps it is waiting for a more favourable movement. You know that Nanking is ready to reach an understanding with Tokyo to bring about a settlement of the Sino-Japanese question. The Chinese Charge d'Affaires at Tokyo has informed Mr. Shigemitsu, the Japanese Vice Minister for Foreign Affairs, that his Government is ready to open negotiations with Tokyo and that it had designated General Chiang Tso Ping to undertake the negotiations.
A: Whatever Nanking may do and supposing even that an arrangement is come to between Nanking and Tokyo, I, for my part, will continue to maintain the autonomous government.
Q: Are you certain that you have sufficient supporters around you?
A: I have the best grounds for believing that I shall find all the help I shall need from the authorities of the five northern provinces.
Q: Did you see General Sung Cheh Yuan yesterday when he passed here?
A: No. Yesterday I received a visit from General Sui, Chief of the 9th Brigade of the 29th Army who congratulated me and, on the orders of General Sung Cheh Yuan, placed his troops at my disposal.
Q: What was the cause of the first failure of the movement?
A: There was no failure, the movement had only been retarded because of certain circumstances.
Q: What do you think of the movement in Tientsin?
A: It is a spontaneous movement of the people in sympathy with ours.
Q: Do you think there will be a similar movement in Peiping?
A: If the authorities are slow to move, it is possible a people's demonstration may occur.
Q: General Dohara returned to Peiping yesterday. Do you know the reason for his return?
A: He has come to take stock of the present situation. I have not seen him but I have met him before at Peiping and Tientsin.
pages.zh:
1935年12月4日。下午译件。

问：自宣言发布之日起，你采取了哪些步骤？
答：在向南京发出抗议电报后，我向民众以及宋哲元将军、张声（音译）、韩复榘将军和秦德纯将军发送了解释性电报，并另发一电通报驻华各国公使馆。
问：列强目前或许无多话可说，但你难道不认为日本会对这一运动感到警觉吗？因为这涉及非军事区，并危及《塘沽停战协定》？
答：日本理解该运动的含义；这取决于民众。日本正以同情的关注注视着这一运动。
问：你不怕南京方面的反应吗？不是说南京正在河南集结部队吗？
答：我已准备好作战。政府在试图镇压该运动之前应三思。此外，如果政府真的有意这样做，它早就采取行动了。
问：也许它在等待更有利的时机。你知道南京准备与东京达成谅解，以解决中日问题。中国驻东京代办已告知日本外务次官重光葵，其政府准备与东京开启谈判，并已指定蒋作宾将军负责谈判。
答：无论南京做什么，即使假设南京与东京之间达成了协议，就我而言，我将继续维持自治政府。
问：你确定身边有足够的支持者吗？
答：我有最充分的理由相信，我将得到北方五省当局所需的一切帮助。
问：宋哲元将军昨天路过这里时，你见到他了吗？
答：没有。昨天我接待了第二十九军第九旅旅长隋将军的来访，他向我表示祝贺，并根据宋哲元将军的命令，将其部队交由我调遣。
问：该运动第一次失败的原因是什么？
答：并没有失败，该运动只是因某些情况而受阻。
问：你如何看待天津的运动？
答：这是民众自发举行的、同情我们运动的行动。
问：你认为北平会出现类似的运动吗？
答：如果当局行动迟缓，民众示威是有可能发生的。
问：土肥原贤二将军昨天返回北平。你知道他返回的原因吗？
答：他是来评估当前局势的。我虽未见他，但我以前在北平和天津见过他。

pages.en:
December 4, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

Q: Supposing, however, that the movement is
confined to the area which is under your jurisdiction
and that, for some reason or other, the authorities of
the other northern provinces do not fall in line with you,
would you proceed with the organization of the political
statute of East Hopei?
A: All the districts are united under my
presidency. We shall continue as before without reference
to Nanking. In short, the following are my aims:-
1) I am seceding from the Kuomintang but not from China.
2) I shall accept full responsibility for civil, political
and diplomatic affairs throughout the whole area of
East Hopei.
3) I shall respect the International treaties.
4) I shall give an undertaking to protect the lives and
property of foreigners.
5) I shall endeavour to rally around me the authorities
of the other provinces so that the whole country may
enjoy peace.
Q: Do you propose to take special measures against
the Communists and will you work in co-operation with Japan
and Manchukuo in this respect?
A: The Communist danger is not imminent. For the
present, we know how to deal with it with our own efforts.
Later, we shall see.
Q: I have seen your manifesto. Supposing that
Nanking takes action against you because of this manifesto?
A: I repeat: I am not afraid to fight. I have
been undertaking this revolutionary work for ten years and
it has now been crowned with success. I was by the side
of General Koo Tsong Lin on November 24, 1925, when he
rebelled against Marshal Chang Tso Lin. It is to mark
the continuity of my work that I selected the date of
November 24 to issue my manifesto.
pages.zh:
1935年12月4日。
下午译件。

问：然而，假设该运动仅限于你管辖的区域，且由于某种原因，其他北方省份的当局不与你们保持一致，你还会继续组织冀东的政治体制吗？
答：所有地区都在我的领导下团结在一起。我们将不顾南京方面，一如既往地进行下去。简而言之，我的目标如下：
1) 我脱离国民党，但不脱离中国。
2) 我将对冀东全境的民政、政治和外交事务承担全部责任。
3) 我将尊重国际条约。
4) 我将承诺保护外国人的生命和财产。
5) 我将努力团结其他省份的当局，使全国享有和平。
问：你打算对共产党采取特别措施吗？在此方面你会与日本和满洲国合作吗？
答：共产主义危险并不紧迫。目前，我们知道如何靠自己的力量应对此事。以后再看。
问：我看过你的宣言。假设南京因这份宣言对你采取行动怎么办？
答：我重申：我不怕打仗。我从事这项革命工作已有十年，如今已取得成功。1925年11月24日，郭宗林将军反抗张作霖元帅时，我就在他身边。为了标志我工作的连续性，我选择了11月24日这一天发布我的宣言。

pages.en:
December 4, 1935.
Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Swatow telegram):
TRAITOROUS ORGANIZATION APPEARS IN SWATOW

People of a certain country have established
a Life Insurance Society at Swatow with the intention of
insuring Chinese traitors. As the situation in North China
has become tense, this Society is doing its best to get
the district undesirables to join, to conduct traitorous
activities. Furthermore, the Society has sent rowdies
of a certain country and undesirables, who have lost their
Chinese nationality, to the Interior, to solicit for members
by promising certain benefits. Persons who join the
Society are each given an insurance certificate and a badge.
More than 200 traitors have joined the Society
which has received a sum of about $300,000 in insurance
fees. During ordinary times, these traitors have connections
with loafers.
The authorities are paying close attention to
the matter.

(Nanking telegram):
Soldiers of a Certain Country Open Fire

Of late, a large batch of soldiers of a certain
country arrived at Deh Zung Hsien (大城县) in the south-
west of Tientsin. They compelled the farmers to declare
self-government and asked them to sign on a document.
Upon the farmers flatly refusing the demand, the soldiers
of a certain country became dissatisfied and opened fire
at the farmers. Two farmers were seriously wounded and
many received slight injuries.
Last week a number of Koreans arrived at Dah
Zung Hsien in Hopei for the purpose of creating a self-
governing movement. A clash took place as the people
opposed the movement. The Hopei Provincial Government
sent a deputy to make investigations and 16 injured
Koreans were handed over to the Japanese Authorities.

(Hsuchow telegram):
Aeroplanes of a Certain Country Fly Over Haichow

Aeroplanes of a certain country have, for the
past days, appeared at Haichow frequently for reconnoitering
purposes. They came from the North-east.
People of a certain country also came to Haichow
where they inspected the Lien Yuin Harbour (连云港) and
many other places.

China Evening News (Editorial):
The Situation in North China

It is a fact that the situation in North China
is very tense. Yin Zu Keng and other traitors have
created disturbances. Japanese militarists are the
authors of the rebellion behind the stage, but maintain
that their action is an answer to the demand of the Chinese
pages.zh:
1935年12月4日。
下午译件。

《星晚报》及其他本地报纸（汕头电）：
叛国组织现身汕头

某国人士在汕头设立了一家人寿保险公司，意图为中国汉奸提供保险。随着华北局势紧张，该社正极力招揽当地不良分子加入，进行叛国活动。此外，该社还派遣某国的流氓以及丧失中国国籍的不良分子进入内地，通过许诺某些利益来招募成员。加入该社的人每人都会获得一张保险证书和一枚徽章。
已有200多名汉奸加入该社，该社已收取约30万美元的保险费。平时，这些汉奸与游手好闲之徒有联系。
当局正密切关注此事。

（南京电）：
某国士兵开火

近日，大批某国士兵抵达天津西南的大城县。他们强迫农民宣布自治，并要求他们在一份文件上签字。由于农民断然拒绝这一要求，某国士兵感到不满，并向农民开火。两名农民受重伤，多人受轻伤。
上周，数名朝鲜人抵达河北大城县，旨在制造自治运动。由于民众反对该运动，发生了冲突。河北省政府派出一名副手进行调查，16名受伤的朝鲜人被移交给日本当局。

（徐州电）：
某国飞机飞越海州

过去几天，某国飞机频繁出现在海州上空，进行侦察。它们来自东北方向。
某国人士也来到海州，视察了连云港及许多其他地方。

《China Evening News》（社论）：
华北局势

华北局势非常紧张，这是一个事实。殷汝耕等汉奸制造了骚乱。日本军国主义者是幕后叛乱的始作俑者，但声称他们的行动是对中国人民自治要求的回应。

December 4, 1935.    2    Afternoon Translation.

people for self-government. In reality, Japanese militarists
are instigating the undesirables of the Chinese people
to set up riots in China.
Japanese ambitious militarists in North China,
however, are still not satisfied. They have recently
concentrated strong forces in the vicinity of Peiping
and Tientsin, occupied the Chinese railway station at
Foong Tan and sent their armies inside Shanhaikwan under
the plea of holding sham fights.
The situation in North China is not entirely
hopeless. The Japanese want a victory without a fight
and therefore they are coercing China on the one hand
through military movements, while on the other they conduct
negotiations for peace by means of diplomatic procedure.
The Chinese Government will not give up its
efforts for peace if there is still a chance, but it will
fight whatever the result, when it is compelled to do so.
We hope the North China Authorities will, under
the leadership of General Ho Yin Chin, endeavour to overcome
the dangerous situation. They should not withdraw owing
to coercion, nor should they weaken on any account.

China Students' Weekly (中國學生) (Comment):

THE NORTH CHINA UNREST.

China at present needs unification. The
unanimous hope of the Chinese people is also one for
unification. It is the supreme political thought of
the revolutionary Chinese people that the unification of
China should be accomplished. However, those who are
interested in the partition of China will think of every
possible method to interrupt the unification and handicap
anything that tends to create a situation which is dis-
advantageous to them.
Following the congregation in Nanking of various
Chinese leaders who have never met one another before,
North China became troubled. According to historical
facts, this is nothing exceptional; all changes in history
have had their own preludes; so with the present North
China situation.
Our country is now slipping towards her
destiny; we have no fear of the appearance of traitors,
but that we have no upright men to annihilate these evil-
doers. We do not fear the oppression of our enemy, but
we actually fear that no real union will ever be achieved
by us.
If we are really unified, the recent
disturbance in the North will merely show the weakness
of our enemy who are making the final struggle to impair
our unity.
pages.zh:
1935年12月4日。    2    下午译件。

实际上，日本军国主义者正在煽动中国人民中的不良分子在中国制造暴乱。
然而，华北野心勃勃的日本军国主义者仍不满足。他们最近在北平和天津附近集结重兵，以举行假演习为借口，占领了丰台的中国火车站，并将军队派入山海关内。
华北局势并非完全无望。日本人不战而胜，因此他们一方面通过军事行动胁迫中国，另一方面通过外交手段进行和平谈判。
如果仍有和平机会，中国政府不会放弃和平努力，但在被迫之时，无论结果如何，它都将战斗。
我们希望华北当局在何应钦将军的领导下，努力克服危险局势。他们不应因胁迫而撤退，也不应在任何情况下示弱。

《中国学生周刊》（评论）：

华北动荡。

中国目前需要统一。中国人民的一致愿望也是统一。实现中国统一是革命中国人民的最高政治思想。然而，那些热衷于分裂中国的人会想尽一切办法打断统一进程，并阻碍任何造成对他们不利局势的事物。
随着此前从未谋面的各位中国领导人在南京聚集，华北变得动荡不安。根据历史事实，这并不例外；历史上的所有变革都有其前奏；目前的华北局势也是如此。
我们的国家正滑向她的命运；我们不害怕汉奸的出现，而是害怕没有正直之人来消灭这些恶棍。我们不害怕敌人的压迫，而是真正害怕我们无法实现真正的团结。
如果我们真正团结起来，最近的北方动荡仅仅显示出敌人削弱我们统一的最后挣扎的虚弱。

Afternoon Translation.

There will be in the near future three
Divisions coming by the Shanhaikwan Pass, according to

It is understood that there is a certain motive

Sin Wen Pao (Tientsin telegram):

On November 1 five locomotives of the Peiping-
Liaoning Railway, fully loaded with fuel, were driven
to the Shanhaikwan Pass to meet the needs of the Japanese
troops.
The newly arrived Brigade Commander's
Headquarters, owing to lack of suitable premises locally,
were set up in the train carriages, the troops also
taking up their abode in the coaches.
The locomotives are standing by and are
expected to depart soon for the west.

Eastern Times (telegram from Hsuchow):

Large Number of Japanese Arrive at Hsuchow.

Recently, a large number of Japanese, accompanied
by Koreans, arrived at Hsuchow. After getting down
from the train, they stoutly refused to allow the inspection
by railway policemen of their luggage, and requested to
be permitted to take photographs when they were making
an observation tour on the outskirts of the city.
They will either depart for Bei Liang (汴梁),
Zungchow (郑州), Tsinan, or Tientsin after a stay of
one or two days at Hsuchow.
Other information secured from Haichow (海州)
shows that Japanese are seen continuously along Li Yuan
Kong under the name of making a tour.

People's Livelihood (大众生活), a weekly periodical,
published the following comment on November 30:-

The Question of North China

The so-called autonomous movement in North China
and the puppet show performed by Yin Zu Keng have drawn
close attention of the people throughout the country.
Who are the directors behind the stage is a matter of
open secret and is known by everybody.
According to information, it seems that the
so-called autonomous movement in North China is a question
that affects the North only and that China will not
encounter any difficult problem when the North China
question has been solved. It is a serious mistake.
The people throughout the country must be reminded that
the present critical situation in the North is a question
that is closely connected with the existence of the whole
Chinese people; it is not a matter concerning a part of
the country only. Speaking strictly, it is not the North
China question but it is a question that has close
connection with the fate of China.
Formerly the North-Eastern problem was much
talked about. It was then thought that it was a problem
affecting the North-East and that it had no connection
whatever with the whole situation in China. After the
North-East had been given away gratis, not many Chinese

11月1日，北宁铁路的五辆机车满载燃料，被驱往山海关，以满足日军的需求。
新到的旅部司令部因当地缺乏合适的房舍，设在火车车厢内，士兵们也住在车厢里。
机车处于待命状态，预计不久将向西出发。

《东方时报》（徐州电）：

大量日本人抵达徐州。

近日，大量日本人伴随朝鲜人抵达徐州。下车后，他们坚决拒绝铁路警察检查其行李，并在市郊参观时要求允许拍照。
在徐州停留一两天后，他们将前往汴梁、郑州、济南或天津。
从海州获得的其他信息显示，日本人以游览为名，持续出现在梨园孔（音译）沿线。

周刊《大众生活》于11月30日发表了以下评论：

华北问题

所谓的华北自治运动以及殷汝耕表演的傀儡戏，引起了全国人民的密切关注。幕后的导演是谁，这是一个公开的秘密，众所周知。
据信，所谓的华北自治运动似乎只是一个影响北方的问题，一旦华北问题得到解决，中国就不会遇到任何难题。这是一个严重的错误。必须提醒全国人民，目前北方的危急局势是一个与全体中国人民生存息息相关的问题；这不仅仅是关乎国家一部分的事情。严格来说，这不是华北问题，而是一个与中国命运密切相关的问题。
以前人们经常谈论东北问题。当时认为那是一个影响东北的问题，与中国整体局势毫无关联。在东北被无偿奉送之后，没有多少中国人

pages.en:
December 2, 1935. Afternoon translation.

people came to the understanding at that time that the
ruin of the North-East was the beginning of the ruin of
whole China. They were of the opinion that the North-
East had been given away and that the other part of China
could be safe for the time being. It has now been
vertified that this opinion was erroneous and now the
North China question has broken out. Unless we consider
this question as one that is closely connected withthe
fate of China, North China will become a second North-East
and the whole of China will become a second North China.
The so-called autonomous movement, the author
of which is our enemy, is absolutely intolerable. Chinese
armies cannot move freely within the territory of China
and Chinese officials and civilians are liable to be
arrested. Under such circumstances, can it be assured
that China's territory will remain complete?
Invasion can be disguised in many different
forms. It can be made by means of the nice methods such
as economic rapprochement, and civilized co-operation.
Close attention must be paid to this measures.
pages.zh:
1935年12月2日。下午译件。

当时人们认识到，东北的沦亡是整个中国沦亡的开始。他们认为东北已被拱手相让，而中国其他地区暂时可以安然无恙。现已证实这种观点是错误的，如今华北问题已经爆发。除非我们将此问题视为与中国命运紧密相连的问题，否则华北将成为第二个东北，而整个中国将成为第二个华北。所谓“自治运动”，其幕后主使乃我方之敌，实为绝对不可容忍。中国军队在中国领土内无法自由调动，中国官员和平民随时可能被捕。在此情况下，能否保证中国领土完整？

侵略可以伪装成许多不同的形式。它可以通过诸如经济亲善和文明合作等看似美好的手段进行。必须对这些措施予以密切关注。

November 30, 1935. Morning translation.

PUBLIC AGITATION AGAINST TRAITOR YIN ZU KENG

Since the traitor Yin Zu Keng formed the so-called Anti-Communist Federation at Tungchow, various public bodies in this locality have sent telegrams to the National Government requesting them to suppress the rebels.

The Shanghai Municipality Educational Association (上海市教育会), the Various College Professors' Union (中学校教职员联合会), and the Shanghai Agricultural Association (上海市农会) have also sent telegrams to the National Government requesting them to adopt strict measures to cope with the situation in North China, in order to preserve the integrity of China's territory.

1935年11月30日。上午译件。

公众反对汉奸殷汝耕

自从汉奸殷汝耕在通州成立所谓“防共联盟”以来，本地各公共团体纷纷致电国民政府，请求镇压叛乱分子。

November 29, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

NEW WEIGHTS AND MEASURES REGULATIONS FOR INTERNATIONAL
SETTLEMENT.

In 1930, the Ministry of Industry instructed
the various provinces and municipalities to adopt new
weights and measures. The Shanghai City Government
has established an Inspection Office to undertake the
work. By now the use of privately manufactured weights
and measures in the Chinese Controlled Territory and the
French Concession has totally disappeared.
However, no satisfactory result has been
obtained regarding the inspection of new weights and
measures in the International Settlement, notwithstanding
repeated negotiations opened by the Shanghai City Government
with the S.M.C.
It is now learned that the S.M.C., after
further discussions, consider that the co-operation
with the Chinese Authorities for the adoption of new
weights and measures in the Settlement is possible, and
commencing from January 1, 1936, it will give instructions
for the adoption of new weights and measures in the
Settlement. A notice to this effect will also be
published.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA.

In reply to its telegram asking for the
suppression of the autonomous movement in the North,
the Shanghai Chamber of Commerce yesterday received a
telegram from the National Government stating that an
order for the arrest and punishment of rebel Yin Zu Keng
has been issued and that the Hopei Provincial Government
has been instructed to take any action necessary to deal
with the situation.

The Shanghai District Association has
received the following telegram from General Saung Chen,
Chairman of the Hopei Provincial Government :-
"I have dismissed rebel Yin Zu Keng from
his office and have ordered his arrest because of his
rebellious move. It is my duty to protect our territory.
I shall not shrink from my duty of obeying instructions
from the Government."

Yesterday the Workers' Union of the Nanking-
Shanghai and Shanghai-Hangchow-Ningpo Railways sent a
circular telegram to the National Government, General
Chiang Kai Shek, Chairman of the Military Commission,
Dr. H.H. Kung, Acting President of the Executive Yuan,
and military leaders in North China, appealing to them
to suppress the autonomous movement in Hopei.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

国际租界实施新度量衡条例。

1930年，实业部指令各省各市采用新度量衡。上海市政府已设立检查所负责此项工作。截至目前，在华界和法租界，私制度量衡的使用已完全绝迹。
然而，尽管上海市政府与工部局进行了多次谈判，但在国际租界检查新度量衡方面仍未取得满意结果。
现获悉，工部局经进一步讨论后，认为在租界内配合中国当局采用新度量衡是可行的，并将从1936年1月1日起，发布在租界内采用新度量衡的指令。届时还将发布相关通告。

《申报》及其他本地报纸：

华北自治运动。

上海总商会昨日就其要求镇压华北自治运动的电报收到国民政府复电，称已发布逮捕并惩办叛徒殷汝耕的命令，并指示河北省政府采取任何必要行动以处理此事。

上海区公所收到河北省政府主席宋哲元将军发来的如下电报：
“因叛徒殷汝耕发动叛乱，我已将其免职并下令逮捕。保卫我国土是我的职责。我将恪尽职守，服从政府命令。”

昨日，京沪铁路和沪杭甬铁路工会向国民政府、军事委员会委员长蒋介石、行政院代院长孔祥熙博士以及华北军事领导人发出通电商，呼吁他们镇压河北的自治运动。

November 26, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

NIPPO(27-II-35)

THE FIRST THREE STEPS OF THE AUTONOMY MOVEMENT IN
THE NORTH

A Dentsu telegram from Tientsin
dated November 26 states that following the declaration
of an independence of the demilitarized zone in the North,
autonomy activities are spreading in the Eastern part of
Charhar province. The people in the North have been
greatly moved by the autonomy spirit. General Sung
Cheh Yuan is well aware of the present situation there.
For this reason, the General is now studying the plans
of the officials of the 29th Army for dealing with the
situation.

As a first step an autonomy
administration will be introduced in Charhar and in
Peiping and Tientsin. As a second step the autonomy
administration will be extended to Hopei province and
finally it will include Shantung, Shansi and Suiyuan
as well as Tsingtao.

COMMENT ON THE GROWING OF JAPAN

According to the recent census
the whole population of Japanese Empire has reached
99,450,000 showing a yearly increase of one million.
Such a huge population is crowded into a limited area
like Japan. For this reason Japan is obliged to find
room for her ever increasing subjects outside Japan.
America and other countries shut their doors against
Japanese, so the Japanese people have to make every possible
effort to find out lots in any directions. The
industrial activities and the progress of Japan may become
a threat to the world.

NIPPO

CHOP LEITH-ROSS UP

The Shanghai Nippo publishes
the following comment under the above headline.

Sir F. Leith-Ross, economic
advisor to the British Government, who appears to have
played an important role in the Chinese currency reform,
has proceeded to the North to investigate the autonomy
movement there. He is now active in Peiping. He has
stated to Chinese and foreign newspaper reporters as
follows:- "The introduction of the currency reform is a
proper measure for the Nanking Government to undertake.
The North is attempting to separate from the Central
Government, but it is certain that such a movement cannot
be successful. Although an autonomy regime may be
created at any time, no European country nor America,
especially Great Britain, will give any assistance."

1935年11月26日。下午译件。

日本同盟通讯社（1935年11月27日）

华北自治运动的前三步

天津11月26日电讯社电称，继宣布北方非武装区独立后，自治活动正在察哈尔省东部蔓延。北方民众深受自治精神感召。宋哲元将军充分意识到那里的当前局势。因此，宋将军目前正在研究第29军军官应对该局势的计划。

第一步将在察哈尔以及北平和天津实行自治行政。第二步将把自治行政扩展到河北省，最后还将包括山东、山西、绥远以及青岛。

关于日本增长的评论

根据最近的人口普查，日本帝国总人口已达99,450,000人，显示每年增加一百万。如此庞大的人口拥挤在日本这样有限的区域内。因此，日本不得不为其不断增长的臣民在海外寻找空间。美国和其他国家对日本人关闭大门，因此日本人民不得不尽一切努力在任何方向上寻找出路。日本的工业活动和进步可能会成为世界的威胁。

日本同盟通讯社

分割李滋-罗斯

《上海日本日报》在上述标题下发表评论如下。

英国政府经济顾问李滋-罗斯爵士（Sir F. Leith-Ross）似乎在中国货币改革中发挥了重要作用，他已前往北方调查那里的自治运动。他目前活跃于北平。他对中外报记者表示如下：“实施货币改革是南京政府应采取的适当措施。北方正试图脱离中央政府，但可以肯定的是，此类运动不可能成功。虽然随时可能建立自治政权，但没有任何欧洲国家或美国，尤其是英国，会提供任何援助。”

November 23, 1935. Afternoon Translation.
Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers (Tientsin telegram):
JAPANESE SOLDIERS DETAIN TRAINS OF THE TIENTSIN-PUKOW RAILWAY
At 10 a.m. November 27, some 40 Japanese soldiers led by their officers arrived at the Tientsin-Pukow Railway Station in an armoured car and three freight wagons. They entered the Station Master's room and requested the Master to refrain from issuing the "all clear batons" to the trains coming to the south. Japanese soldiers were sent to watch the starting of the 75th train to Tsinan. Other Japanese soldiers proceeded to the Western Station of the Tientsin-Pukow Railway by motor cars and prevented the 21st passenger train from proceeding further. At the same time, the Peiping-Liaoning Railway Administration also received a telephonic report from Foong Tan stating that some 60 Japanese soldiers arrived at 5.50 a.m, bringing a field gun with them and had mounted guard of the station, watched the Station Master and prevented the freight train from proceeding south.
Loh Meng Hsiung (罗孟雄), Assistant Manager of the Peiping-Liaoning Railway Administration, called on Tada, Commander of the Japanese Military Headquarters at Tientsin and opened negotiations over the matter. At 12.15 p.m. November 27, the Japanese soldiers began to withdraw from the Chief Station and the Western Station of the Tientsin-Pukow Railway and drove away all the trains in the station.
At 10 a.m. November 27, the officers of the Tientsin-Pukow Railway called on Tada, Japanese Military Commander in Tientsin, in connection with the detention of trains by the Japanese soldiers. The two parties verbally agreed to the following conditions:-
1) No empty trains should be sent to the south.
2) Troops should not be transported by trains.
3) When a train proceeds to the south, a train should go to the north at the same time.
On November 26, a party of Japanese soldiers and of Peace Preservation Corps under the command of Chang Ching Yue entered Ning Ho (宁河) and took over the control of the Hsien Government by force. The Magistrate was driven away. The Hsien district is now included in the bogus organization.
China Evening News (comment):
Yin Zu Keng who is willing to be a puppet, has made an attempt to start a rebellion. The National Government has issued a mandate for the arrest of Yin.
The feelings of the community have been roused by the mandate of the Government and the Chamber of Commerce and other public bodies have requested it to suppress the rebel.
We are sure that for the sake of preserving the integrity of China's territory, the independence of sovereign rights of China and the existence of our race, the feelings of the people which been put down for the time being must burst forth to launch a determined struggle with the enemy.

1935年11月23日。下午译件。
《新闻报》及其他本地报纸（天津电）：
日军扣留津浦铁路列车

11月27日上午10时，约40名日军在军官率领下，乘坐一辆装甲车和三节货运车厢抵达津浦铁路车站。他们进入站长室，要求站长不要向开往南方的列车发放“放行棒”。日军被派去监视开往济南的第75次列车的发车。其他日军乘汽车前往津浦铁路西站，阻止第21次客运列车继续前行。与此同时，平宁铁路管理局也收到丰台的电话报告，称约60名日军于上午5时50分抵达，带有一门野战炮，并对车站实行警戒，监视站长，阻止货运列车向南行驶。

平宁铁路管理局副局长罗孟雄拜访了驻天津日军司令部指挥官多田，就此事项展开谈判。11月27日下午12时15分，日军开始从津浦铁路总站和西站撤离，并驱走了车站内的所有列车。

11月27日上午10时，津浦铁路官员就日军扣留列车一事拜访了驻天津日军指挥官多田。双方口头达成以下条件：
1) 不得向南发送空车。
2) 不得通过铁路运输部队。
3) 当列车向南行驶时，应同时有一列列车向北行驶。

11月26日，一队日军和张庆余指挥的保安队进入宁河，强行接管县政府。县长被赶走。该县辖区现已被纳入伪组织。

《China Evening News》（评论）：
甘愿充当傀儡的殷汝耕企图发动叛乱。国民政府已发布逮捕殷汝耕的命令。
政府的命令激起了社会情绪，总商会及其他公共团体请求政府镇压叛乱分子。
我们相信，为了维护中国领土完整、中国主权独立以及我们民族的生存，暂时被压抑的民众情绪必将爆发，与敌人展开坚决斗争。

November 28, 1:35.                                  Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE AUTONOMY MOVEMENT IN THE NORTH.

At 3 p.m. November 27 the Various Universities'
Federation held a meeting in the premises of the Chinese
Y.M.C.A., Boulevard de l'ontigny, French Concession. There
were present Dr. H.C.E. Liu(劉湛恩), Principal of the
University of Shanghai, Dr. T.H. Lee(李登輝), Principal
of the Futan University, Dr. Oong Tse Loong(翁之龍),
Principal of the Tungchi University, etc.
The meeting resolved that the Federation
should send a circular telegram to Great Britain, America,
France, Japan, Germany, etc., announcing that the citizens
of China protest unanimously against the so-called
autonomous movement in North China.
The Federation also sent the following telegram
to the National Government, General Chiang Kai Shek, Dr.H.H.
Kung, Acting President of the Executive Yuan, as well as
the Chairmen of the Hopei, Shantung and Charhar Provincial
Governments and the Mayors of Peiping and Tientsin :-
"Under the pretext of autonomy, rebel Yin Zu
Keng is occupying East Hopei and has issued a declaration
of secession from the Central Government.      All the
citizens are indignant at his mad move which is intolerable.
Being responsible for the maintenance of territorial and
administrative integrity, our Central Government should
immediately suppress such rebellion in order to uphold the
law.    Our government should not hesitate to take
action so as to prevent the move from spreading.      All
senior military and civic officers of various provinces,
whose duty is to protect the nation, should abide strictly
by the orders of the Central Government and should unite
together at the present national crisis.    Any attempts
or intrigues to secede from the Central Government will
be disapproved of by the citizens.    Our friendly nations
should understand that China is an independent country
and that dismemberment of her territory will not be
tolerated at any rate.    Our Government has the authority
to punish any person who attempts to secede from the
government because such authority constitutes one of her
internal administrative rights.    Any party who attempts
to interfere will be the aggressor and will be strongly
opposed by the whole nation."

Yesterday the Shanghai First Special District
Citizens Federation and the General Federation of Chinese
Industrialists sent telegrams to the National Government,
the Executive Yuan and the Military Commission appealing
them to suppress the autonomous movement declared by rebel
Yin Zu Keng in East Hopei and to instruct General Ho Ying
Ching to proceed to the North immediately to assume his
office as the Superior Officer of the Executive Yuan
residing in Peiping.
The two public bodies also sent telegrams
to General Sung Cheh Yuan, General Saung Chen and General
Han Fu Chu asking them to send troops to suppress the
autonomous movement in order to protect China's territorial
integrity.

11月28日，下午1时35分。                                  下午译件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

华北自治运动。

11月27日下午3时，各大学联合会在法租界霞飞路（Boulevard de l'ontigny）基督教青年会会所举行会议。出席者有沪江大学校长刘湛恩博士、复旦大学校长李登辉博士、同济大学校长翁之龙博士等。
会议决议，由该联合会向英国、美国、法国、日本、德国等国发出通电路电，宣布中国公民一致抗议所谓华北自治运动。
该联合会还向国民政府、蒋介石将军、行政院代院长孔祥熙博士，以及河北、山东和察哈尔省政府主席和北平、天津市长发出如下电报：-
“叛徒殷汝耕借自治之名，占据冀东，并发表脱离中央政府的宣言。全体公民对其疯狂举动感到愤慨，此乃不可容忍之事。中央政府负有维护领土和行政完整之责，应立即镇压此类叛乱，以维护法律。我国政府不应犹豫，应采取行动，以防事态蔓延。各省高级军政官员，其职责在于保卫国家，应严格遵守中央政府命令，并在当前国家危机时刻团结一致。任何企图或阴谋脱离中央政府的行为，都将遭到公民的反对。友好各国应理解，中国是一个独立国家，其领土分裂无论如何都不会被容忍。我国政府有权惩罚任何企图脱离政府的人，因为这种权力构成其内部行政权利之一。任何企图干涉的一方都将是侵略者，并将遭到全国人民的强烈反对。”

昨日，上海第一特区市民联合会和中国工业家总联合会向国民政府、行政院和军事委员会发出电报，呼吁他们镇压叛徒殷汝耕在冀东宣布的自治运动，并指示何应钦将军立即北上，就任驻北平的行政院高级官员职务。
这两个公共团体还向宋哲元将军、商震将军和韩复榘将军发出电报，要求他们派兵镇压自治运动，以保护中国的领土完整。

November 27, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

THE NATIONAL GOVERNMENT AND THE SITUATION IN THE NORTH.

On November 26, the National Government issued a mandate dismissing Yin Zu Keng, Special Deputy for the Luanchow-Shanhaikwan Areas, for having formed the so-called Anti-Communism Federation at Tungchow and stating that the Hopei Provincial Government is ordered to effect his arrest and that the post of Special Deputy for the Luanchow-Shanhaikwan Areas, is abolished herewith.

At a conference held on November 26 by the Executive Yuan, it was resolved that the Peiping Branch of the Military Affairs Commission be abolished, after which all matters relating to this organization will be dealt with directly by the Military Affairs Commission (of which General Chiang Kai Shek is Chairman) and that all matters relating to the Luanchow-Shanhaikwan Areas should, after the abolition of the post of Special Deputy, be dealt with directly by the Hopei Provincial Government.

It was also resolved that General Ho Yin Ching, Minister of War, be appointed Superior Officer of the Executive Yuan residing at Peiping, that General Sung Cheh Yuen be appointed as Pacification Commissioner of Hopei and Charhar Provinces and that General Sung Cheh Yuen and General Shang Chen, Chairman of the Hopei Provincial Government, be directed to undertake full responsibility for the maintenance of peace and good order at places under their jurisdiction.

National Government Requested to Suppress Rebels.

The Chinese Chamber of Commerce has sent a telegram to the National Government requesting it to adopt strict measures to cope with the situation in North China.

In a telegram sent to General Sung Cheh Yuen, Peiping and Tientsin Defence Commissioner, and General Sheng Chen, Chairman of the Hopei Provincial Government, the Chamber requests them to preserve the integrity of China's territory.

The Shanghai District Association, the General Labour Union, the Shanghai Bar Association, etc. have also sent telegrams to the National Government, Generals Sung Cheh Yuen and Shang Chen requesting them to suppress the rebels in the North.

Chen Poo (Shanghai Morning Post, an official organ of General Chiang Kai Shek) publishes the following editorials:-

The Suppression of Rebels

The activities of rebels, such as Yin Zu Keng, Shih You San and Zee Sih Yuen, have increased the instability in the North. Although the National Government has ordered the arrest of Yin Zu Keng and appointed General Ho Yin Ching Superior Officer of the Executive Yuan at Peiping, we cannot hold optimistic views towards the situation in the North until the Government has resorted to military action to suppress the rebels. The reason why the rebels have been so bold as to create a disturbance in the North is

1935年11月27日。下午译件。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

国民政府与华北局势。

11月26日，国民政府发布命令，罢免滦榆区特种专员殷汝耕，因其在通州组织所谓防共联盟，并声明已命令河北省政府将其逮捕，同时撤销滦榆区特种专员一职。

在11月26日举行的行政院会议上，决议撤销军事委员会北平分会，此后与该组织有关的一切事务将由军事委员会（蒋介石将军任委员长）直接处理；在特种专员职位撤销后，与滦榆区有关的一切事务应由河北省政府直接处理。

会议还决议，任命军政部长何应钦将军为驻北平的行政院高级官员，任命宋哲元将军为河北、察哈尔两省绥靖主任，并指令宋哲元将军和河北省政府主席商震将军全面负责维持其管辖地区的和平与秩序。

要求国民政府镇压叛乱分子。

上海总商会已向国民政府发出电报，要求其采取严厉措施应对华北局势。

在给北平天津卫戍司令宋哲元将军和河北省政府主席商震将军的电报中，商会请求他们维护中国领土的完整。

上海特别市地方协会、上海总工会、上海律师公会等也向国民政府、宋哲元和商震将军发出电报，要求他们镇压北方的叛乱分子。

《晨报》（蒋介石将军的官方喉舌）刊登了以下社论：-

镇压叛乱

殷汝耕、石友三和齐燮元等叛乱分子的活动加剧了北方的不稳定。虽然国民政府已下令逮捕殷汝耕，并任命何应钦将军为驻北平的行政院高级官员，但在政府采取军事行动镇压叛乱分子之前，我们对华北局势不能持乐观态度。叛乱分子之所以如此大胆地在北方制造骚乱，原因是

November 27, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

partly due to the fact that they may secure foreign
support and that the National Government may not be in
a position to touch them. Unless the National Government
orders an immediate attack on the rebels, the latter
will take the so-called demilitarized zone as their base
to start a revolution to destroy the whole of the North.
In this case, the wording in a booklet belonging to Tada
to the effect that the finances of the five provinces
in North China will become independent will materialize,
and we cannot guarantee that the establishment of a colony
in North China by certain authorities will not become a
fact. The root of the evil in the North must be overthrown
so that the devil that interferes with the civil affairs
of the Chinese Government will find no way to succeed.
An extensive attack on the rebels by the National
Government will raise a question as to whether Chinese
armed troops may enter the demilitarized zone. We believe
that the Japanese have no grounds whatever to prevent
the Chinese armies from suppressing the rebels. The
creation of the demilitarized zone is for the purpose of
averting a clash between Chinese and Japanese armies;
the zone was not established for the rebels to occupy.
Now that the rebels have utilized this demilitarized zone
and occupied it as a base to endanger China, there are
no reasons for the Japanese Authorities preventing the
Chinese armies from advancing towards the demilitarized
zone to suppress the rebels.
Under the name of the self-government movement,
the rebels Yin, Shih and Zee have started an uprising
against the National Government. The people in the
North are becoming panic-stricken. When we recollect
the sufferings of our people living in the demilitarized
zone and its neighbourhood, and when we recollect the
fate of the country, we must determine to guard against
any possible secession movement, suppress the rebels.
Should the National Government be determined
to suppress the rebels immediately, the people throughout
the country will all be willing to support them. Thus,
no matter what difficulties may face us, we can overcome
them, if they only act immediately.

The Modern Daily News(時代日報) published the following
comment on November 26 :-

On November 24 Yin Zu Keng, Special Deputy for
the Luanchow-Shanhaikwan Areas, declared independence in
