and the demilitarized zone, which the government troops
are not allowed to enter. The Japanese military

However, the fact is that Yin Zu Keng was appointed Special
Deputy for the Luanchow-Shanhaikwan Areas on Japan's
recommendation and that the said self-government is
established in the demilitarized zone. According to a
telegram received yesterday, the troops of the 32nd Division
under General Sung Cheh Yuen have entered Tungchow, but

1935年11月27日。下午译件。

部分原因在于他们可能获得外国支持，而国民政府可能无法触及他们。除非国民政府下令立即攻击叛乱分子，否则后者将以所谓非武装区为基地，发动革命以摧毁整个华北。在这种情况下，多田（Tada）小册子中关于华北五省财政将独立的说法将成为现实，我们不能保证某些当局在华北建立殖民地不会成为事实。必须铲除华北祸根，使干涉中国政府内政的魔鬼无计可施。
国民政府对叛乱分子的大规模进攻将引发中国武装部队是否可以进入非武装区的问题。我们认为，日本没有任何理由阻止中国军队镇压叛乱分子。设立非武装区的目的是为了避免中日军队之间的冲突；该区的设立并非为了让叛乱分子占领。既然叛乱分子利用这一非武装区并将其作为危害中国的基地，日本当局就没有理由阻止中国军队向非武装区推进以镇压叛乱分子。
叛乱分子殷、石和齐以自治运动为名，发动了反对国民政府的起义。北方人民正变得惊慌失措。当我们回想起生活在非武装区及其周边地区人民的苦难，以及国家的命运时，我们必须决心防范任何可能的分裂运动，镇压叛乱分子。
如果国民政府决心立即镇压叛乱分子，全国人民都将愿意支持他们。因此，无论我们面临什么困难，只要他们立即行动，我们就能克服它们。

《时代日报》于11月26日发表了以下评论：-

11月24日，滦榆区特种专员殷汝耕在冀东非武装区宣布独立。他胆敢成立脱离国民政府的自治政府，是因为他有日本人作为支持者，且该地区是政府军队不得进入的非武装区。天津日本军方发表声明，称未参与此运动。然而，事实是，殷汝耕是在日本推荐下被任命为滦榆区特种专员的，且该自治政府建立在非武装区内。根据昨日收到的电报，宋哲元将军麾下的第32师部队已进入通州，但

November 27, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Japan is about to lodge a protest. This shows clearly that Yin Zu Keng has actually obtained assistance from Japan in his rebellious move.
The integrity of China's territorial and administrative rights should be maintained. As the rebels have started the self-government, our government should be requested to instruct the 29th Army to quell the rebellion. At the present extraordinary time, the Truce should be declared as null and void. If Japan still has some intention to cooperate with China and not to interfere with our territorial integrity, she must not prevent our troops from quelling the rebellion, by using the Truce as a pretext, unless she voluntarily directs the rebels to abolish their self-government.
China does not wish to be at enmity with Japan; her only desire is that Japan will not proceed any further. Whether or not Japan will abide by this will be seen from whether Japan will allow the Chinese troops to suppress the rebellion or not. The only armed force under the command of Yin Zu Keng is the Peace Preservation Corps which is naturally unable to combat with the government troops. If Japan does not side with the rebels, we believe that order will be restored in the Luantung District in a day or two.
What we are fearing now is that Japan may send reinforcements to the Great Wall to abate the rebellious movement, while on the other hand she may prevent the troops under General Sung Cheh Yuen from undertaking the rebel suppression campaign and not hesitate to instigate Yin Zu Keng from forming a bogus state on the same footing as "Manchukuo" in an attempt to divide North China. This, of course, is Japan's old trick in the annexation of the North-East. If so, what is the use of conducting parleys on the future of Sino-Japanese relations!
At any rate, the Government should first of all determine to suppress the rebels, and we do not wish to say what the future will bring for us.

Shun Pao and other local newspapers published the following article on November 26 :-

JAPANESE MERCHANTS ENTERTAINED BY CHINESE ECONOMIC MISSION TO JAPAN

The Chinese Economic Mission to Japan gave an entertainment on the night of November 25 at the Park Hotel, Bubbling Well Road, to a number of local Japanese merchants.
Among those present were Mr. Funatsu, President of the Japanese Cotton Mill Owners Association in China, the Manager of the Mitsui Bussan Kaisha, the representative of the Japanese Chamber of Commerce and others.
At the close of the reception, the question of the formation of an Association for the development of commerce between China and Japan was discussed.

1935年11月27日。下午译件。

日本即将提出抗议。这清楚地表明，殷汝耕在其叛逆行动中实际上获得了日本的援助。
应维护中国领土和行政权利的完整。鉴于叛乱分子已启动自治，应请求我国政府指令第29军平息叛乱。在此非常时期，应宣布停战协定无效。如果日本仍有意与中国合作，不干涉我们的领土完整，则不得以停战协定为借口阻止我军平息叛乱，除非日本自愿指令叛乱分子废除其自治政府。
中国不希望与日本为敌；她唯一的愿望是日本不再进一步行动。日本是否会遵守这一点，将从日本是否允许中国军队镇压叛乱中看出。殷汝耕指挥的唯一武装力量是保安队，自然无法与政府军作战。如果日本不与叛乱分子站在一起，我们相信滦东地区的秩序将在一两天内恢复。
我们现在担心的是，日本可能会向长城增派援军以平息叛乱运动，另一方面又可能阻止宋哲元将军的部队开展平叛行动，并不惜唆使殷汝耕建立一个与“满洲国”同等的伪国家，企图分裂华北。当然，这是日本吞并东北的老伎俩。如果是这样，就中日关系未来进行谈判又有何用！
无论如何，政府首先应决心镇压叛乱分子，至于未来会带来什么，我们不愿置评。

《申报》及其他本地报纸于11月26日刊登了以下文章：-

日本经济使团宴请日本商人

赴日中国经济使团于11月25日晚在南京路（Bubbling Well Road）国际饭店宴请了一些当地日本商人。
出席者包括在华日本棉纺业主协会会长船津先生、三井物产株式会社经理、日本商会代表等。
招待会结束时，讨论了成立一个促进中日商业发展的协会的问题。

MAINICHI

GENERAL SUNG CHE YUAN HOLDS CONFERENCE TO DECIDE

the autonomy movement. The general will announce his
attitude within a few days.

AMBASSADOR ARIYOSHI TO PROCEED TO NANKING

A Rengo telegram from Tokyo
states that on November 25 Mr. Ting, acting Ambassador
to Japan, called on Mr. Shigemitsu, Vice Minister of
Foreign Affairs, and informed him that the Nanking
Government has decided to appoint Ambassador Chiang
Tso Pin who is now in Nanking to open negotiations with
Ambassador Ariyoshi to settle the Sino-Japanese
relations. Accordingly Mr. Hirota, Minister of Foreign
Affairs cabled to Ambassador Ariyoshi instructing him
to proceed to Nanking to conduct the negotiations.
Ambassador Ariyoshi is therefore expected to proceed
to Nanking shortly.
pages.zh:
1935年11月26日。下午译件。
-2-

《每日新闻》

宋哲元将军召开会议决定对自治运动之态度。

据北平专电称，11月25日晚，宋哲元将军与第二十九军官员举行会议。结果他决定支持自治运动。该将军将于数日内宣布其态度。

有吉明大使将前往南京

据东京联合社电称，11月25日，驻日代办丁先生拜访了外务次官重光葵先生，并告知他南京政府已决定任命目前在南京的蒋作宾大使与有吉明大使开启谈判，以解决中日关系。据此，外相广田弘毅致电有吉明大使，指示其前往南京进行谈判。因此，预计有吉明大使将于近期前往南京。

pages.en:
November 26, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

KIPPO

DR. C.T. WANG LEAVING FOR JAPAN

Dr. C. T. Wang, former Minister
of Foreign Affairs, in company with Mr. Van K'eng, former
Counsellor of the Foreign Ministry, will proceed to
Japan to-day on the S. S. President Jefferson. Dr.
Wang called on Military Attache Isogae yesterday.
Major -General Isogai states
that he advised Dr. Wang some time ago to go to
Japan to inspect the present conditions in Japan as
he had informed him that he had nothing to do. "On
November 25 Dr. Wang called on me", he said, "and
informed me that he was leaving for Japan, but I
advised him not to go to Japan at present because it
is not a favourable time for him to do so. He then
stated that he had made up his mind and had even booked
his passage. I did not recommend him to go because
it would cause people to think that he was going to
Japan as an envoy of Chiang Kai Shek. However, Dr.
Wang assured me that this was not so. Dr. Wang and
his companion Mr. Van K'eng will remain in Tokyo for
only about 10 days."

TIENTSIN KUOMINTANG DECIDES TO SUPPRESS AUTONOMY
MOVEMENT

A Daito telegram from Tientsin
states that at 9 a.m. November 24 the Tientsin Kuomintang
held an urgent meeting in the Chinese Transporters
Guild and passed resolutions to suppress the autonomy
movement in the North and to assassinate all the leaders
of the autonomy movement and the pro-Japanese
and pro-Manchukuoan Chinese, in accordance with the
instructions received from the Central Kuomintang.

TEN DIVISIONS OF CENTRAL ARMY IN HONAN

The autonomy movement in the
various provinces in the North and the unsuccessful
result of the of the currency reform would cause the
down-fall of Chiang Kai Shek's regime. For this reason,
Chiang Kai Shek is sending his troops to Honan to
suppress the movement in the North and at the same time
he is endeavouring to win over the militarists in the
North. It is reported that about 10 divisions of
troops passed through Hankow for the North. There will
be about 300,000 soldiers in Honan when the ten divisions
have joined the defence force already established there.
pages.zh:
1935年11月26日。下午译件。

《警保》

王正廷博士启程赴日

前外交部长王正廷博士将与前外交部参事范肯（Van K'eng，音译）先生一同，于今日乘坐“杰斐逊总统”号轮船前往日本。王博士昨日拜访了武官矶谷（Isogae，原文如此，应为Isogai）少将。

矶谷（Isogai）少将称，他曾在不久前建议王博士前往日本视察日本现状，因为王博士曾告知他自己无事可做。“11月25日，王博士拜访了我，”他说，“并告知我他将前往日本，但我建议他目前不要前往日本，因为此时对他而言并非有利时机。他随后表示已下定决心，甚至已预订船票。我不建议他去，因为这会让人们认为他是作为蒋介石的特使前往日本。然而，王博士向我保证事实并非如此。王博士及其同伴范肯先生将在东京停留约10天。”

天津国民党决定镇压自治运动

据天津大同社电称，11月24日上午9时，天津国民党在中国运输业公会召开紧急会议，并通过决议，根据国民党中央收到的指示，镇压北方的自治运动，并刺杀所有自治运动领导人以及亲日和亲满洲国的中国人。

中央军十个师进驻河南

北方各省的自治运动以及币制改革的不成功结果，将导致蒋介石政权的垮台。为此，蒋介石正派兵前往河南以镇压北方的运动，同时他正努力争取北方军阀的支持。据报道，约有十个师的部队经汉口北上。当这十个师与已在当地建立的防御部队汇合后，河南将有约30万士兵。

November 26, 1935.    Morning Translation.
(印：PRIORITY / ASSIGNMENT / (CRP))

Shun Pao and other local newspapers (Tientsin telegram) :-

AUTONOMY MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA - REBELS STAGE
DEMONSTRATIONS IN TIENTSIN.

At 6 a.m. November 25 the rebel elements hiding
in the certain Concession assembled several hundred of their
number, some wearing uniforms or armlets with inscriptions
"North China People's Self-Defence Corps", and others
carrying clubs and two machine guns, who proceeded in trucks
to Tungmalu and seized the First Lecture Hall. They posted
up two banners at the entrance of the hall, bearing the
inscriptions "Headquarters of the North China People's
Self-Defence Dare-To-Die Corps". After mounting machine
gun posts in the street, they proceeded to the City
Government in several batches, either on foot or in trucks,
led by people of a certain nationality, and staged
demonstrations shouting slogans on the way.
At 8.40 a.m. the first batch of rebels, numbering
about 60, drove up in two trucks before the City Government
and, claiming themselves to be members of the People's Self-
Defence Corps, requested for an interview with the Mayor.
As Mayor Chen Kuh was not present, they were received by
Mr. Sung Zung Yue, the Chief Secretary. The callers
submitted a petition demanding the abdication of the
government. Mr. Sung promised to transmit the petition
to the Mayor, after which those in plainclothes left but
those in uniforms remained in the building. Upon a
telephonic message from Mr. Sung, Ikegami, Chief of the
Japanese Gendarmes, arrived with two gendarmes and
succeeded in persuading them to leave.
At 9 a.m. a second batch of rebels, about 100
in number, the majority of whom were boys, arrived and
requested to see the Mayor. They styled themselves as
the "North China Farmers Self-Salvation Corps". They were
persuaded to leave by the Chief Secretary, Mr. Sung Zung Yue.
At about 10 a.m. another batch of rebels,
numbering about 200, wearing plainclothes and uniforms,
came with the same request. They claimed themselves to
be the "Chong Hsien People's Self-Defence Corps".
At 11 a.m. the demonstrators assembled in front
of the Headquarters of Tientsin-Tangku Peace Preservation
Commissioner and shouted slogans. The Headquarters
immediately called out an armed guard commanded by Adjutant
Wong Shing Kong who arrested six of the demonstrators. The
members of the guard were very angry and attempted to open
fire which was only prevented by Adjutant Wong. Adjutant
Wong telephoned to Paoting for instructions and was directed
to consult with the Japanese authorities in handling the
situation. On a request from Ikegami, Chief of the
Japanese Gendarmes, the arrested persons were later
released and the demonstrators dispersed.
The Dare-To-Die Corps is organized by Zung Yien
Hou(鄭彥棻), former Commander of the First Army of the
National Salvation Troops, who was responsible for the
previous uprising in Luantung. The members of the Corps
were each issued with $1 and 4 loaves of bread daily, being
mostly loafers and drug addicts. The banner carriers were
mostly boys who were given $0.40 and 4 loaves of bread each
daily. There were also a few persons of a certain
nationality who took part in the movement.

《申报》及其他本地报纸（天津电）：

华北自治运动——叛乱分子在天津举行示威。

11月25日上午6时，隐藏在某一租界内的叛乱分子集结了数百人，其中一些人身穿制服或佩戴写有“华北人民自卫团”字样的臂章，另一些人手持棍棒和两挺机枪，他们乘卡车前往东马路并占领了第一讲演厅。他们在该厅入口处张贴了两面横幅，上面写着“华北人民自卫敢死队总部”。在街道上架设机枪阵地后，他们分几批，有的步行，有的乘卡车，由某国籍人士带领，前往市政府，沿途高呼口号进行示威。

上午8时40分，第一批约60名的叛乱分子乘两辆卡车驶至市政府前，自称是人民自卫团成员，要求会见市长。由于市长陈恭恰不在，由秘书长宋宗岳先生接待。来访者提交了一份请愿书，要求政府辞职。宋先生答应将请愿书转交市长，随后便衣人员离开，但身穿制服的人员仍留在大楼内。接到宋先生的电话后，日本宪兵队队长池上（Ikegami，音译）带着两名宪兵赶到，并成功说服他们离开。

上午9时，第二批约100名叛乱分子抵达，其中大多数是少年，要求见市长。他们自称是“华北农民自救团”。秘书长宋宗岳先生劝离了他们。

上午10时许，另一批约200名身穿便衣和制服的叛乱分子前来，提出同样的要求。他们自称是“崇县人民自卫团”。

上午11时，示威者聚集在津塘和平保安专员公署门前高呼口号。公署立即召出由副官黄兴公（Wong Shing Kong，音译）指挥的武装卫队，逮捕了六名示威者。卫队成员非常愤怒，试图开枪，但被黄副官制止。黄副官致电保定请示，获指示在与日本当局协商处理此事。应日本宪兵队队长池上的请求，被捕人员随后被释放，示威者散去。

敢死队由前救国军第一军司令郑彦棻（Zung Yien Hou，注：此处英文拼写与中文名对应存疑，依原文括号内汉字译为郑彦棻）组织，他曾负责此前的滦东起义。该队成员每人每天发放1元和4个面包，成员多为游手好闲之徒和吸毒者。举旗者多为少年，每人每天给予0.40元和4个面包。也有少数某国籍人士参与了此次运动。

"Regarding the domestic policy, sincere
cooperation must be effected between the National
Government and the various provincial and district
governments. Such cooperation will tend to consolidate
our national strength. The "membership rights" of
the Kuomintang members must be restored and Kuomintang

Further the people should be given freedom of speech,

Sin Wan Pao (telegrams from Peiping and Tientsin):-

THE SITUATION IN NORTH CHINA

Dr. Chiang Mong Ling, Dr. Hu Shih and several
other presidents and professors of various universities
and colleges in Peiping issued the following manifesto
on November 24, 1935:-
"Recently false opinion, alleged to be that
of the general public, was created for the purpose of
breaking the unity of the country. We, members of
educational circles of Peiping, are opposed to any
special political organ or plan that has for its
purpose secession from the National Government.
We also demand that the Government use the full
strength of the country to preserve the integrity of
our territory and its administration."

Special precautionary measures were adopted
in Tientsin on the evening of November 24 because some
500 lawless elements had gathered at Keng Yu Li in a
certain Concession in readiness to start a movement.
The Chinese Authorities have opened negotiations with
a certain government.

On November 24, Gen. Sung Cheh Yuan sent
several telegrams to Nanking asking for instructions
to deal with the activities of lawless elements.
He has been informed that the situation would be
handled through diplomatic channels.

According to persons arriving at Nanking
from Tientsin on November 14, Shih Yu Shan and Chi
Shih Yuan (齐世元) are very active in a certain
Concession in Tientsin. The evil characters they
have assembled are mostly narcotic addicts who are
being given a small quantity of heroin and a sum of
money each day.

1935年11月25日。下午译件。

“关于国内政策，国民政府与各省政府及地方政府之间必须实现真诚合作。这种合作将有助于巩固我们的国力。必须恢复国民党党员的‘党员权利’，并使国民党党员承担更重大的责任。此外，应给予人民言论、集会和出版自由，这样他们在对抗侵略者的斗争中才能发挥作用。
“我一直主张抗日和剿共。如果采取明确措施，我将接受指派给我的任何职务。
“如果我本人在南京，我也会提出同样的观点。
李宗仁。”

《新晚报》（北平和天津电）：

华北局势

1935年11月24日，北平各大学院校的校长和教授蒋梦麟博士、胡适博士等几人发表了以下宣言：
“最近，有人制造所谓公众舆论，旨在破坏国家统一。我们北平教育界人士反对任何以脱离国民政府为目的的特殊政治机构或计划。我们也要求政府动用全国力量来保卫我国领土和行政的完整。”

11月24日晚，天津采取了特别的预防措施，因为约有500名不法分子聚集在某一租界的庚余里（Keng Yu Li，音译），准备发动运动。中国当局已与某政府展开谈判。

11月24日，宋哲元将军向南京发出数封电报，请求指示以应对不法分子的行动。他获悉，局势将通过外交渠道处理。

据11月14日从天津抵达南京的人士称，石友三和齐世元（Chi Shih Yuan）在天津某一租界内活动频繁。他们召集的不法之徒大多是吸毒者，每天每人给予少量海洛因和一笔钱。

November 25, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

On the afternoon of November 23, pamphlets were distributed in Tangku. The situation in Tientsin has suddenly become tense. On receiving a report to the effect that lawless elements in Tientsin are planning to disguise themselves as policemen and occupy the strategic points in Tientsin, the Police on the evening of November 23 took on their summer uniform and carried out strict precautionary measures. A few arrests were made.

The Chinese Edition of the Shanghai Nichi Nichi publishes the following telegrams from Tientsin :-

Yin Ju Keng, Administrative Commissioner of the demilitarized area, moved by the enthusiastic desires of the people in the area, issued a manifesto on November 23 announcing the severance of the demilitarized area from Nanking.

Yin Ju Keng is a graduate of Waseda University. In 1926 he participated in the campaign organized by Gen. Kuo Soong Ling against the late Gen. Chang Tso Ling. He was the representative of the National Government to Japan in 1928 and assisted Mayor Wu Te Chen in the negotiations with Japan during the Sino-Japanese Hostilities in Shanghai. His wife is a Japanese.

People's Daily News 人民日报 published the following comment on Nov. 23:-

SINO-JAPANESE RELATIONS

The Chinese and Japanese peoples belong to the same race and possess a similar culture. As owners of the East Asia they should keep in close touch with each other.

Since the annexation of Korea, vast tracts of our territory have fallen into the hands of the Japanese who are now advocating an "Asiatic Monroe Doctrine". She regards herself as the leader in Asia. Chinese are fully aware of this and are willing to die for the salvation of their nation.

It is obvious that the present delicate situation has arisen through the mistaken views adopted by Japan. Japan regards herself as superior to others. To her the Kellogg Pact; the Naval Pact, etc. are but scraps of papers, and as for the League of Nations she has no respect for it at all. Towards China, she takes a free hand and does as she likes.

Under such conditions there can be no talk of peace in East Asia.

Modern Daily News published the following article on Nov. 22:-

YANG AH MAO IN SZECHUEN

Yang Ah Mao (杨阿毛), formerly a notorious loafer in Shanghai, fled to Szechuen several years ago after having shot to death an officer of the S.M.P.. It is now reported that he has established a restaurant in Szechuen.

1935年11月25日。下午译件。

11月23日下午，塘沽分发传单。天津局势突然紧张。警方收到报告称，天津的不法分子计划伪装成警察并占领天津的战略要点，于是警方在11月23日晚换上夏季制服，并实施了严格的预防措施。进行了少量逮捕。

上海《日日新闻》中文版刊登了以下来自天津的电讯：

非武装区行政委员殷汝耕受该地区民众热情愿望的感动，于11月23日发表宣言，宣布非武装区与南京断绝关系。

殷汝耕毕业于早稻田大学。1926年，他参加了郭松龄将军组织的反对已故张作霖将军的战役。1928年，他担任国民政府驻日代表，并在上海中日冲突期间协助市长吴铁城与日本进行谈判。他的妻子是日本人。

11月23日，《人民日报》（People's Daily News）发表了以下评论：

中日关系

中日两国人民同种同文。作为东亚的主人，他们应保持密切联系。

自从朝鲜被吞并以来，我国大片领土落入日本人手中，他们现在鼓吹“亚洲门罗主义”。她自视为亚洲的领袖。中国人充分意识到这一点，并愿意为拯救国家而死。

显然，目前的微妙局势是由于日本采取的错误观点造成的。日本自视高人一等。对她来说，《凯洛格公约》、《海军条约》等不过是一纸空文，至于国际联盟，她根本不放在眼里。对中国，她放手行事，为所欲为。

在这种情况下，东亚无从谈起和平。

11月22日，《现代日报》（Modern Daily News）刊登了以下文章：

杨阿毛在四川

杨阿毛，前上海著名无赖，在枪杀一名工部局警务处（S.M.P.）警官后，于数年前逃往四川。现据报道，他已在四川开设了一家餐馆。

November 20, 1935.    3    Afternoon Translation.

Ta Lei Wan Pao and other local newspapers published the
following special telegram from Peiping on November 19 :-

THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN NORTH CHINA

According to information received from
diplomatic sources, it is learned that the leaders in
North China, being under the pressure of the Japanese
militarists, will establish "an autonomous state in
North China" as was advocated by the Japanese. It is
said that the movement will be put into effect as soon
as Sung Cheh Yuan, Chin Teh Cheng, Shang Chen, Siao
Tseng Ying, Chen Kuo and Ying Shih Ken are eligible for
membership. Three committees to be known as the
Communications Committee, Cultural Committee and the
Economic Committee, will be established to deal with
the interior administration of this new Government,
while a Political Council similar in nature to the one
existent in the South-West, will be formed to handle
all diplomatic affairs. This organization will first
be carried out in two or three provinces in North China.
The new state, with the exception of its political
and economic independence, should be subject to the
control and supervision of the National Government as
regards matters involving military affairs.
In connection with this movement, the
leaders in North China held an emergency conference on
night of November 18, when the following points were
decided on:-
(1) Measures relating to this autonomous
movement.
(2) The new government to be established
in the nature of an allied state and its name is to be
known as "The Autonomous State of North China" or "The
Autonomous State of the North China Frontier".
(3) All taxes and revenues, etc. collected
should be handed over the new government.
(4) All military affairs in the new
state should be subject to the control and supervision
of the Central Military Affairs Commission.
As regards the connections between the
new state and the Japanese Authorities, it is stated
that an agreement has been reached, but whether this
agreement has been officially signed or not is unknown.
According to Siao Tseng Ying, a compromise
has been secured from the Japanese that the new state
will be established on condition that it is not subject
to any interference in its civil administration or
invasion of its territorial rights by any people. The
new state has, however, to employ Japanese advisors,
although it has the right to decide the number of and
select the appropriate candidates.
Chien Yung Chong, Chairman of the Shansi
Provincial Government, despatched a telegram on November 18
to General Yen Hsi Shan, who is at present at Nanking
participating in the 5th National Congress of the Kuomintang,
urging his immediate return to the North.
Further information gleaned elicits that
a large number of Japanese forces outside the Great Wall
have concentrated at Shanhaikwan. It is presumed that

1935年11月20日。 3 下午译件。

《大美晚报》及其他本地报纸刊登了11月19日发自北平的特急电报如下：-

华北自治运动

据从外交渠道获得的消息获悉，华北领袖在日本军国主义者的压力下，将按照日本人的主张建立“华北自治国”。据悉，一旦宋哲元、秦德纯、商震、萧振瀛、陈果夫及应世珍（音译）具备成员资格，该运动即会付诸实施。将设立三个委员会，分别称为交通委员会、文化委员会和经济委员会，以处理这个新政府的内政事务；同时还将组建一个性质类似于西南政务委员会的政治委员会，以处理所有外交事务。这一组织将首先在华北的两三个省份推行。这个新国家除了政治和经济独立外，在涉及军事事务方面应受国民政府的控制和监督。

关于此次运动，华北领袖于11月18日晚召开紧急会议，决定了以下几点：-
(1) 有关此自治运动的措施。
(2) 新建立的政府具有联盟国家的性质，其名称定为“华北自治国”或“华北边区自治国”。
(3) 所有征收的税款和收入等应移交给新政府。
(4) 新国家的所有军事事务应受中央军事委员会的控制和监督。

关于新国家与日本当局的关系，据说已达成协议，但该协议是否已正式签署尚不清楚。据萧振瀛称，已从日本人那里争取到妥协，即新国家的建立条件是，其民政管理不受任何干涉，领土权利不受任何人侵犯。然而，新国家必须聘用日本顾问，尽管它有权决定人数并挑选合适的人选。

山西省政府主席阎锡山于11月18日致电目前正在南京参加国民党第五次全国代表大会的阎锡山将军，促其立即返回北方。

November 19, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

NICHI-NICHI

ARRIVAL OF RELIEF MARINES FROM JAPAN.

About 200 Japanese Marines
arrived yesterday on the S. S. Shanghai Maru to take the
place of others who have already completed their terms
of service in Shanghai.

S
53 JAPANESE ANARCHISTS ARRESTED IN JAPAN.

It is reported that recently
the Tokyo Police arrested 53 important anarchists,
including Uemura, age 29, chairman of the Central
Committee of the Japanese Anarchistic Communist Party,
Aizawa, their chief secretary, Futami, chief of their
Finance Section and Irie, chief of their Military Section.
According to information given by the prisoners to the
Police there are about 400 anarchists in Japan.
The Tokyo Police issued
instructions to the police authorities in Yokohama, Kobe,
Moji and Nagasaki to keep a close watch on anarchists
who try to go to Shanghai and other foreign ports.

JIPPO

JAPANESE MILITARY AUTHORITIES' DECISION REGARDING
JAPAN'S POLICY TOWARDS CHINA.

A Dentsu telegram from Kagoshima
dated November 18 states that as a result of a conference
held between War Minister and General Imai, chief of the
Military Affairs Bureau, to discuss the China policy
question, the following decisions have arrived at:-
1. Following the Nanking incident the anti-Japanese
attitude of the important officials of the Nanking Govern-
ment has become stronger. The Japanese Government should
take speedy and appropriate measures according to the
pre-determined policy towards China.
2. The policy towards the North has already been
adopted and the Kwantung Army Commanders Headquarters have
been instructed regarding the policy. For this reason
the War Ministry should seek the co-operation of the
Japanese authorities there. In this connection the
understanding of the government organs concerned is
necessary. The War Minister will, therefore, make
appropriate arrangements with the Premier and the Finance
Minister.

JAPAN OPPOSES MILITARY SUPPRESSION IN THE NORTH

A Dentsu telegram from Hsinking
dated November 17 reports that the Kwantung Army pays
serious attention to the autonomy movement in the North.
If Chiang Kai Shek sends troops to the North to suppress
the autonomy movement violating the Tangku Truce and the
Boxer Agreement, the Kwantung Army will put a stop to
the Chinese military interference in the movement.

《日日新闻》

来自日本的增援海军陆战队抵达。

约200名日本海军陆战队员昨天乘坐“上海丸”号轮船抵达，以接替那些在上海服役期满的人员。

S
53名日本无政府主义者在日本被捕。

据报道，东京警方最近逮捕了53名重要的无政府主义者，其中包括29岁的日本无政府主义共产党中央委员会主席上村（Uemura，音译）、他们的总秘书相泽（Aizawa，音译）、财务部长双见（Futami，音译）和军事部长入江（Irie，音译）。根据囚犯向警方提供的信息，日本约有400名无政府主义者。

东京警方已向横滨、神户、门司和长崎的警察当局发出指令，严密监视试图前往上海和其他外国港口的无政府主义者。

《时报》

日本军方当局关于日本对华政策的决定。

11月18日发自鹿儿岛的电通社电报称，陆军大臣与军务局局长今井（Imai，音译）将军就讨论对华政策问题举行会议后，达成了以下决定：-
1. 继南京事件之后，南京政府重要官员的反日态度日益强硬。日本政府应根据既定的对华政策，迅速采取适当措施。
2. 对北政策已经采纳，并已就相关政策向关东军司令部下达指令。因此，陆军省应寻求当地日本当局的合作。在这方面，有必要获得相关政府机构的理解。因此，陆军大臣将与首相和大藏大臣作出适当安排。

日本反对在北方进行军事镇压

11月17日发自新京的电通社电报报道，关东军严重关注北方的自治运动。如果蒋介石派遣军队到北方镇压自治运动，从而违反《塘沽协定》和《辛丑条约》，关东军将制止中国军队对该运动的干涉。

November 18, 1935. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Mei Wan Pao published the following telegrams from
Tientsin on November 17 :-

GENERAL DOIHARA DIRECTS THE AUTONOMOUS MOVEMENT IN
NORTH CHINA

According to information from a reliable
source, General Doihara of the Japanese Kwantung Army on
November 7 submitted a demand to General Sung Cheh Yuan,
the Garisson Commander of Peiping and Tientsin, requesting
him to proceed with the movement for an autonomy in North
China, within three days. General Sung, however, replied
that this cannot be decided on, until the 5th National
Congress of the Kuomintang, at present being held in
Nanking, is over.
It is said that the various offices of
the National Government in North China, including the
Peiping Military Council, will be abolished while a new
organ will be established with General Sung Cheh Yuan as
the leader. The new organ will, however, maintain some
adequate connections with the National Government. This
is the fundamental scheme of the formation of an autonomous
government in North China but whether the National
Government will accept it or not is at present unknown.
The above information has been released by
Japan and is reported to have been confirmed by the
Chinese authorities.
It is further reported that the Customs
revenue, the Salt revenue, Consolidated Tax, Stamp Tax,
and other government revenues of North China will be with-
held for the development of North China.
General Doihara is intending to make North
China entirely independent from the National Government
and proposes that the suggested autonomous government
adopts a new emblem and new coins. General Sung Cheh
Yuan, however, is insisting that (1) the new government
should be under the National Government in its organization
and (2) the integrity of North China should be preserved;
none of North China should be annexed by Japan or "Manchukuo".
According to general observation, the "connections" between
the suggested autonomous government and the National
Government may be cut off at a time when the National
Government may be alleged to have undertaken anti-Japanese
activities.
General Sung Cheh Yuan held that this
movement should not be carried until the time is opportune
and has requested Japan accordingly. The latter, however,
is exerting every effort to press Sung.
The so-called new state of North China
would consist of Hopei, Charhar, Suiyuan, Shansi and
Shantung Provinces. It has not been definitely decided
however, whether or not the two last named provinces will
be included.

《大美晚报》刊登了11月17日发自天津的以下电报：-

土肥原将军指挥华北自治运动

据可靠消息来源，日本关东军土肥原将军于11月7日向平津卫戍司令宋哲元将军提出要求，请他在三天内推进华北自治运动。然而，宋将军回复称，在目前于南京举行的国民党第五次全国代表大会结束之前，此事无法决定。

据说，包括北平军事委员会在内的国民政府在华北的各机构将被撤销，同时将建立一个以宋哲元将军为领导的新机构。然而，新机构将与国民政府保持一定的适当联系。这是建立华北自治政府的基本方案，但国民政府是否会接受目前尚不清楚。

上述信息由日本发布，据报已得到中国当局的证实。

另有报道称，华北的海关收入、盐税、统税、印花税及其他政府收入将被扣留，用于华北的发展。

土肥原将军打算使华北完全脱离国民政府，并建议拟议中的自治政府采用新的徽章和新货币。然而，宋哲元将军坚持认为：(1) 新政府在组织上应隶属于国民政府；(2) 应保持华北的完整；华北的任何部分都不应被日本或“满洲国”吞并。

据一般观察，拟议中的自治政府与国民政府之间的“联系”可能会在国民政府被指控从事反日活动时切断。

宋哲元将军认为，在时机成熟之前不应开展此运动，并据此请求日本方面。然而，后者正竭尽全力向宋施压。

所谓的华北新国家将由河北、察哈尔、绥远、山西和山东各省组成。然而，最后两个省份是否包括在内尚未最终决定。
